CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Sturdy but a couple of assembly faults
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I was delighted to get this rack to be able to organise tools, but disappointed to see that it has a couple of faults that prevent correct assembly.
Firstly, the bottom rack pushes together and then should be kept in place with a screw, but the two holes do not line up (see photo with yellow arrows showing where the hole SHOULD be). This means that although the bottom rack will fit together, it is not as stable and robust as it is designed to be.
The second fault is also with the bottom rack - the outside edges should have been welded to either the sides or the undersides of the side edge, but they have instead been welded to the TOP of it, thus preventing the side panels from being bolted into place properly (see photos with blue arrows). The work-around for this is to use 2 or 3 suitably-sized washers as spacers in each and every hole, but this results in gaps around the edges. The alternative is to have the whole bottom rack upside-down, but then the curves will point downwards and the tools will slide off . . . . a potentially expensive and/or dangerous result!
You can see from my final photo that, with the aid of the extra washers, it was finally assembled, but it is neither as robust nor as aesthetically pleasing as it should be.
This had the potential to be good, but has been let down by stupid manufacturing errors, so only two stars from me.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Sturdy with lots of cool accessories. Well above average for similar priced bags.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
The bag itself is a substantial size for storing water, treats, toys and bags for longer everyday walks. For ease of carrying it has a shoulder strap that you can clip on and off, the clips are plastic but seem quite sturdy.

The strap is adjustable and has a padded movable section to put over your shoulder. For putting in the car it has two short handles that you can secure together with a velcro wrap around strip which is a nice touch.

The front of the bag has a zip pocket the width of the bag. Both ends have pockets with elasticated tops that are large and secure enough to hold water bottles. The inside of the bag is spacious and has a rectangular piece of material to separate the compartment into two. All linings are waterproof.

When you open up the bag, you'll find two collapsible plastic water bowls with carabiner style clips attached to them, two square smaller bags with zips, waterproof linings and handles and finally a towel. It's in the style of oven gloves, so it makes it easy to keep hold of whilst trying to dry your squirming dog.

I've had quite a few dog bags over the years, and the accessories make this one. Probably one of the best value bags with lots of utility.

I work as an exam invigilator, and quite a few of the children in the concessions rooms have dyslexia and need a coloured overlay. These tend to get lost or the child forgets to bring it with them, so I thought that these would be ideal for me to carry in my bag so that I would have one to offer them when that happens. I've been doing the job for 12 years, now, and cheating is very rare indeed, so I see my role as making it as easy and stress-free as I can for the concessions children, within the confines of the exam board rules, and they are allowed coloured overlays when they are doing their GCSEs.

I was interested to see what kind of a difference they would make, and it turns out that I can read small writing more easily using the yellow one, so I can imagine what a benefit these will be to any student who has forgotten theirs. They can also be used as a ruler and a general guideline for reading more easily, without using the coloured part.

We got this to hang a vintage lucite lamp (socket style), and the dimensions for these cords are exactly what we were looking for—we don’t have to reach up, and the switch still has enough distance from the plug. We also wanted a socket that didn’t have the extra threading or security ring, since that would take away from the visual aesthetic.

All the parts are certified (UL or equivalent), and the cable is pliable to thread properly into the plastic hanging hooks. I also like the rocker-style switch since it’s easier to use. That being said, the cable insulation seems to be easily damaged, and in our case was easily scraped merely by threading through the plastic hanging hooks. The cable looks a little tacky and doesn’t straighten out, and feels flimsy like telephone cords. The socket looks assembled from pieces that clip together and have rough plastic edges. I’m overall concerned if this cord can support the weight of our lamp shade in the long term.

The colour matching is also poor. The socket and plastic hanging hooks are more of a warmer cream colour, the switch is a milky white, and the cable is a greyish white. It’s like the manufacturer ordered a whole bunch of unrelated pieces and mashed them together.

I can recommend these for lighter duty hanging when you’re not worried about the appearance, otherwise suggest you look elsewhere. We’ll probably be looking for an alternative in the longer term.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Good value, but don't use for climbing
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
There are several YouTube reviews showing the strength of no-name brand climbing equipment such as this and they do well, but there is no mechanism for product recalls that I can see and I've had some equipment where the manufacturer is not identifiable and no longer sell equipment. That does not inspire confidence.

Further, these do not meet the latest BS EN 566:2017 according to their claims.

Finally, when I went on a jewellery making course the instructor said when she was in South America the jeweller just looked at the silver and said "it looks like 925" and stamped it as such. The same can be said for equipment - these are not listed as UIAA compliant on the UIAA certified equipment list and I suspect they've just printed UIAA on without receiving certification.

Other than all that, these are good and I might use for tree safety.

Ärgerlich ist auch die Begrenzung der SD-Karte auf 32 GB, von der man erst erfährt, wenn man sich wundert, warum die 128 GB Karte bestimmte Lieder nicht findet. Am Ende hatte ich noch eine Brummschleife zwischen MP3 Player und Verstärker, die ich irgendwann im Trial und Error Verfahren eliminieren konnte. Die Verarbeitung ist erstklassig. Der dicke Edelstahl fühlt sich robust an und die BPA-freien Verschlüsse geben mir ein gutes Gefühl. Auch nach mehreren Wochen intensiver Nutzung sieht die Dose aus wie neu und lässt sich leicht reinigen.

Ein unerwarteter Bonus: Ich verwende die Dose nicht nur für Kaffee, sondern auch für Tee und sogar für Zucker. Sie ist vielseitig einsetzbar und hält alles frisch und trocken.

Fazit: Die BELLE VOUS Kaffeedose ist mehr als nur ein Aufbewahrungsbehälter - sie ist ein stilvolles Accessoire, das Funktionalität und Ästhetik perfekt vereint. Für alle Kaffeeliebhaber, die Wert auf Frische und schönes Design legen, ist diese Dose ein absolutes Muss!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Cheap, Uncomfortable to Stand On but Good for Your Arms
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This is a decent enough twisting disc exercising gadget thingy but honestly it's a bit faddy and if you're looking for miracles you need to look elsewhere. You also need to be very careful with any exercise that involves twisting as it can cause serious harm if you're out of shape or lacking in core strength.

That said though this is decently made and you can get a good workout from it, especially around the arms and hips. It's very simple to use and you just stand on it while holding an end of the rope in each hand. You then pull and stretch them out to get the thing moving. It's pretty simple but effective. It's certainly good for helping you to balance if nothing else!

As part of a wider workout regime it's fine. On it's own you'd probably have to do far too many revolutions to count to actually see any great big difference but my arms feel good. I don't think I'll be using this much though as apart from the balance issues I have and the feeling that I'm not getting as full of a workout as expected I also didn't find it at all comfortable to stand on. The top is very textured and so a bit knobbly which wasn't very pleasant at all.

It's ok. Go in with low expectations and you'll be fine.

Instead of rummaging through cabinets for the ingredients we need, everything is on display and within arm's reach. This saves us lots of time during cooking!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Utilizzo la cover su un vecchio Galaxy J3 2016 di riserva e devo dire che è buona.

L'interno (parte colorata in argento) presenta un texturing "a puntini" che serve per fare in modo che le particelle di polvere/sporco, che possono accumularsi se non la si lava per lunghi periodi, non lascino dei segni sulla scocca. Il "feeling" del materiale è molto piacevole al tatto e anche il colore è molto bello.

Gli intagli per la porta USB, il jack delle cuffie e lo speaker sono appropriati (non troppo grossi o troppo piccoli) e, nota di merito, la cover copre tutti i tasti (bilancere del volume e tasto di accensione) garantendo protezione dai graffi ma senza intaccare sul "feedback tattile" che si ha quando li si preme.

Ho apprezzato il fatto che i bordi siano rialzati e che anche in corrispondenza della fotocamera posteriore si abbia un po' di rialzo.

In conclusione si tratta di una cover con un'ottima qualità costruttiva, che consente di migliorare la protezione del telefono in caso di cadute, senza però risultare ingombrante o alterare il "feel" originale del dispositivo.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Lids not very secure and can’t take liners
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This is a review of “BELLE VOUS Small Desktop Trash Cans with Lids (2 Pack) - Mini Plastic Waste Bins for Desk, Table, Office, Kitchen, Bedroom or Bathroom - 1.4L & 2.2L Garbage Cans”, currently priced £17.49.

The pop up mechanism releases well, but it so strong that the small bin actually lifts up off the desk when it is used! This might not be too much of a problem, but the lids do not fit very securely so a jolt like this or a slight knock often dislodges them. They need to click properly in place not just rest inside the rim as they do.

From the images online the sides of these bins looks frosted, but in fact they are fairly transparent. I do not want the contents of my bins being too obvious so I decided to try a liner, but it was hard to find ones the right size. Once I did I discovered that the lids fit even less well once they have to accommodate even a very thin liner, and using one also prevents the lid from pivoting into the space at the back of the bin when you open it so it only opens part-way. One of the images shows a liner inside so it is very disappointing that this is not actually possible.

These might work as storage containers as long as you don’t plan to open them very often, but as bins for regular use I don’t recommend them. The price is also very high for two small plastic items.
There is no plate for water drain

Belle Vous describe this as a sliding closet drawer organiser. As an organiser it’s good, as for the sliding, it’s awful.

The basket is strong and well built, and will hold a considerable number of clothes or other bits and bobs and could be put to many uses round the house.

Then there’s the attempt to make it slide. A nice idea-if it worked. At the best I’ll call it inefficient, at worst, dangerous. If 2 baskets are used, leave the 3rd on one side for a moment, then the slider works. But as there are no stops the basket could shoot off either the front or the back. Or if the contents are unbalanced in the baskets, then as the top basket is pulled forward both could easily topple over. If a third basket is added on top of the other 2 then the problems mount. You have 2 baskets that could shoot off front or back. You now have 3 baskets that could topple over. And to add to the fun, because of the weight of the top basket and contents the middle basket will no longer slide.

It’s as if the design department had to finishing designing this basket by 4 pm and at 3.55 pm realise that they have yet to start designing the runners.

If this basket set did away with the runners so they were freestanding then it would be worth more stars. But then it wouldn’t be worth the £30.99 asking price. Not that it’s worth paying that much for it as it is now.

The only solution I can come up with is for the design department to ask if they can work overtime.

Das AZDelivery NodeMCU Amica Modul V2 ist einfach fantastisch! Mit dem ESP8266 und dem praktischen USB-C Anschluss habe ich viele Stunden Spaß gehabt und gleichzeitig viel gelernt.

Die einfache Programmierung und die vielfältigen Einsatzmöglichkeiten machen es zu einem idealen Tool für alle, die sich mit IoT und Mikrocontrollern beschäftigen möchten. Die Module sind zuverlässig und bieten eine starke WLAN-Verbindung, die ich für meine Projekte sehr geschätzt habe.

Das 3er-Pack ist perfekt, um mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu entwickeln oder als Backup zu haben. Ich kann das NodeMCU Amica Modul V2 jedem empfehlen, der in die Welt der Mikrocontroller einsteigen oder seine Fähigkeiten erweitern möchte. Eine klare 10 von 10 für dieses großartige Produkt!

Das Buch "Social Media Marketing für Einsteiger" von Carlos Dr. Bravo bietet eine umfassende und praxisorientierte Einführung in die Welt des Social Media Marketings. Besonders für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMUs) und Selbstständige stellt es eine wertvolle Ressource dar, um die Grundlagen von Social Media Strategien zu verstehen und erfolgreich umzusetzen. In einer Zeit, in der soziale Netzwerke wie Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn und Co. einen immer wichtigeren Platz im Marketing-Mix einnehmen, zeigt Bravo den Weg, wie diese Plattformen aus unternehmerischer Sicht gewinnbringend genutzt werden können.

Ein zentraler Vorteil dieses Buches liegt in seiner leicht verständlichen und praxisorientierten Herangehensweise. Bravo führt den Leser Schritt für Schritt durch die verschiedenen Aspekte des Social Media Marketings und nimmt dabei besonders die Bedürfnisse von KMUs in den Blick. Diese Unternehmen sehen sich oft mit der Herausforderung konfrontiert, knappe Ressourcen effizient einsetzen zu müssen, um in der digitalen Welt Fuß zu fassen. Hier bietet das Buch konkrete Fallstudien, die reale Anwendungsfälle vorstellen und zur Inspiration bei der Definition einer eigenen Social Media Strategie dienen.

Die agile Methodologie, die Bravo in seinem Werk vorstellt, ist ein weiterer starker Punkt des Buches. Diese Methode ermöglicht es Unternehmen, ihre Social Media Aktivitäten kontinuierlich zu verbessern und flexibel auf Veränderungen und Trends zu reagieren. Dieser Ansatz ist besonders wertvoll, da sich die Welt der sozialen Medien ständig weiterentwickelt. Durch regelmäßige Anpassungen und Optimierungen können Unternehmen sicherstellen, dass ihre Strategien relevant bleiben und sie ihre Zielgruppen effektiv erreichen.

Ein besonderes Augenmerk legt Bravo auf den Aufbau von Communities auf den wichtigsten Social Media Plattformen wie Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok und Snapchat. Er zeigt auf, wie Unternehmen auf diesen Plattformen nicht nur Inhalte veröffentlichen, sondern echte Beziehungen zu ihren Kunden aufbauen können. Der Community-Aufbau ist ein entscheidender Faktor für den Erfolg von Social Media Marketing, da engagierte und treue Follower das Fundament für langfristigen Erfolg bilden.

Ein weiteres Highlight des Buches sind die Insidertipps, die wertvolle Einblicke in mögliche Herausforderungen und Fallstricke bieten, die im Social Media Marketing auftreten können. Bravo gibt praktische Ratschläge, wie Unternehmen diese Stolpersteine erfolgreich bewältigen können. Diese Tipps basieren auf seiner umfangreichen Erfahrung und ermöglichen es, häufige Fehler zu vermeiden und von Beginn an auf Erfolgskurs zu bleiben.

Auch die Erfolgskontrolle spielt eine wichtige Rolle in Bravos Buch. Er stellt Werkzeuge und Metriken vor, die es Unternehmen ermöglichen, den Return on Investment (ROI) ihrer Social Media Aktivitäten zu messen. Dies ist ein entscheidender Aspekt, da viele Unternehmen Schwierigkeiten haben, die Effektivität ihrer Social Media Maßnahmen zu bewerten. Durch klare und nachvollziehbare Metriken können Unternehmen ihre Ergebnisse analysieren und fundierte Entscheidungen zur Optimierung ihrer Strategien treffen.

Für Unternehmen, die sich erstmals intensiv mit Social Media Marketing auseinandersetzen, bietet dieses Buch einen schnellen und einfachen Einstieg. Die praxisorientierten Umsetzungsleitfäden machen es möglich, sofort mit der Arbeit zu beginnen und erste Erfolge zu erzielen. Bravo erklärt nicht nur die Grundlagen, sondern gibt auch praktische Handlungsempfehlungen, die mit kleinen unternehmensspezifischen Anpassungen direkt implementiert werden können.

Zusätzlich stellt das Buch einen Fragenkatalog zur Verfügung, der Unternehmen dabei hilft, die richtigen Dienstleister und Agenturen auszuwählen, wenn sie externe Unterstützung im Bereich Social Media Marketing benötigen. Dies ist besonders wertvoll für KMUs, die möglicherweise nicht die internen Ressourcen haben, um eine umfassende Social Media Strategie selbst umzusetzen.

Insgesamt ist "Social Media Marketing für Einsteiger" von Carlos Dr. Bravo ein unverzichtbarer Leitfaden für alle, die ihre ersten Schritte in die Welt des Social Media Marketings wagen möchten. Durch seine praxisorientierte und leicht verständliche Herangehensweise ermöglicht das Buch einen erfolgreichen Einstieg und bietet gleichzeitig wertvolle Tipps und Tools zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der eigenen Social Media Strategie. Für KMUs und Selbstständige ist es eine wertvolle Ressource, um das Potenzial von sozialen Medien voll auszuschöpfen und ihre Marketingziele zu erreichen.

My 6 year old granddaughter tried out this waist whisper for the first time and she shimmied back and forth as if she’d been using this piece of equipment for years. My turn next. At just under 13 stone I’m a lot heavier than GD, but still well within Belle Vous’s suggested weight limit. I doubt whether the most generous person would call my movements a shimmy, more the jerk. And it wasn’t me-it was the board. It was no longer smooth, it was as if the board was bogged down with my weight.

I thought acupuncture was a precise science, but these nubs as Belle Vous call them rely on numbers rather than accuracy. It wouldn’t matter much to my feet. I think I could walk on nails and not feel anything. These nubs don’t stand a chance. I can’t see them making much impression on anyone’s feet. I’m less sure about the magnets. They aren’t very strong, they seem to be randomly placed and would need precise placing of the feet to stand a chance of having any effect.

If this board worked for adults and not just lightweight children I would say it’s worth considering. But when it doesn’t work for adults and the efficacy of the nubs and magnets is dubious at best then I can’t recommend buying this Belle Vous Waist Whisper.

Das Regal ist nicht nur praktisch, sondern auch ein echter Hingucker, der meine Küche aufwertet. Insgesamt kann ich dieses Gewürzregal jedem empfehlen, der Wert auf Organisation und Stil in der Küche legt!

I have lots of houseplants and pots on my patio, so these pot feet looked really useful. I already use terracotta feet - 3 per large pot - which look good but tend to move around, and the pot doesn't stay balanced. I also recently bought some plastic "terracotta" feet, which also move around - and look a bit naff. These small, square black pot risers raise the pots enough to keep them off the ground sufficiently for water to drain away - and we do get an awful lot of surplus water these days! Placed just inside the edge of the pot also makes them virtually invisible.

Indoors I have quite a few large houseplants which currently sit on bamboo mats to protect the carpet underneath, but they often get knocked by the vacuum cleaner, and it's also not easy to move pot and mat together. To keep the option of being able to move the pots, I don't really want to stick them to the carpet, but can use these pads to stick them to the mats.

The pot risers come in a pack of 24, making them just 48p each at the current price of £11.49. They are easy to use, and so far they are sticking well to protect both plants and surfaces. I can't help feeling that they could have other uses as well - so I may well be buying some more!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Versatile spice rack with room for improvement
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Pros:
- Smart space saving solution for spices or tea
- Includes jars and oil dispensers
- Despite some average craftsmanship, it looks nice on the cabinet

Cons:
- Craftsmanship could be improved
- No anti-slip layer between jars and the rack
- No labels included to mark the contents of each jar

The spice rack arrived in secure packaging, with everything carefully wrapped to ensure it reached us without any damage or cracks. As shown in the pictures and accurately described by the seller, the package included the rack itself, 8 spice jars, and two oil dispenser bottles.

Since my wife and I are tea lovers, we decided to repurpose the jars to store our various teas instead of spices. The jar lids have a plastic seal that does a great job of keeping moisture out, ensuring the contents stay fresh. Aesthetically, the rack looks fantastic on our kitchen cabinets and fits right in with our decor.

While I’m generally happy with the product, there are a few areas for improvement. First, the craftsmanship is fairly average, you can clearly see the glue used to hold the wood parts together, which could have been done more neatly. Secondly, the rack would benefit from an anti-slip material under the jars or on the racks. Although the jars sit securely, there’s a slight risk of them slipping if the rack is accidentally bumped. Lastly, it would have been helpful if the package included some labels to write the contents of each jar.

Overall, I like the product, but due to these three issues, I would give it 3 stars.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I recently got the Healthy Hounds PaddyPaw Portable Dog Water Bottle for walks with my dog, and it’s been a brilliant little addition to our outings. The one-handed operation is a lifesaver, especially when you've got an excitable dog tugging at the lead. With the press of a button, water flows into the attached bowl, and my dog drinks away without any fuss. It’s great for walks, especially when we’re out for longer stretches and away from water sources.

The bottle feels sturdy and well-made, so I’m confident it’ll last a while. The added carabiner makes it easy to clip to my bag, which is a nice touch. And the waste bag dispenser—honestly, that’s just genius. No more digging around in pockets for bags when nature calls! Plus, there's a little compartment for treats, which my dog appreciates as much as the water.

The only downside is that the water capacity could be a bit bigger for longer hikes. I sometimes have to refill it if we’re out for ages, but for a casual walk, it's more than enough. Overall, great value for money and super handy for keeping your dog hydrated on the go. Couldn’t really ask for more… unless it also carried the dog home after a long walk!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Die perfekte Haarbürste zum Entknoten – Mühelos und schmerzfrei!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich habe lange nach einer Haarbürste gesucht, die das tägliche Entknoten meiner Haare nicht nur erleichtert, sondern auch meine Kopfhaut schont – und ich bin absolut begeistert, diese Bürste gefunden zu haben! Sie entknotet die Haare so leicht und schmerzfrei, dass ich mich jedes Mal aufs Neue frage, wie ich vorher ohne sie ausgekommen bin.

Was diese Bürste so besonders macht:

1. Sanft und effektiv: Die flexiblen Borsten gleiten durch das Haar, ohne zu ziehen oder Haarbruch zu verursachen. Selbst nach dem Duschen, wenn meine Haare am stärksten verknotet sind, bekomme ich sie damit mühelos entwirrt.
2. Für jeden Haartyp geeignet: Ich habe dickes Haar, aber ich kann mir vorstellen, dass diese Bürste auch bei feinem oder lockigem Haar funktioniert. Sie passt sich wirklich jeder Haarstruktur an.
3. Kein Haarbruch mehr: Ich habe gemerkt, dass ich viel weniger Haare verliere, seitdem ich diese Bürste benutze. Sie ist wirklich schonend und mein Haar fühlt sich gesünder an.
4. Angenehm in der Hand: Der Griff liegt super in der Hand und das Bürsten geht wirklich schnell und unkompliziert – perfekt für den Alltag!

Insgesamt bin ich super zufrieden und würde diese Bürste jedem empfehlen, der Probleme mit verknoteten Haaren hat oder einfach nur nach einer schonenden Bürste sucht. Ich habe auch Bürsten der Marke Tangle Teezer, nehme aber mittlerweile diese Bürste 🤗

Für alle Arten von Haaren, sowohl richtig dicke und krause, als auch für feine, dünne, verhedderte, die Bürste ist einfach genial! Zieht nicht, kämmt richtig gut durch, entwirrt. Absolute Kaufempfehlung

Das Trainingstrikot der Marke TCA hat uns auf ganzer Linie überzeugt. Das Design ist modern und ansprechend, was meinem Sohn sofort gefallen hat. Auch die Verarbeitung lässt keine Wünsche offen: Es gibt keine scheuernden Nähte, was bei intensiveren Trainingseinheiten ein großer Vorteil ist und Hautirritationen verhindert.

Besonders begeistert sind wir vom Material. Das Trikot besteht aus einem leichten, kühlen und atmungsaktiven Stoff, der den Schweiß gut ableitet und so ein angenehmes Tragegefühl auch bei schweißtreibenden Sportarten bietet. Nach dem Waschen ist das Shirt sehr schnell wieder trocken, sodass der Trockner in den meisten Fällen überflüssig ist, sofern man das Shirt eine Nacht lang zum Trocknen aufhängt.

Die Größe entspricht unseren Erwartungen, sodass wir uns beim Kauf auf die Standardgrößen verlassen konnten. Mein Sohn nutzt das TCA Trainingstrikot vor allem für das Leichtathletiktraining und ist damit sehr zufrieden. Es bietet ihm die Bewegungsfreiheit, die er benötigt, und sieht dabei auch noch klasse aus.

Wir sind rundum zufrieden mit dem Produkt und können es definitiv weiterempfehlen – besonders für alle, die ein bequemes und funktionales Trainingsshirt suchen, das sowohl in der Optik als auch in der Qualität überzeugt.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Brilliant as long as you realise it's not really "adjustable".
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This feeding stand is self assembly flat pack. It seems to be made of a solid material that is painted matt black. The finish is nice. The paintwork is smooth and the wood pieces nicely finished.
Assembly is easy. The supplied screws fit in place using an Allen key which is also supplied. Once fitted together the stand is sturdy and secure.
The description says "adjustable". I would question this and say it is more configurable than adjustable. You can choose what heights to have the bowl collars, but once they are in, they are probably in for good. Unscrewing and then screwing back in again is going to erode the screw holes - the screws bite directly into the wood rather than bolts going into a metal fitting. It will probably stand a couple of reconfigures, but after that I expect the fitting to become loose.
In use the stand is great. The central horizontal pole can be used as a handle for moving the stand. The bowls fit well into the stand and don't rattle when in use. The paintwork wipes clean to remove spills.
This is a good stand that can be customised for your dog's comfort.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: A stackable solution with a sliding disappointment

These drawer organisers offer a promising solution for maximizing storage space, but the sliding feature falls short of expectations. While they stack securely on top of each other, there's no way to slide out individual drawers without pulling out the entire unit. This makes accessing items in the lower bins quite inconvenient.

I initially intended to use them in my wardrobe, but the lack of independent sliding drawers made them impractical for that purpose. I ended up using them for vegetable storage in my pantry, where the sliding function isn't as crucial.

The organisers themselves are sturdy and well-made, offering ample storage space. However, the design flaw with the drawers significantly limits their versatility. If the drawers had individual rollers or a way to secure them while sliding, they would be much more functional.

I mixed this with 91% alcohol since they said that there could be some separation if you use anything less than 90%. I mixed this up and got some containers to go with them. I put the liquid in the cartridge and put it in the station and cleaned my shavers. The following morning I inspected the shaver and it smelled like lemon as advertised and it appears to have cleaned it pretty good. The only thing I noticed is typically with the Braun solution, if I rub the shaver against my hand after it cleans it, it would still be a little wet or at least have a small amount of liquid residue left on there. I didnt notice that with this, maybe because of the 91% alcohol being able to dry a lot faster. But the shave experience was no different, the shaver still performed as it should. One small container can make up enough solution to fill 3 cartridges! So this 3 pack will allow you to make up to 9 refills. Very good product at the fraction of the original braun solution.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
La bolsa de frío y calor para la espalda es un accesorio esencial para quienes buscan alivio de dolores musculares, tensión o simplemente desean relajarse después de un largo día. Su diseño ergonómico se adapta perfectamente a la zona lumbar, proporcionando un confort inmediato.

Características destacadas:

Versatilidad: Esta bolsa se puede usar tanto caliente como fría, lo que la convierte en una solución práctica para diferentes tipos de molestias. El calor ayuda a relajar los músculos y mejorar la circulación, mientras que el frío es ideal para reducir inflamaciones y calmar el dolor.

Material de calidad: Generalmente está fabricada con materiales suaves y duraderos, lo que la hace cómoda al tacto y resistente al uso diario. La funda suele es lavable, facilitando su mantenimiento.

Fácil de usar: Se calienta en el microondas o se pueden enfriar en el congelador, lo que permite un uso rápido y sin complicaciones.

Alivio localizado: Su forma y tamaño permiten que se adapte bien a la espalda, concentrando el tratamiento en la zona donde más se necesita.

Portabilidad: Muchas de estas bolsas son ligeras y fáciles de transportar, lo que las hace ideales para usar en casa, en la oficina o incluso durante viajes.

Conclusión: En general, la bolsa de frío y calor para la espalda es una excelente inversión para quienes buscan un alivio eficaz y natural para el dolor. Su versatilidad y comodidad la convierten en un aliado perfecto para el bienestar diario. Sin duda, es un producto altamente recomendado para mejorar la calidad de vida.

This is a great idea and my puppy loves puzzle toys, but I have found that the pieces get stuck more often than not, which really frustrates my dog. In turn, he then starts dragging and flipping the toy over to access the treats more easily, therefore negating the whole point of a puzzle toy.

Sometimes, unless you get the angle just right, the squeaker doesn't squeak and again - the puppy gets annoyed. Or freaked out when it suddenly squeaks.

The manoeuvrability of the treat covers can be hit and miss, with the edges getting stuck in the track. They are quite wobbly so it isn't hard for an enthusiastic dog to push or snuffle too hard and then they turn slightly and become wedged.

The turn dial thingy at the top left of the toy is the biggest culprit for getting stuck and having a frustrated puppy is actually the opposite of what I need when I'm trying to keep him busy so I can get on with other stuff for a few minutes.

It's a shame because when it does work, it's brilliant and a lot of fun. But the fact that it keeps getting stuck makes it not a great option.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: für Nassbereich ungeeignet, im Trockenbereich geeignet - bitte darauf achten!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Zu 100 Prozent konnten mich die Haltegriffe nicht überzeugen. Sie bestehen aus Edelstahl 201. Dieser wird vor allem in trockener Umgebung eingesetzt und ist ziemlich leicht. Das heißt auch, dass er im feuchtem Badezimmer schnell rostet. Im Gegensatz dazu gibt es noch Edelstahl 304, der im Nassbereich Anwendung findet.

Wenn man sich beispielsweise aus der Badewanne herausziehen möchte, habe ich deshalb Bedenken. Die Kräfte, die hier auf die Haltegriffe einwirken, sind enorm. Durch die Feuchtigkeit rostet der 201 Stahl schnell und kann demzufolge schneller brechen. Hier hätte ich Angst, mich daran hochzuziehen.
Im Gegensatz dazu, kann man die Griffe gut anbringen, wo es trocken ist. Das wäre beim Hochziehen von der Toilette, bei Stufen u.ä.

Die Länge der Haltegriffe ist optimal. Zudem wird das Installationsmaterial mitgeliefert. Der Preis ist auch relativ niedrig.

Da die jetzigen Haltegriffe nicht für feuchte Umgebung verwendet werden sollten, würde ich sie dort auch nicht anwenden. Hier ist Edelstahl 304 passend.
Dagegen sind die Haltegriffe aus dem Edelstahl 201 absolut gut im Trockenbereich einsetzbar.

Man muss immer wissen, wofür man die Haltegriffe benötigt: Nass nein, trocken ja.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: trés utile en IOT mais manque GPIO16
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
j’ai acheté ce module pour s’initier à la IOT avec batterie, donc naturellement je m’attendais à avoir à utiliser le pin GPIO16 pour réveiller le module du deepsleep. Mais j’étais surpris de remarquer l’absence de ce pin du board ( il y est bien sûr dans la puce esp8266 ). Donc si vous mettez le board en deepsleep , vous ne pourrez pas le réveiller avec le reset software. J’ai regardé des tutos pour souder un fil de GPIO16 à RST mais le pin de la puce esp8266 est archi miniscule que j’ai fin par le griller avec le fer à souder.
J’ai trouvé la solution en codant un reset externe venant d’un attiny13 qui dort lui aussi et après une heure se reveille , reveille le esp01 pour envoyer les données , ensuite tout les deux refont dodo. Consommation totale 100 microamp donc je suis content par rapport au nodemcu 12e qui consomme lui 11ma .
Conclusion je mets que 4 étoile à ce module mais à part l’absence du gpio16 j’ai rien d’autre à dire et il fonctionne tres bien.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Good strong holder for seven drills and their associated ancillaries
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Very strong, very solid, rack for hanging drills and storing power packs / drill bit sets / screwdrivers.

The rack arrives a box which requires self assembly, but they don't provide any guidance other than a picture showing that screws go through holes... From bitter experience after doing it wrong - when you're putting it together, you need to put to drill hanging hooks at the bottom INSIDE the box ends rather than trying to hang it from the bottom of the unit, and you need to ensure that the holes in the box ends that you drill through to fasten it to the wall are ALL facing backwards. I got these two elements wrong first time out and it wasted about 20 minutes.

The other oddity is that the upper two shelves are hinged units that fold out for securing to the box ends. they don't lie flat, nor do they have any stiffening applied to them. They get flattened out by the weight of the stuff you put on them, which doesn't seem a great approach since it's asking a lot of the hinges!

Other than the above quirks, though, this is a great way to organise the proliferation of drills that many people now accrue. I didn't think I'd use it all, but I have actually found 7 drills around my workshop and garage, so it's good that there are actually 7 slots rather than the 6 mentioned in the ad (there are even 7 pictured in place in advert!)..

This is a good strong holder for multiple drills, batteries and chargers, and if they'd spent more than 3 minutes on instructions, it would have been 5 stars.

Die Boxen sind praktisch. Der Deckel öffnet und schließt durch Druck auf den Verschluss. Das funktioniert gut.

Außerdem lässt sich der Deckel abnehmen, sodass die Box leicht gereinigt werden kann. Das ist vor allem für diejenigen - wie mich - interessant, die die Boxen für Abfall benutzen möchten.

Eigentlich wollte ich die große Box in der Küche für Biomüll nutzen, da sie in der derzeitigen Artikelbeschreibung als „dicht“ beschrieben werden. Dafür ist die Box aus meiner Sicht allerdings nicht geeignet:

Der abnehmbare Deckelaufsatz schließt zwar dicht ab, der Schwingdeckel jedoch nicht. Im vorderen Teil liegt er im Inneren auf einer Leiste auf, welche wahrscheinlich für einen dichten Abschluss sorgt. Im hinteren Teil (zwischen den beiden Schwingscharnieren) liegt der allerdings frei. Ich habe versucht, das entsprechend in meinen Fotos festzuhalten. Hier hätte es einer Abdichtung von außen über dem Deckel bedarft, um einen möglichst dichten Abschluss zu erreichen. Insofern wird die Box nicht „obstfliegensicher“ sein.

Die Box ist für Temperaturen von -30 bis +65 Grad Celsius geeignet. Für den Deckel gilt diese Angabe vermutlich nicht.

Das Material ist sehr leicht. Auf der Unterseite befinden sich Füßchen, die zwar auch aus Plastik sind. Diese sind aber ausreichend weich und abgerundet, sodass sie aus meiner Sicht tatsächlich klassische Gummifüßchen ersetzen und den Untergrund schonen.

Insgesamt sind die Boxen praktisch - bis auf die erwähnten Einschränkungen.

I am going to give this 5 stars because it fits albeit tighter than a (insert appropriate term here) and it puts out 2.5GbE speeds but there are a few things to note in order to make it fit.

1) Use a UK standard size single gang metal 47mm back box. Make sure it is perfectly square before you begin because the lug which allows you a few mm here and there isn’t going to work.
2) Take out one of the largest knock outs at the TOP of the single gang back box.
3) I used plastic conduit and bushes but up to you.
4) I used the thickest cable possible which was Oren CAT7 24 AWG but you should probably opt for something more sensible.
5) After you’ve cut the wall, set the box level with rapid set or something and punch down - kudos for the tooless connectors! Then you just need to ‘pursuade’ the metal face plate with termination into position. It really does help here if your metal back box has bushes and conduit because you can push and pull as much extra or little of the cable as you need to get a final fix. The 3.5mm bolts supplied are crap so pop up to Screwfix and get some decent M3.5 and cut to size.

If you don’t use a perfectly square 47mm deep back box then it won’t fit.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Strong borosilicate glass with great heat retention
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This bottle is pretty strong, the glass is not too thin or too thick, it's a good balance of weight and strength, the included sleeve helps to further protect it. It has quite a large footprint for just 900ml, but this is due to the double wall, the actual container is pretty small.

The opening is wide, easy to drink from with a smooth rounded lip and a strainer below, which could be better fitting as I have noticed it's not completely firm in its place, but its sufficient.

It keeps water ice cold and hot for a couple of hours, and warm for even longer. The outside of the bottle doesn't get that hot to hold, but if it does the sleeve helps to shield it.

The lid is made of plastic, which is the biggest concern for me, on the outside and more importantly the inside. This means synthetic ingredients will leech into your beverages, especially if they're hot. It takes away from the glass if your reason for using it was to avoid toxins.

Other than that, it works great, looks good ajd is ergonomic to hold.

These white boards are great.

The thing I like most about the white boards, other than their small size, is that physical notes are very difficult to beat in terms of ease of immediate access. They complement electronic calendar reminders but also add a lot extra because you can't help but see the white board notes for example when making a drink in the kitchen.

The pens are great: good selection of colours, deep colours, excellent thickness strokes and no smudging.

The white board surface is easy to clean. I tend not to use the provided white board rubber and instead use a tissue - it works very well.

My son uses his board as a homework reminder and it works very well.

The only downside is that there is no fixing mechanism for attaching the white board to a fridge door. The white board is small enough and light enough to attach to a fridge door and be easy to use but there's no magnetic backing or fixing strip which would though be easy to improvise.

I would definitely recommend the white board package for home use.

I recently tried this dog puzzle toy, priced at £12.49, and it’s kept my dogs very entertained. With 14 sliders and 21 openings to hide treats, this toy provides plenty of mental stimulation. It’s an excellent way to help improve a dog’s IQ skills and reduce boredom or destructive behavior, which has been especially useful for my dogs.
Teddy enjoyed the puzzle, but mostly for the treats—it’s clear he’s very food-oriented. Minnie seemed to understand the concept and was quite adept at moving the pieces. Buster, on the other hand, had a different approach: he simply kicked the toy around until he managed to move a piece, not showing much intellect in the process! One part they all struggled with was the rotating piece—it doesn’t spin as easily depending on which square is beside it, which adds a bit more of a challenge.
The puzzle can also double as a slow feeder, which can help prevent fast eaters from experiencing stomach issues. One feature that caught my attention was the squeaky button designed to attract the dog’s focus. However, my dogs seemed to interpret it as a command to destroy the toy rather than engage with it gently, so be mindful if your dogs react the same way.
A bit of confusion arises when it comes to cleaning the toy. While the product pictures show it as dishwasher safe, the page also mentions handwashing only due to its Polypropylene material. Further down, the description states it can be washed with warm water and is also safe for the dishwasher. This inconsistency should probably be clarified to avoid any mishaps.
One drawback I noticed was that despite the non-slip pads on the corners, the toy slid all over the floor when my dogs were playing with it, so it didn’t quite stay in place as I had hoped. Overall, it’s a fun, engaging toy with a few minor areas that could use improvement in terms of durability and clarity on cleaning.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Most suitable for requiring high volumes of storage
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This is the largest file storage box I’ve used, and if anything, it goes beyond the size that I require for my own personal filing; it is perhaps of a depth that would benefit a small business or department. It will take me some time to fill the storage capacity; the box takes quite a chunk of space. I prefer having a smaller storage box that can fit on my desk without taking up so much of a footprint. This is another factor that makes me feel it is better suited to a small business, where there will likely be a filing setup (or cube shelves as shown in the promotional images) and a higher volume of papers than I have personally.

It is also the first fabric storage box I’ve used, and while it is perhaps a nicer look than plastic alternatives, I’m not sure how well it would work for stacking and archiving.

Other reviews question the strength of the box and the usefulness of a single handle when it is full; whilst I haven’t filled this yet, I can see their point.

It's worth noting that the box doesn't come with any dividers, etc, inside, so unless you want a pile of loose papers in there, you may need to use additional folders to keep it organised.

The lack of any internal structure would make it more flexible so that it could be used as a toy box, for instance.

This box works best for someone who wants a box that looks nicer than a plastic one and has the space and volume to warrant it, maybe a small design office or something like that. The outside appearance of my filing boxes is not that important, so I will likely default to using smaller, cheaper plastic boxes with dividers or lock springs to keep papers in place.

MakerHawk OLED Display Module has been a solid addition to my tiny project, where I'm using it to display distance measurements from a TF Luna LiDAR. The compact size is perfect for my needs, and integration was straightforward. The OLED screen offers good clarity, making the distance readings easily visible.
While overall performance is satisfactory, I did notice some flickering when updating the display every 100ms. This minor issue aside, the module provides good value for its price point, especially for makers working on small-scale projects requiring a simple, space-efficient display solution.
If you're looking for a compact OLED display for your Arduino or Raspberry Pi or Stm32 „in case of me“projects, this module is worth considering. Just be aware that very rapid updates might cause some flickering.

Dieses Belle-Vous-Gewürzregal ist von eingeschweißtem Kunststoff umgeben und mit zwei Kunststoffecken an den empfindlichen Ecken versehen.

Jede der beiden quadratischen Flaschen ist einzeln in Luftpolsterfolie und Karton verpackt, ebenso wie die acht quadratischen Vorratsdosen aus Glas und Bambus mit Deckel.

Ich kann sagen, dass viel Zeit und Mühe in die Verpackung gesteckt wurden und das bedeutete, dass das gesamte Set in gutem Zustand ankam.

Dieses Bambus-Gewürzregal ist einfach zu montieren. Ziehen Sie einfach den Holzständer heraus und stecken Sie ihn in die Stabilisierungsstange, dann stellen Sie Ihre Flaschen/Gläser darauf.

Die Flaschen haben einen Ausgießer mit einem Stopfen, der leicht zu öffnen ist, um das Ausgießen zu ermöglichen, und mit einem Druck ist er verschlossen.

Aus der Ferne sieht das gesamte Ensemble wirklich gut aus, aber bei genauerem Hinsehen ist ein Teil der Verarbeitung etwas minderwertig; an einer der Verbindungsstellen der vorderen Ablage befindet sich eine sichtbare Metallklammer und einige Bereiche sind schlecht lackiert.

Es ist so schade, dass eine Metallklammer irgendwie an der Vorderseite des Ständers befestigt wurde, wo sie deutlich sichtbar ist und es Bereiche mit erhabenem Lack gibt, denn sonst wäre das für mich ein 5*-Produkt gewesen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Badly designed and doesn’t work effectively
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This metal shelving unit arrives flat packed but is quick and easy to assemble. It only requires the side panels to be clipped into the existing hooks and it’s done.

There is a sliding rail attached to the top edge of two of the trays to enable them to be stacked.

The baskets themselves are reasonably sturdy but as a tiered storage unit it fails miserably. There are no restrictors at the back or front of the trays and they pull right out and the whole thing collapses. It is a bit like having a chest of drawers with no casing there is no structure around the trays to keep them in place on the rails and stable as a unit.

This is an ill thought out design that fails to function as intended. With a bit more thought at the design stage it could have been greatly improved.

Der Webrahmen kommt genau wie auf den Bildern beschrieben.
Die Anleitung ist nur auf Englisch und in schwarz/weiß. Das führt dazu, dass z.B. ein beschriebener Knoten nur durch Raten zustande kam. Da die verschiedenen Fäden nur sehr schwer farblich auseinander zu halten sind. Vielleicht benutzen wir ihn falsch, aber es besteht zusätzlich das Problem, dass der Faden der Bespannen schnell mal „abgehoben“ wird.
Wir haben dafür ein Gummiband zur Sicherung um den Webrahmen gezogen. Danach ging es zum Glück.
Mit der mitgelieferten Wolle kann das Kind starten. Es wird aber nicht für ein ganzes Webstück reichen. Man sollte also noch Wolle parat haben.

Die Anleitung zum Zusammenbau der Teile ist nur in englisch. Dennoch ist dieser in kürzester Zeit erledigt. Leider fehlt ein hinterer Anschlag und sie sind nicht rutschfest. Wenn man sie nicht mit der Rückseite an einer Wand plaziert, dann rutscht statt der oberen Schublade schnell mal der ganze Stapel nach hinten. Hier wäre gründlicheres Nachdenken bei der Entwicklung sinnvoll gewesen.

Das Buch "Hacking & IT-Security für Einsteiger" von Max Engelhardt bietet eine umfassende und praxisorientierte Einführung in die Welt der IT-Sicherheit. Es richtet sich speziell an Anfänger und vermittelt das notwendige Wissen, um die Methoden der IT-Sicherheit zu verstehen, sich gegen Bedrohungen zu verteidigen und selbst als IT-Security-Experte aktiv zu werden. In einer Zeit, in der Sicherheitslücken, Trojaner und Hackerangriffe die Nachrichten dominieren, wird das Thema IT-Sicherheit immer wichtiger – sowohl für Privatpersonen als auch für Unternehmen.

Ein herausragendes Merkmal dieses Buches ist die einfache und verständliche Darstellung der Inhalte. Der Autor legt großen Wert darauf, auch komplexe Sachverhalte so zu erklären, dass sie für Einsteiger gut nachvollziehbar sind. Besonders hilfreich sind dabei die anschaulichen Beispiele und praxisnahen Übungen, die den Leser nicht nur theoretisch, sondern auch praktisch in die Materie einführen. Schritt für Schritt werden wichtige Werkzeuge wie Metasploit und Burp Suite vorgestellt, die für das Testen von Sicherheitslücken und das Durchführen von Angriffen auf IT-Systeme unerlässlich sind.

Eines der zentralen Themen des Buches ist das IT-Sicherheitsmanagement. Engelhardt erklärt, wie Unternehmen und Privatpersonen ihre Systeme effektiv gegen Angriffe schützen können. Dabei geht es nicht nur um technische Lösungen, sondern auch um die richtige Organisation und die Planung von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen. Hierbei spielen das IT-Notfallmanagement und die IT-Forensik eine wichtige Rolle – beides sind Themen, die im Buch ebenfalls ausführlich behandelt werden.

Für Einsteiger besonders interessant ist die Einführung in das Betriebssystem Kali Linux, das eine zentrale Rolle im Bereich des Hackings und der IT-Sicherheit spielt. Engelhardt zeigt Schritt für Schritt, wie dieses Betriebssystem auf einem Windows-Rechner als virtuelle Maschine installiert und genutzt werden kann. Mit Kali Linux erhalten die Leser Zugriff auf zahlreiche Werkzeuge, die in der Praxis von IT-Sicherheitsexperten und Hackern verwendet werden. Dadurch können sie die Sichtweise eines Angreifers einnehmen und lernen, wie Schwachstellen in Systemen erkannt und ausgenutzt werden.

Das Buch vermittelt jedoch nicht nur das Wissen aus der Perspektive eines Angreifers, sondern zeigt auch, wie man sich effektiv gegen solche Angriffe verteidigen kann. Dieses Zusammenspiel von Angriff und Verteidigung gibt den Lesern ein umfassendes Verständnis davon, wie IT-Sicherheit funktioniert. Das Ziel des Buches ist es, die Leser auf den Weg zu einem IT-Sicherheitsexperten zu bringen, der nicht nur versteht, wie Hacker arbeiten, sondern auch in der Lage ist, eigene Schutzmaßnahmen zu entwickeln.

Zusätzlich bietet das Buch einen Crashkurs zu HTML/HTTP und Python, wodurch die Leser lernen, selbst einfache Skripte zu erstellen und Code zu lesen. Diese Grundkenntnisse sind essentiell, um in der Welt der IT-Sicherheit erfolgreich zu sein. Der praktische Ansatz des Buches wird durch den Quellcode, der zum Download bereitsteht, weiter unterstützt. Dies ermöglicht es den Lesern, das Gelernte direkt in die Praxis umzusetzen und eigene Angriffe auf Testumgebungen zu simulieren.

Insgesamt ist "Hacking & IT-Security für Einsteiger" ein wertvolles Buch für alle, die in die Welt der IT-Sicherheit eintauchen möchten. Max Engelhardt schafft es, die komplexen Themen der IT-Sicherheit verständlich zu erklären und gleichzeitig praxisnahes Wissen zu vermitteln. Das Buch eignet sich sowohl für Einsteiger, die erste Schritte in Richtung IT-Sicherheit machen möchten, als auch für diejenigen, die sich intensiver mit Hacking-Methoden und Sicherheitsstrategien auseinandersetzen wollen. Es ist ein Leitfaden, der den Leser auf dem Weg zum IT-Sicherheitsexperten begleitet und eine solide Grundlage für weitere Lernschritte bietet.

I have two cats that are getting way up in years. Not too long ago, I bought them a pair of raised bowls - they wouldn't eat out of them. The problem was apparent before I even tried them - the bowls were tilted/angled. The angle was darn near impossible for the cats to comfortably eat their food.

I decided to try this one, since it looked like it was level, like a regular bowl. When it arrived, I washed it and got it ready to use.

When I fed the cats their wet food last night, I used this for one of the cats - the eldest. She seemed to like it just fine and ate all of her food. Tonight, I will use it for the other cat and find out if he likes it too. If so, I'll probably buy another of these.

This is a nice functional set and it looks cute. I think it's relatively sturdy, but will wait to see if it stands up to one of their cat brawls! If it's still standing after that, I will consider it perfect.

One thing does need a bit of improvement- the bottom. I have hardwood floors and it would be so helpful if this had rubber on the bottom to hold it in place. It slid and moved a bit while the cat the cat was eating from it. Besides that - everything is good. I do wish I had the option of getting 2 of these since I have 2 cats. That would have really been a good value for the money!

Overall, a nice raised kitty bowl. So far, one cat likes it and I'm pretty sure the other one will too. I'm satisfied and recommend.

Trop rigide donc, mais également très glissante ; c'est un simple plastique au fini certes mat, mais inefficace quant à la prise en main (et j'ai eu l'occasion de comparer l'adhérence avec une coque en silicone, et c'est le jour et la nuit !)
De plus, après une inspection plus minutieuse, j'ai noté le très léger empiètement du trou pour la lentille photo sur la lentille elle-même, ce qui montre une erreur de conception, ainsi qu'une absence, malgré ce que les photos de l'annonce peuvent donner à croire, d'un "bourrelet" protecteur autour dudit trou et de l'écran lui-même, ce qui signifie que, chaque fois que l'on pose son téléphone, la lentille ou l'écran se retrouve en contact direct avec la surface, et s'endommage sur le long terme.
Vraiment, je vous recommande, malgré le large choix de couleurs, de passer votre chemin.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: A really good pet travel bag for smaller breeds...
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
The main carrier appears well made and comes with a carry handle, shoulder strap and velcro divider in case one is needed. There's a sizeable pocket on the long side, and a bottle holder too. Inside are two smaller equally smart top-zippered bags useful for storing any manner of things including treats and dried food/biscuits that'd fit the 5"x5"x4.5" internal height. But the two collapsible bowls - for food and water - with an inside rim diameter of 4" and a depth of just 1", are likely suited to only smaller pooches, as is really the included dog towel.

Having helped as a dog-holder on the side-lines of many dog shows over the years, this is a nicely made and easy-to-carry solution for many dog owners, especially the smaller breed owners. And it'd definitely make a good starter kit/gift for the newer pet owner.

Got this for the kids to use for sleepovers in the garden and it has worked out really well. For the price I really can't grumble, as the set includes everything required including the little table and chairs.

- Pretty lightweight, but not so light that you'd want it on your back on a long hike.

- Waterproof, which was good as it got rained on the first night it went up.

Just to set expectations this isn't the same as a tent costing £400. It is at the budget end of things. Also, it isn't huge. We had no problems getting four kids in it, but four adults would be a challenge unless they were all small and close.

I also wouldn't want to use it for a long holiday, but for an inexpensive weekend trip, or in the garden it is just fine.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Kein Zieps, kein Weh-Tun - Kämmen mit Ninabella Haarbürste macht Spaß
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Ich kenne diese Art Haarbürsten bereits von meinem FriseurSalon und war schon immer richtig begeistert. Leider habe ich meine gute Haarbürste irgendwo liegengelassen und musste Ersatz besorgen, weil im FriseurSalon kein Vorrat mehr vorhanden war. Und ich war total erfreute diese Ninabella Haarbürste hier entdeckt zu haben. Und diese ist genauso gut in ihren Funktionen wie meine ehemalige vom Friseur. Auch die farbliche Ausführung in Grün begeistert mich. Mit dieser Bürste komme ich ganz einfach durch mein frisch gewaschenes schulterlanges Haar, was da gern verwuschelt ist und bei sämtlichen normalen Bürsten schon auch sehr ziept und Haare mit entfernt - das Haare mit Herausgerissen werden beim Kämmen ist für mich das Schlimmste, denn ich habe recht dünn strukturiertes Haar.
Diese Bürste hier ist sehr leicht, liegt sehr gut in der Hand und es macht wirklich Spaß damit Haar im nassen sowie trockenem Zustand zu bürsten.
Bestes Beispiel für die gute Funktionalität ist, dass meine kleine Enkeltochter mit langem und kräftigerem Haar (5 3/4 Jahre) auch schon ihre Probleme mit dem Haar hat. Es ist bei ihr schon durch Sport, Spiel, Toben, Badengehen und anderen vielen Aktivitäten oft struppig, verwuschelt und das Kämmen gefällt ihr überhaupt nicht, ganz einfach: weil es ziept! Und bei mir gab es schon mit der alten Bürste dieser Art überhaupt keine Probleme, sie ließ sich früh gut und ohne Tränen kämmen und griff am Tag sogar selbst zu meiner guten Bürste. Da ich 2 Stck. damals gekauft habe, im Handel diese noch nicht zum Kauf angeboten wurde (soweit ich das mitbekommen habe) hatte ich ihr bei einem Besuch bei uns so eine leichte Haarbürste mitgegeben und diese hat sie heute noch und wird sogar von der Mama mit genutzt.
Angenehm überrascht hat mich der Preis, ich finde ihn doch recht günstig, bei dem was ich im Fachgeschäft vor 3 Jahren bezahlt habe.
Und sehr gut kam meine Haarbürste verpackt in einem stabilen Karton (nur für die Bürste scheinbar gemacht) , was schon einen guten Eindruck vermittelt.
Ich empfehle diese tolle und funktionale Haarbürste allen, die problemlos und ohne Ziepen ihre Haare durchbürsten, dabei Zeit sparen und auch selbst bei nassem Haar keine Probleme haben wollen, bis sie das Kopfhaar wieder richtig in Form gebracht haben.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Good grip and dexterity, very uncomfortable seams
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: I got these primarily for driving, and touchscreen functionality was an appreciated bonus. I wore these through most of the summer so can't attest to whether these are 'warm enough' for colder climates, but I can say these aren't 'too warm' either. I will say the stitching killed the comfort for me - I've worn MTB and winter gloves before, but the stitching in these was so noticeable inside of the glove, that I ended up grabbing a pair of scissors and removing most of the excess material. I did end up busting one of the finger seams slightly, which to be clear isn't the fault of the glove; but I can immediately tell the comfort is much greater without the extra material, and it's much easier to type with the gloves on now. I'll know what to look for when buying my next pair, but it won't be these.. still, I don't regret this purchase.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Elegant Design, Practical Use – A Solid Bedside Upgrade!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This bedside carafe is both functional and aesthetically pleasing. It’s one of those items that I didn’t know I needed until I started using it. The design is sleek and minimalist, so it looks great on my nightstand, adding a bit of sophistication to the bedroom. It’s not just for looks though—it works incredibly well for keeping water handy at night, and the integrated tumbler that acts as a lid is a smart touch.

One thing that stood out is the handblown glass. It feels sturdy but has a refined, artisanal quality that you just don’t get from mass-produced glassware. The wide opening makes it easy to fill, and the pour is smooth, with no awkward spills. I appreciate the thought put into the base, which feels solid and stable, ensuring it doesn’t tip easily.

In terms of size, it’s bigger than I initially expected; enough to last through the night without needing a refill. Some may find that a bit large for a bedside carafe, but for me, it’s just right, especially since I’m one to wake up thirsty. The glass tumbler that doubles as a lid keeps dust out, and I like that it fits nicely over the top.

All in all, this carafe checks both the form and function boxes. It’s a great addition to my nighttime routine, and I’d highly recommend it if you’re looking to add a touch of elegance to your bedside or even as a thoughtful gift. It’s easy to clean, looks fantastic, and has a level of craftsmanship that makes it feel like more than just a water pitcher.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Chic, Practical, and a Total Game-Changer – My New Favorite Must-Have Bedside Essential!!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This bedside carafe set has become one of those items that I didn’t realize I needed until I got it, and now I can’t imagine life without it! It’s been a total game-changer, and I honestly find myself asking, “Why didn’t I buy this sooner?!”

The first thing that caught my eye was how incredibly chic this set looks. The shade of green is absolutely perfect, adding a subtle yet stylish pop to my nightstand, and surprisingly, it has elevated the entire look of my bedroom setup. What’s even better is how practical it is, proving that you can have both form and function with this piece.

I purposely waited a couple of weeks to write this review because, sometimes, after the initial excitement fades, I notice things I don’t like about a product. But after using this for a solid two weeks, I’m still in love and use it every night without fail. In fact, it’s become a central part of my nightly routine.

My new nightly routine revolves around this carafe set—I fill it up, make sure it’s clean, and place it by my bed. It’s such a comforting feeling to know I have water readily available throughout the night. I wake up often, and this has been a lifesaver, making it easier to stay hydrated without having to get out of bed. It's also perfect for when I take my morning and nighttime medications. The size is just right—I don’t find myself needing to refill it frequently as it holds enough to get me through until morning.

One of the features that really sold me on this carafe was the thoughtful design of the cup fitting snugly over the carafe, protecting the water from dust or anything else that might float into it overnight. It’s a small but crucial detail that adds to the overall practicality of the set. The opening of the carafe is wide enough to fit large chunks of ice into it as well, helping to keep your water colder for longer periods throughout the night.

Another big bonus? The price! This set is super affordable, especially considering the quality and style it offers. I think it would make an amazing housewarming gift—perfect for anyone moving into a new home or apartment. Honestly, if someone gifted this to me, I’d be thrilled!

To top it all off, I find myself drinking way more water than I used to, and it’s made my life so much easier. This is easily one of my favorite purchases this year. If they ever offer this set in more modern colors, I’d jump at the chance to buy another one—just so I have a backup when this one’s in the dishwasher. It’s that good!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Looks great on the wall and holds light magnetic material well
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Looks great in the wall.

Die kwmobile Schutzhülle für das Xiaomi 11T / 11T Pro hat mich auf ganzer Linie überzeugt. Dieses Case bietet nicht nur exzellenten Schutz, sondern ist auch perfekt auf das Smartphone abgestimmt. Für jeden, der eine robuste und langlebige Hülle sucht, ist dieses Produkt eine klare Empfehlung.

Passgenauigkeit und Komfort: Perfekter Sitz ohne Kompromisse

Die Hülle passt sich dank ihres flexiblen und elastischen TPU-Silikons optimal an das Smartphone an. Die biegsamen Seiten sorgen dafür, dass die Hülle leicht anzubringen ist und das Gerät dennoch fest umschließt. Besonders hervorzuheben ist das weiche Mikrofaserfutter auf der Innenseite, das zusätzlichen Schutz vor Kratzern bietet. Mit der rutschfesten Gummierung außen liegt das Smartphone sicher in der Hand, was gerade im Alltag von Vorteil ist.

Design und Haptik: Schlank, leicht und stilvoll

Obwohl die Hülle sehr schlank ist, bietet sie hervorragenden Schutz, ohne das Smartphone unnötig dick erscheinen zu lassen. Für diejenigen, die Wert auf ein elegantes und minimalistisches Design legen, ist diese Hülle ideal. Sie trägt kaum auf und behält das schlanke Profil des Xiaomi 11T / 11T Pro bei.

Praktikabilität: Alle Funktionen weiterhin uneingeschränkt nutzbar
Trotz des umfassenden Schutzes bleibt die Bedienbarkeit des Smartphones vollständig erhalten. Alle Knöpfe und Anschlüsse sind leicht zugänglich, ohne dass man die Hülle abnehmen muss. Das macht die Handhabung im Alltag besonders angenehm und unkompliziert.

Qualität und Haltbarkeit: Ein langlebiges Produkt

Was mich besonders überzeugt, ist die Langlebigkeit dieser Schutzhülle. Sie bleibt auch nach längerer Nutzung wie neu – weder Abnutzungsspuren noch Farbveränderungen. In einer Zeit, in der viele Produkte schnell ersetzt werden müssen, hebt sich diese Hülle klar ab. Sie bietet langfristig Schutz und sieht auch nach Monaten noch aus wie am ersten Tag.

Fazit: Hochwertige Schutzhülle zum fairen Preis
Insgesamt bin ich begeistert von diesem Produkt und empfehle es jedem, der eine hochwertige, langlebige und stylische Schutzhülle für sein Xiaomi 11T / 11T Pro sucht. kwmobile hat hier erneut ein Produkt geschaffen, das Qualität und Praktikabilität vereint.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Amazing how much they ruin the airpods
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I bought these replacement cushions after my original Apple ones fell apart from being washed one too many times. Since the official replacements are about £75, I decided to try these cheaper alternatives. Unfortunately, they have put me off aftermarket options for the AirPods Max altogether.

While they are comfortable enough to wear, the plasticky material makes them feel sweaty after a while. The biggest problem, however, is the negative impact on sound quality. Even with noise cancellation on and no music playing, there was an odd "inside a seashell" effect. When I did play music, the sound quality was noticeably worse.

For premium headphones like the AirPods Max, cheap aftermarket parts just don’t cut it. I ended up purchasing genuine Apple cushions, and the sound quality is back to normal. From now on, I’ll be using wipes or Febreze to keep them clean rather than risking another poor replacement.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Great storage boxes but no that great at being drawers ....
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This shelving unit is made of metal comes flattened in the box but once taken out set up, it offers plenty of room for an array of items.
It comes with 3 metal mesh draws, each measuring about 200mm tall, 400mm long and 300mm wide, which sit on top of each other, sliding into the grooves of the draw beneath it.
Putting them together, sort of, is a breeze. Just take them from the box and pull out the sides, rear and front, with the front and back clicking into the sides making them quite sturdy for what they are for. The front is a quarter of the height of the sides and rear which makes it easier to get things from the boxes which are beneath other boxes. Each one made well and strong enough to do what they are designed for.
Once set up they stack on each other with the upper box sliding on the grooves on the box beneath it.
Sadly, when you stack more than two they don’t slide on as they’re supposed to as when you slide one out the ones above it come out with it. The only one which slides out with ease is the one at the very top.
They can be used for many things when it comes to storage, bedroom, bathroom, bedroom, helping store almost anything. Personally, I have 2 I use for vegetable and a single one in the food cupboard. They have neatened up the area where I have them.
In all, these are a fine idea for people whose space in the home is a limited. They help store things in a neat, shelving system whilst giving easy access to each of the drawers.
The only downside is the one I’ve mentioned, where the drawers above the one you pull out with come out with it. Or end up falling off the sliding grooves at the back.
Are they worth the £29.99?
Yes. Even though they don’t slide as well as you’d like them to do put they offer easy access to what ever is inside due to the lower section at the front. There’s little need to slide any of the drawers out.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Purchased to replace stock filing cabinet wheels that were scratching hardwood flooring
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
The stock wheels on my heavy filing cabinet were putting scratches in my hardwood flooring while it was empty and I quickly saw this would be a bigger problem once loaded with files and supplies.

At first I put down an area rug but still wanted to move the filing cabinet freely around the office as needed so I decided replace the wheels entirely. (I had bought some replacement roller blade wheels for my chair and wanted the same freedom of movement)

The spacing for the mounting brackets had a wider footprint than the stock wheels but we're pretty much the same height. (Comparison photo included to show installed wheels vs original stock). This required for me to use the included larger screws to securely attach them. (Pilot holes are your friend here.) The included screws were also a little deeper than the wood and stick up through the wood ~1/8th of an inch, though the drawers hide this and it doesn't interfere with drawer function.

The front wheels come with brakes that allow you to lock it in place by pressing down on the lever or release the brake by pulling up. (There is a cog like guide that keeps the wheel from rotating side to side when the brake is applied).

Wheels feel sturdy and work great, allowing me to move the filing cabinet around the office with ease without the need of an area rug to protect my floors.

Il resto è in plastica molto compatta e resistente, aumenta il peso della chiama ed anche le dimensioni.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Look legit but no documentation of independent testing results is included
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:

These carabiners provide a large load capacity if the labelling is legit and yet are rather lightweight. I must add a caveat that I am not a climber, but for gym equipment use or for holding up furniture and other objects; to me these appear to be more than capable. They are labelled to show they meet particular standards but I don't have means to verify their legitimacy and integrity. I have not looked into what these standards state. Climbers are more likely going to be aware of them.

I had not closely looked at all the product listing prior to ordering, and expected the nylon loop ropes to both be of the same length. One is considerably longer than the other. I can make good use of these in various scenarios. Being supposedly rated to 23kN means they far exceed by multiple times what stress I am likely to subject them to during gym and home workouts. The carabiners are rated higher at 25kN.

Priced at £19.49 at the time of composing this review; seems very reasonable and great value for money to me, due to the loads the items can potentially withstand and the build quality of them appears to be very good.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Bellissima la penna e buono l'inchiostro fornito, ma le punte fornite sono troppo rigide.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Questo kit per calligrafia con piuma è un regalo esteticamente molto carino e raffinato, perfetto per chi ama la scrittura e desidera aggiungere un tocco decorativo alla propria scrivania. Tuttavia, dal punto di vista pratico, ho riscontrato qualche limite nell'uso delle varie punte.

Dal punto di vista estetico, la penna con piuma è davvero ben fatta, con decorazioni eleganti sul manico che la rendono un pezzo perfetto da esporre sulla propria scrivania. Anche la base d’appoggio è decorata, aggiungendo un tocco di classe e funzionalità per riporre la penna. Il kit viene fornito con un calamaio di inchiostro nero, la cui qualità devo ammettere essere molto buona e ideale per scrivere senza sbavature.
Aggiungo però che il colore della piuma non è blu come riportato nel titolo, ma si tratta di un verde ottanio.

Il mio principale problema riguarda i 5 pennini inclusi nel set. Le punte sono infatti molto rigide, il che rende difficile modulare la pressione per ottenere linee di spessore diverso. Per chi è abituato a strumenti di calligrafia più flessibili, potrebbe risultare limitante in quanto non permette di esprimere appieno la varietà tipica del lettering artistico e pertanto solo la punta con tratto più sottile risulta piacevole da usare nella scrittura.

In definitiva, questo kit per calligrafia è un’ottima scelta come regalo decorativo grazie alla sua bellezza e ai dettagli curati. Tuttavia, per chi cerca uno strumento più pratico per la calligrafia, le punte rigide potrebbero essere un limite. Ottimo da esporre, ma meno funzionale per chi desidera lavorare con una gamma di spessori nel tratto.

Ich habe mir diesen Kaffeebehälter aufgrund seines schlichten und modernen Designs in Weiß gekauft, das perfekt in meine Kaffee-Ecke passt. Besonders begeistert bin ich vom **CO2-Ventil**, das bei frischen Röstungen das entstehende CO2 entweichen lässt, aber keine Luft in den Behälter hineinlässt. Das ist ein riesiger Vorteil, vor allem bei Kaffeebohnen, die erst vor wenigen Wochen geröstet wurden – solche Bohnen habe ich häufig und lege großen Wert auf ihre Frische.

Falls man industriell verarbeiteten Filterkaffee oder andere Dinge wie Gewürze in der Dose lagern möchte, kann man das Ventil einfach durch einen Gummistopfen ersetzen. Das ist eine clevere Lösung!

Die **Datumsanzeige** am Deckel ist ebenfalls sehr praktisch, um die Frische im Blick zu behalten. In den Behälter passen ca. 650g Kaffeebohnen, was für mich absolut ausreichend ist. Die Angabe von 1,4 Litern verwirrt etwas, da ich dachte, es würde mehr hineinpassen, aber das ist kein großes Manko.

Ein Kaffeelöffel ist auch dabei, was nett ist, aber davon habe ich schon mehr als genug in der Schublade.
Kleines Manko ist das das Weiß vom Deckel nicht das gleiche ist wie vom Behälter. Insgesamt ist der Kaffeebehälter ein sehr praktisches Produkt mit einem durchdachten CO2-System, und auch der Preis ist absolut fair. **Klare 5 Sterne!**

These square plant pot feet, or raisers are quite substantial and i'd say best suited for pots over 4 inches diameter.

So far i've only used them on indoor plants and thus far i'm questioning myself as to whether they are plant pot or pot holder feet. They certainly work fine on pot holders where the potted plant itself is inserted and disguised and no water drains through - so great to stand on wooden surfaces such as side tables without any risk of water rings on furniture, or surface scratches.

With some of the larger pot holders, rather than sticking these feet on individually around the base i've joined some of the squares to make a plus (+) shape by trimming some of the extra sticky tabs to join the sides together. That has worked well.

For outdoors i've a number of quite large potted plants to test these feet on. It's been too wet to do this yet, and whilst I suspect the feet should stick to each pot base quite well (if arranged carefully and not too close to drainage holes) i'm wondering how well they'll do after a winter period that is likely to be very damp at times. Time will tell I guess, but overall these pot feet look very promising.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Well made, but could be improved upon.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
🔹INTRO & DESCRIPTION🔹

I chose this storage box by Belle Vous in the hope that I would be able to get my paperwork organised rather than having it in various different piles around the house.

It arrives flat packed, and once assembled it measures 31 cms wide and 37 cms long. It is 25 cms high. Assembly is simple – very similar to the cube type storage system whereby it simply unfolds and has a stiffened cardboard piece which slides into the base. The description says that it has "metal carry handles”, which implies more than one. However, it does only have one handle. The lid flips over and secures with Velcro.

🔹OPINION🔹&🔹CONCLUSION🔹

The box itself looks attractive, and I quite like the neutral light brown/beige colour with the darker edging and interior. It has a space on the front for writing a label on a piece of card, and slotting it into the holder. It would have been nice to have the blank label included ready for writing on, but that's a fairly minor point.

The Velcro secures the lid quite well, but the sides of the lid do not overlap the base, so this could allow dust etc inside the box.

It is a well made box, and the fabric covering has a canvas texture to it. All the seams and stitching are neat.

I am not sure why there is just one handle on the front. If storing papers, they can become quite heavy, so it would be more useful to even out the weight by having two handles. I assume the one handle is to facilitate it being stored on a shelf thus making it easier to pull forward and off the shelf with a hand supporting it underneath.

I have just had my garage insulated, so I will use it for storing items on my new shelves. I will probably use it for out of season shoes or maybe Christmas decorations. For me personally, after seeing it, I do not think it is the best solution for paperwork, and I will probably invest in a filing cabinet for this purpose.
I like it. Convenient, practical and functional. Looks and feels well made.
