CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Superb set of 6 high quality ceramic plant pots and trays with alternative uses too.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Firstly I have to say that I'm not often really impressed with every aspect of my online orders, but I am in this case. I am unable to find anything negative to say about these, it's positives all the way.

This beautiful and very well made set of ceramic plant pots are very high quality all-round. The packaging is really protective, so these would be ideal to send as a gift. Each ceramic pot is perfect, no glazing faults, no misaligned printing, they are not blemished in any way. The patterns are finely detailed. You'll see some light reflecting from the pots in my photographs, that's just bright camera flash and spotlight reflections, not imperfections.

The bamboo trays are very high quality as well. Most importantly, the pots have drainage holes, so you can fully water your miniature plants letting the water run through. Then you can place them back on their trays when the water has stopped draining, so you know the surface you're standing your pot on is protected from moisture damage. Plus the pots look really nice standing on the trays. The main benefit of the holes is your plants are not sitting in water, like other plant pots that don't have holes.

I've put one of my baby plants inside one of these pots to give you an idea of how they can look with plants. They are perfect for miniature succulents or growing on your plant cuttings.

I have another idea for use, as pen, pencil or artist brush holders on my desk. I'm actually torn between using these for my miniature plants or using them for my craft supplies on my desk........ I might split them between the two uses. Although they do look really lovely displayed as a set of six.

I recommend these, you might want to buy two sets if you plan to give these away as gifts, because you could end up wanting a set for yourself when you see them.

Der Foldable Step Stool with Handle kommt in einem Karton beim Käufer an.

Der Artikel muss vor Benutzung noch endmontiert werden. Dazu liegen 3 Schrauben (2 benötigte, 1 Ersatz) und eine Bedienungsanleitung die die kleine Montage beschreibt.

DIe 3 Schrauben werden dazu vewendet den Kunststoffgriff am Tritt zu montieren. Das geht recht einfach, wenngliech die Schrauben etwas schwer einzudrehen sind.

Für die Benutzung der Erhöhung, müssen sie unteren Standfüße asugeklappt und verriegelt werden. Zusätzlich lässt sich auch noch die Länge des Haltegriffs arretieren.

Die Verarbeitungsqualität im allgemeinen ist recht gut, das Metall wirkt Stabil und der Kunstostoff in Ordnung.

Nun klingt ja alles gut, nicht wahr? Leider nicht ganz. Mir fehlt hier einfach etwas der Anwendungsfall. Warum? Nunja, im voll ausgeklappten Zustand, erhält man hier maximal 10cm zusätzliche Höhe. Das ist am Ende derart wenig, das dies wohl den wenigsten Menschen eine wirkliche Erleichterung bietet. Ich meine klar, wenn einem nur 5cm fehlen zum Geschirrschrank oder ähnlichem, ist das Ding Trumpf. Aber in diesem Grenzfalle und auch nur in diesem.

Der Preis ist mit etwa 29€ denke ich in Ordnung. Aufgrund des fragwürdigen Anwendungsfalles reicht das für mich aber nur zu 3 Sternen.

Bisher hatte ich nur starre Gartenschläuche. Diesen kleinen, sich selbst entrollenden und zusammenziehenden Schläuchen hatte ich nicht viel zugetraut. Umso erstaunter bin ich nun. Der Schlacuh ist leicht, lässt sich gut zusammenrollen und zeigt trotzdem eine gute Stabilität. Der Anschluß passt sofort an meinen Standardanschluß im Garten, zur Not ist auch noch ein Adapter dabei. Der Schlauch ist recht kurz, wird maximal 7,5 m lang. Damit ist er nur für kleine Gärten oder Balkone geeignet. Ich nutze ihn dann für die Terasse. Der Vorteil gegenüber dem bisherigen Schlauch ist die Beweglichkeit. Den großen Schöauch jedes Mal aus- und aufzurollen ist ein recht große Aufwand. Da ist der flexible Schlauch deutlich praktischer. Die kleine Spritzpistole, die mitgeliefert wird, ist erstaunlich vielseitig. 7 verschiedene Einstellungen und ein kleiner Metallbügel, der auf Dauerbetrieb schaltet, bieten für jeden Bedarf den richtigen Strahl. Ich bin über das Set echt erstaunt. Wer mit so einem Schlauch einen gößeren Garten bewirtschaften will, sollte allerdings auf ein längeres Modell zurückgreifen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Per chi vuole la sedia immobile!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Gioco al pc con un simulatore di guida ed utilizzo una pedaliera che poggia sul muro davanti oltre che una sedia classica da scrivania con le ruote che però, a quasi ogni mia azione sulla pedaliera, si spostava, rendendo la guida difficoltosa.
Ho così optato per queste ruote nella speranza di risolvere il mio problema.

Le ruote arrivato dentro una scatola, una ad una dentro delle bustine mille bolle per proteggerle.

Il montaggio è semplicissimo, in 3 minuti tutte e 5 le ruote erano posizionate nella base della sedia.

Da subito si nota una qualità non trascurata, oltre che una bella estetica.
Le ruote si muovono sul pavimento in maniera molto silenziosa essendo praticamente fatte di gomma.
Ho un pavimento in cotto antico e questa è una qualità non da poco!
La cosa che più mi ha sorpreso però, una volta attivato il blocco in tutte e 5 le ruote, è l’incredibile tenuta che hanno.
La sedia non si muove di un millimetro e nonostante i miei movimenti e la forza che applico sulla pedaliera, la sedia rimane perfettamente ferma.
La perfezione, nient’altro da aggiungere.
Ottimo prodotto e spedizione velocissima

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Polierpastenset mit kleineren Polierblöcken. Gut für gelegentlichen Gebrauch.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Das Polierpastenset an sich ist gut und umfasst 5 verschiedene Körnungen. Der scheinbar günstige Preis von etwas über 10 Euro wird dadurch erkauft, dass die einzelnen Blöcke jeweils nur knapp 70g schwer sind. Macht in Summe 350g. Beim Preisvergleich mit anderen Sets oder Blöcken sollte man daher unbedingt auch das Gewicht beachten.
Die Polierpasten kommen wie üblich als feste Blöcke. Der Auftrag erfolgt unter Bewegung auf den Streichriemen oder auf die Schleifscheibe, die Reibungswärme lässt die wachsartige Substanz schmelzen. Wichtig: Einmal aufgetragen, lässt sich das Polierpad oder Streichriemen nicht mehr für feinere Polierpasten nutzen.

Während ich qualitativ an den Polierblöcken nichts auszusetzen habe, ziehe ich einen Stern ab, da keinerlei Produktbeschreibung mitgeliefert wird. Die Polierblöcke sind nicht nach Körnung sortiert und enthalten keinerlei Beschriftung der Körnungsgrade. Lediglich aus der Produktbeschreibung hier auf Amazon kann man diese Informationen entnehmen. Daher empfiehlt es sich, einen Zettel mit den Körnungsgraden zu notieren und dem Produkt beizulegen. Auch die Lieferung aller Blöcke zusammen in einem ZIP-Beutel könnte optimiert werden. Ich werde die Pasten mit etwas Folie umhüllen, markieren und in einer kleinen Box lagern.

Il prodotto consiste in due piccole piastre di materiale che dovrebbe essere andiaderente, con ai lati delle maniglie in silicone per maneggiarle e fissarle una sull’altra. Arriva in una scatola di cartone a misura e non sono presenti istruzioni, per cui bisogna fare riferimento alla presentazione presente su Amazon.

In ogni modo l’utilizzo è intuitivo in quanto una volta posizionato il piatto da cucinare tra le due lastre, si introduce il tutto nel microonde selezionando qualche minuto di cottura.

Allora, io ho fatto qualche tentativo con toast e zucchine, che appunto volevo fare grigliate.

Le zucchine non si sono minimamente grigliate e sembravano lesse. Forse avrei dovuto cuocerle di più, ma erano fettine sottili e forse si sarebbero bruciate dentro le piastre, non essendoci indicazioni di utilizzo con tempi di cottura per i vari tipi di pietanza.

I toast la prima volta non si sono grigliati per niente. Quindi ho provato a settare due minuti, poi ho girato le piastre e ho messo altri due minuti. Al termine dei quattro minuti, i toast risultavano completamente attaccati alla piastra “antiaderente”: sollevando la piastra rimaneva attaccato anche il pane. Quindi ho provato a ungere sia i toast sia le piastre con un po’ d’olio, ma hanno continuato ad attaccarsi. I toast in sé erano decenti, anche se non erano toast ma semplicemente sandwich con fette di pan carré abbrustolite. Ma per riuscire a separarli dalle piastre (ho fatto con attenzione, e non è stato nemmeno possibile staccarli del tutto), le piastre stesse si sono subito rigate. Il che significa che lo strato antiaderente non solo non è antiaderente, ma è sottilissimo e non può durare.

Aggiungo che uso abitualmente una tostiera elettrica che avrà almeno trent’anni di perfetto servizio, che fa dei toast eccezionali e che non ha mai attaccato alcunché, naturalmente senza mai aver dovuto ungere le piastre. Altre due piastre elettriche che possiedo funzionano benissimo, sono realmente antiaderenti e si puliscono in un attimo.

Questo per dire che, dato il anche il prezzo esagerato (oggi 27 euro) e dato il prezzo analogo e persino inferiore di una normale tostiera o di un grill elettrico, dove tra l’altro non bisogna girare le piastre durante la cottura e non si rischia di scottarsi nel maneggiarle, non si capisce perché dannarsi l’anima con un oggetto che non produce lo stesso risultato, con cui è probabile scottarsi, che attacca molto (a meno forse di ungere tutto con un bel po’ di olio), che è difficile da lavare e si riga subito.

Data l'esperienza di utilizzo e il prezzo assolutamente non competitivo, purtroppo non posso dare più di una stella.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Perfettamente Aderente, Leggera e con un Ottimo Grip. Una Cover Bella e Performante
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
DESCRIZIONE
Arriva in una confezione brandizzata in plastica questa cover per OnePlus 6T.
E' realizzata in TPU ed ha un peso di 33 grammi. Internamente ha un leggero rivestimento più morbido in microfibra che ne forma il primo strato, mentre quello centrale è in policarbonato ed all'esterno è in gomma siliconica. Posteriormente sporge dal comparto fotografico di circa 1,3 mm.

ESPERIENZA D'USO
L'ho presa per cambiare la cover dello smartphone di mia madre ormai consumata.
E' molto leggera ed aderisce perfettamente allo smartphone, non risultando allo stesso tempo troppo spessa.
Nonostante la superfice liscia, il grip è perfetto grazie allo strato esterno in silicone che ne aumenta la presa.
Perfetta la protezione degli angoli che risultano ben coperti, mentre i fori sono lasciati tutti liberi per le loro funzioni.
I tasti vengono sovrapposti perfettamente dalle coperture specifiche in quelle aree, per cui le funzioni non sono minimamente alterate.
Molto bello il colore che ho scelto “petrolio matt”, è una tonalità giovanile ma con un certo stile, e comunque l'offerta di colori è molto ampia, essendone disponibili altre 19 tonalità.
Il prezzo attuale di € 9,69 a mio modo di vedere conferisce a questa cover un ottimo rapporto qualità/prezzo.

SINTESI
Di seguito i miei pro e contro:

PRO
- molto leggera;
- ottima adesione allo smartphone;
- ottima qualità del materiale;
- ottimo grip;
- ottima protezione degli angoli;
- ottimo rapporto qualità/prezzo.

CONTRO
- nessuno rilevato ad oggi.

CONCLUSIONI
E' realizzata molto bene e sono rimasto pienamente soddisfatto della sua qualità costruttiva, della protezione che offre e del feeling che dà tenendola in mano. A questo prezzo fare di meglio mi sembra molto difficile. Il mio voto finale: 5 stelle!
Va bene per l'uso richiesto.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Leggera, Avvolgente e con un Buon Grip. Molto Bello ed Originale il Design
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
DESCRIZIONE
Cover per Oneplus 11 in TPU e legno che arriva in una confezione brandizzata e curata. Ha un peso di 33 grammi con un bordo di 1,2 cm. La parte posteriore è rivestita in legno e stilizzata con una bussola intagliata sulla superficie, mentre l'area circolare del comparto fotografico è protetto da rivestimento in TPU che lascia libere solo le singole zone circolari delle lenti e del flash.

ESPERIENZA D'USO
Rispetto alla sua dimensione complessiva e a quella dei bordi abbastanza pronunciati è veramente leggera, ma quello che spicca sin da subito è il connubio tra plastica e legno che è gradevole al tatto ed esteticamente molto ben riuscito. A giudicare proprio dalla leggerezza, non mi sembra un legno particolarmente resistente o pregiato ma riesce comunque ad avere la giusta consistenza per offrire un'adeguata protezione allo smartphone, anche perché la sua funzione è quella di rivestimento esterno, mentre all'interno c'è sempre la base in TPU che fa il suo lavoro.
L' aderenza di questa cover alle linee dello smartphone è perfetta, lasciando il giusto spazio a tasti, alla porta di connessione e ricarica e a tutti i fori. Allo stesso tempo riesce a proteggere molto bene il reparto fotografico posteriore di cui lascia liberi solo le zone circolari di lenti e flash.
Il grip è buono, non lo ritengo scivoloso seppur ha bordi lisci ed anche la parte il legno posteriore sembra essere molto liscia al tatto, fatta eccezione per l'area intagliata.
L'unica cosa che un po' mi insinua dei dubbi è la sua durata e questo per il semplice motivo che il legno assorbe umidità, ma per questo sarà necessario attendere del tempo.
Il prezzo attuale di € 14,99 mi sembra ben centrato rispetto alla sua qualità complessiva ed alla sua estetica originale.

SINTESI
Di seguito i miei pro e contro:

PRO
- molto leggera;
- ottima adesione alla linea dello smartphone;
- buona qualità del materiale;
- buon grip;
- non trattiene le impronte;
- estetica originale;

CONTRO
- nessuno rilevato ad oggi.

CONCLUSIONI
E' un'ottima cover che ben collega l'esigenza di una giusta protezione dello smartphone ad un estetica originale che nasce dal connubio di 2 materiali profondamente diversi come plastica e legno. La consiglio. Il mio voto finale: 5 stelle!

Auf dem Glassockel wurde sie sonnengeschützt in einer Vitrine untergebracht, um sie beim Fotografieren vor dem wegrollen zu schützen, benutze ich meist einen Schlüsselring. Die Kugel ist kristallklar, und frei von Einschlüssen. Für schöne Bilder ist das wichtig. Zunächst experimentierte ich mit einer Kugel aus einem Dekohänger. Die hatte Einschlüsse aus Luft, was jeden schönen Effekt zerstörte.
Für wirklich schöne Fotos, empfehle ich, entweder im manuellen Modus zu knipsen, oder wenigstens in der Halbautomatik mit manueller Blendeneinstellung, um die Kugel entweder willentlich einzubinden, oder als Objekt hervorzuheben. Und üben, üben, üben. Es macht wirklich Spaß, damit zu experimentieren, und ich wählte eine Größe, die tatsächlich noch in die Fototasche passt.
Wichtig: Solche Kugeln wirken mitunter wie ein Brennglas. Entsprechend sollten sie weder im Fenster gelagert, noch unbeaufsichtigt irgendwo abgelegt werden, es besteht Brandgefahr.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Trasparenti personalizzazioni, ma con qualche elemento che lascia a desiderare.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Tavoletta portablocco formato A4 con clip, adatta ovviamente anche a fogli sfusi, sufficientemente rigida nel fornire una stabile base di appoggio per prendere appunti anche stando in piedi, dotata anche di un gancetto metallico retraibile, utile per un fissaggio a una parete.
In quest’ultimo caso, tanto per indicare un esempio tra i tanti possibili, la tavoletta può trattenere i fogli su cui il personale, incluso in un turno di lavoro, conferma la propria presenza ed il servizio svolto, apponendo una firma.
Oltre alla presenza di tale gancio, ciò che caratterizza tale tavoletta, è la sua trasparenza, che ben si presta ad una facile personalizzazione del supporto, con un logo o un motto della propria azienda, o un condensato pensiero, indicante sinteticamente il nostro modo di stare al mondo, ed un righello, inciso nella superficie laterale.
Purtroppo tutte queste allettanti caratteristiche sono in parte vanificate da un aspetto che dovrebbe ricevere la giusta attenzione: il bordo superiore della tavoletta, soprastante la clip, risulta essere abbastanza tagliente, come del resto lo stesso gancio metallico retrattile.
La condizione di potenziale pericolosità è legata soprattutto all’utilizzo della tavoletta nel prendere appunti, quindi tenendola in mano, poiché per rimuovere o inserire i fogli, nell’aprire la clip, si tende ad appoggiare le dita, per fare leva, sulla superficie superiore.
La potenziale capacità di tagliare, si riduce fortemente con il fissaggio verticale della tavoletta precedentemente descritto, poiché in tale condizione, il bordo superiore della tavoletta difficilmente viene interessato dalle operazioni di spostamento di fogli o blocchi.
A mio modo di vedere, questo aspetto influenza, purtroppo, negativamente il giudizio di un prodotto, altrimenti validissimo.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Great Addition to My Kettlebell Workouts
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: I'm 62. I do 5 kettlebell workouts a week. I've been a weightlifter since I was 12, so I have a lot of experience. My intention for the wedge block was to add variety to my kettlebell workouts for goblet squats, off-set kettlebell squats (hold a KB by my right shoulder and doing some reps before alternating to the next shoulder) and doing conventional and Roman deadlifts. The wedge puts different stress on my quads and glutes, which I like. Because you will have a tendency to bend forward, you will want to practice keeping your back straight to avoid injury. Therefore, I recommend you use a lighter weight than you normally would. I was concerned that training barefoot, my preference, would hurt my toes with this wedge, but by planting my feet high on the wedge so that my toes barely touch the flat surface, I feel no discomfort. This is a well-built wedge block. Recommended.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Stabil und sicher, könnte aber etwas höher sein
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Der Hocker ist in einem stabilen Karton nach kurzer Lieferzeit angekommen. Bis auf den Griff an der Tragestange ist alles fertig montiert. Dieser muß nur mit den beiliegenden Schrauben mit der Griffstange verschraubt werden. Es wird eine Montageanleitung auf deutsch mitgeliefert, die man aber zum Aufbau nicht benötigt. Jeder der vier Füße wird mit einem Druck auf den Verriegelungsstift entriegelt und kann dann leicht ausgeklappt werden. Die Tragestange wird durch einen Schnallenmechanismus entriegelt und kann dann hochgeklappt werden. Die Tragestange ist (vom Boden aus gemessen) im hochgeklappten Zustand 60 cm hoch und muß zum Tragen des Hockers auf die Länge von 82 cm ausgezogen werden, wo diese dann auch einrastet. Der Tritthocker ist in 30 Sekunden ausgeklappt und einsatzbereit. Alle Füße stehen nach schräg außen. So kann man auch etwas an der Kante stehen, ohne dass der Tritthocker umkippen kann. Der Hocker ist für seine Größe entsprechend schwer und deshalb auch sehr stabil. Auch die Gelenke der Füße und die Tragestange machen einen sehr soliden Eindruck. Die Trittfläche des Hockers ist 37,5cm x 26cm groß. Die Tragestange ist ausgezogen 82cm hoch. Die Trittfläche ist mit einer Höhe von 17cm über dem Erdboden in meinen Augen etwas zu gering. In der Praxis könnte die gerne 10 bis 15cm höher sein. Aber vielleicht schreibt eine DIN dafür dann eine extra Stufe vor, die man sich hier erspart hat. Der Tritthocker ist stabil verarbeitet und kann schnell benutzt werden. Dadurch, dass er in 30 Sekunden auseinander und wieder zusammengeklappt werden kann, kann er bei Nichtgebrauch überall leicht verstaut werden. Wenn der Tritthocker etwas höher wäre, würde ich gerne 5 Sterne vergeben. So hat es leider nur zu vier Sternen gereicht. Wem die Trittflächenhöhe von 17 cm aber ausreicht, der hat damit aber eine ideale Alternative zu einer Stehleiter oder womöglich zu einer leeren Getränkekiste.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Il kit è un ottimo set per chi, come noi, vuole iniziare a sperimentare con l'infeltrimento ad ago.
Include 24 colori di lana infeltrita da 5 g ciascuno, un set di aghi per feltro di dimensioni diverse, un tappetino per feltro e una guida per principianti.
La lana è di alta qualità e morbida al tatto. La lana cardata è una lana che è stata lavorata a maglia o a uncinetto e poi tagliata a pezzi. È perfetta per l'infeltrimento ad ago, in quanto si infeltrisce rapidamente e facilmente.
I colori sono vivaci e vibranti e si prestano a una varietà di progetti.
Gli aghi per feltro sono ben realizzati e hanno impugnature comode che facilitano il lavoro. Gli aghi per feltro inclusi nel kit sono disponibili in tre dimensioni: 4, 3 e 2. I numeri più alti producono un feltro più denso, mentre i numeri più bassi producono un feltro più morbido.
Il tappetino per feltro è resistente e aiuta a proteggere i mobili. La guida per principianti fornisce istruzioni passo passo per iniziare a creare con l'infeltrimento ad ago.
Il contenitore incluso è un modo conveniente per riporre tutti i materiali. È dotato di divisori per mantenere i colori organizzati e ha un coperchio trasparente in modo da poter vedere facilmente cosa contiene.

E' un ottimo rapporto qualità-prezzo ed è un ottimo modo per iniziare a sperimentare con questo hobby creativo. È adatto a principianti di tutte le età e abilità. Mi rilassa tantissimo ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Die Saugnapfhalterung für Rasierer ist eine super Idee. Das Produkt ist in mehreren Farben auswählbar und die von mir verwendeten Rasierklingen passen von der Größe und Form perfekt in die Halterung. Die Saugleistung entspricht nicht meinen Erwartungen.

Ich habe die Fliesen in meiner Dusche gereinigt und nach dem Trocknen die Saugnapfhalterung angebracht. Am ersten Tag hing nur die Saugnapfhalterung ohne Rasierer in einer Höhe von ca. 1,80 m an der Wand zum Testen (die Höhe wurde von mir extra so gewählt, dass kein Wasser beim Duschen gegen die Saugnapfhalterung kommt und die Saugnapfwirkung beeinträchtigt.). Am zweiten Tag hing die Saugnapfhalterung mit Rasierer an der Wand. Nach ca. 24 h fiel die Saugnapfhalterung mit Rasierer von den Fliesen ab.

Die Saugnapfhalterung für Rasierer hat mich von der Idee und Ausgestaltung des Produkts dennoch begeistert, so dass ich mir eine Lösung ausgedacht habe. Ich habe den Saugnapf zwischen die Gitter eines Duschablagekorbs geklemmt, der an meiner Duschstange befestigt ist. So lässt sich dieses Produkt ohne herunterfallen benutzen.

Ein Nachtschränkchen in der Optik meines Bettes, wie cool! Ich versuch möbel immer so gut wie möglich selbst aufzubauen da ja nicht alle unbedingt mit der Familie zusammen leben. Hier hat das super auf dem Boden geklappt. Und um den Schrank zusammen zu Bauen braucht man nichts anderes als das was im Lieferumfang vorhanden ist. Werkzeug kommt mit dazu.

Die Anleitung ist anfangs erst etwas Tricky zu verstehen. Aber im Endeffekt kann ich hier ein kleinen Tipp geben:

Erstmal die Beine drunter schrauben von denen es 2 varianten gibt. Die Orientierung ist selbst leicht rauszufinden. Sobald man die Montiert hat, am besten die Linke wand fest schrauben, so kann man dann die anderen Bretter an die richtige Stelle schrauben. Die andere Wand kommt zu letzte und ist auch etwas Kniffelig fest zu bekommen da sie alle Teile hält, und man erstmal die Dübel in das vorgesehene Loch bekommen muss.

Hat man das aber geschafft und alles ist perfekt zusammen gebastelt hat man als Endresultat ein ziemlich Stabiles Nachtschränkchen dort stehen. Die Sticker sind aber leider nicht Rückstandslos entfernbar, die meisten hatten bei mir leider Klebereste. Kann man Glücklicherweise mit einem Feuchten Tuch gut entfernen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: ☕️🧊 Just a really cool looking modern tumbler
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I promise not to make any jokes referring to the ‘ribbed’ part of this product name. I am a mature 40 year old man, and shouldn’t have to caveat my reviews with that…but also…. I mean, the name….

Anyway, this is a brilliant tumbler. I am a big fan of iced coffee, and I’m always on the look out for a new tumbler or glass to drink from, and this has now ticked all those boxes and has become my new favourite iced coffee drinking receptacle… hello fancy word… anyway, yeah this is great! It comes with two drinking parts, the actual drinking bit has a click down lid which is simple to open and drink out of, and then there’s a different section which allows you to slide a straw in and drink through a straw - perfect!

The tumbler lid is removable via screwing it on and off, and then the lid has a detachable string/holder thing (which weirdly is branded as ‘Battle Bears’ - not entirely sure why), which is a nice little bonus, as this means you can hold onto this tumbler and keep it nice and safe when being used.

The… ahem.. ribbed part of the tumbler is a nice touch too, it allows you to really hold onto the tumbler and it feels nice and comfy in your hand when in use, nice and ergonomic (hello another fancy word) and means it really nice to hold and drink out of… so all in all, this is a brilliant tumbler.

The size is really nice too, it’s not too big or small, it’s just the perfect size for a nice big decent sized drink - I’m not sure what more I can say about this, this a great tumbler, it’s easy to drink out of and doesn’t leak, feels nice to hold and use and looks real modern and cool too…

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Great design a little bit tricky to assemble
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This bedside table arrived fast and was packed tightly and very securely. It had foam inside so nothing was damaged or scratched.

I started to assemble it but the instructions were just some figures which were somewhat complicated to properly follow. After some struggle, I managed to mound it.

First of all it looks great. I really love the design and the color choice, plus it matches my apartment quite well. I didn't use it as a bedside table but as a table in the hallway of my apartment, just in front of the mirror. It matches the mirror and everything around it, plus it gives a nice retro look.

It is quite sturdy and strong. Nothing moves around and it has a really interesting design, both to the eye and to functionality. It has a nice place on the back so you can store the power supply and make it somewhat invisible. I really like this part.

The glass part on top is also sturdy and doesn't move, plus is frosted glass and apart from looking good doesn't attract fingerprints.

There is also a drawer which opens easily and you can store quite a lot in there.

Overall this is a really great product, and apart from having some difficulties assembling I really like it and can only recommend it!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Fits most sizes and fun to use
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: I had seen Weighted Hula Hoops on social media and was keen to try one out for myself. This Belle Vous Smart Fitness Ring comes in a branded box and is a lovely bright pink. It is easy to assemble and fits any waist from 23" - 60". It has 28 removeable knots to allow you to change its size by the knots clipping together. The belt spins round a full 360 degrees. The rotating ball works on gravity and needs to be weighted with 200grm of sand/water or powder. I used damp sand. I am using the hoop to add to my weight loss journey and increase my exercise level but I would say the hoop needs quite a decent amount of time and uses to gain any real benefit but it is quite fun although harder than I thought it would be. I am pleased that it is more quiet than I expected although you can hear the movement it is not overly loud at all. Hopefully I will see results soon, in the meantime, the massage nodules on the knots feel very good on my lower back and I will keep using the hoop and monitor weight loss in addition to the benefits to my various muscle groups.

Montati su di una lavatrice HotPoint e funzionano bene. Le vibrazioni sono leggermente diminuite, complice anche il rialzo da terra che generalmente produce sempre un po' di rumore.
In questo caso il sottofondo fastidioso si è attenuato e la lavatrice lavora più silenziosamente.
Non fa miracoli ma fa il suo senza ombra di dubbio.
Ottima la qualità costruttiva, piedi morbidi al tatto ma rigidi al punto giusto per sostenere una lavatrice di un certo peso.

Ribadisco il fatto che sono utili per attenuare le vibrazioni emesse a contatto con il pavimento e non sono utili in nessun caso per ridurre il rumore di fondo generato dalla stessa lavatrice.
Detto ciò, il prodotto è valido ma, nei limiti della compatibilità; la mia lavatrice non ha piedi come in foto ma i rialzi si adattano bene alla sua forma, quindi funzionano lo stesso e anche bene.
Prodotto consigliato sicuramente ma occhio alla compatibilità!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Nice shelves, would benefit from being sealed if used in a kitchen or bathroom
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
The shelves are made of paulownia wood which seems sturdy, yet is surprisingly light and has a strong, appealing grain pattern. The pack contains all the screws and wall plugs needed to put the shelves up and even contains a (very basic) spirit level to make sure the shelves are level. It is interesting that the wall plugs and spirit level are included in the pack, but the provided instructions do not make any mention of using them. For anybody with a basic grounding in DIY, this will of course be obvious, but some guidance might have been useful for those who are less experienced.

As I’ve already mentioned, the shelves are made of paulownia wood. It does not appear that the wood has been sealed in any way, so I would say that if you are going to use them in a room where there is often high humidity (kitchen or bathroom), you might want to consider using some form of polyurethane sealant on them before putting them up.

Overall, a nice pair of lightweight shelves. Just bear in mind that there are only two fairly small screws holding each shelf onto the wall, so load the shelves accordingly.

There are many similar products around, in lots of sizes, which vary in quality, some being much better than others. These are good quality, certainly not made with poor quality plastics like some, which are often low-grade, brittle, and prone to cracking. The plastics used in the manufacture of these is very good, with a decent degree of flexing, and general robustness, making them likely to be far more resistant to cracking.

Sizing is of course suitable depending on what you actually intend using them for. This is a set of 4 x 6l storage boxes, perfect for shelves, cupboards etc. Great also for hobbies, workshop etc.

The plastics used seem as though they will be very durable and generally shatterproof. The boxes have decent, properly fitting lids, although they just sit atop, they don’t lock into place. There are handle recesses at the ends. They’re really good quality all round, and the boxes stack nicely too!

To summarise, this is a very good quality, above average set of 4 x stackable storage boxes. A little on the pricey side perhaps, and do be aware the lids don’t lock into place, but good all-round and recommended nonetheless.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Bonitos y de calidad, un “must have” en todo hogar
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Esta caja de 12 candelabros es de lo mejor que vamos a encontrar tanto dentro como fuera de Amazon: son sencillos, bonitos, bien acabados y quedan bien en cualquier decoración y circunstancia, no importa si es para adornar una noche romántica, una cena de Navidad, un Halloween o evento de cualquier tipo.

Ahora mismo, para las fotos sólo tenía en casa velas de miel gruesas y cortas pero ya veis en las fotos que los candelabros tienen un excelente agarre y las velas no se van a caer puesto que el diámetro es el correcto para las velas.

Son resistentes y compactos así que estoy deseando que llegue Navidad para ponerlos en la cena de Nochebuena.

✅La presentación es buena: una caja de cartón lisa sin serigrafía ni información de producto o fabricante dentro de otra caja de cartón de Amazon por lo que el reciclaje es sencillo.
✅En el interior encontramos un molde de poliespán de 4cms de grueso con las 12 incisiones para que los candelabros encajen perfectamente y no se dañen en el transporte. Además, también llevan una lámina de 0.5cms a modo de tapa que protege la parte superior de los candelabros.
✅Las medidas de los candelabros son las siguientes: 6cms de altura, 5.5cms la base de los candelabros y 2.3cms el diámetro para las velas.
✅Los candelabros son de vidrio grueso, liso y transparente
✅Están perfectamente acabados: sin rebabas, sin grietas, muescas ni roturas de ningún tipo

En resumen, me han encantado estos candelabros por su sencillez y robustez por lo que recomiendo su compra al 100%, además, la relación calidad/precio es muy buena (en el momento de la compra el precio es de 28.99€/12 candelabros por lo que cada uno sale a unos 2.40€)

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Needed quite a bit of work
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: The box is entirely untreated wood, so that needed a coat of exterior sealant (outer surfaces only). The single fixing hole is not ideal, unless the base is wedged against something, so I added a small angle bracket underneath. Having said that, this is a nice little feeder and the platform is exactly the right size for the squirrels that happily use it every day. To improve it further, I removed the metal lid cover (sharp edges!) and the completely unecessary sprung hinge, which I replaced with a better quality standard hinge. The weight of the lid is perfectly adequate to keep it closed. Finally, if you do nothing else, do please smooth the sharp exposed edge of the plastic window: the female squirrels will be very grateful. Not very good value for money, but with a little work it has turned out to be a great success.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Tut was es soll, wirkt aber nicht wirklich hochwertig
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Im Rahmen des Amazon Vine Programms durfte ich das Navaris Ultraschall Reinigungsgerät kostenfrei testen und ausprobieren.

Ich habe etwas gezögert mit dem rezensieren, weil ich nicht ganz sicher bin was ich von dem Reinigungsgerät halten soll bzw. ob es funktioniert. In die Schale wird Wasser eingefüllt und via Ultraschall sollen kleinere Gegenstände wie Schmuck oder vlt auch noch Brillen sauber werden. Ehrlich gesagt weiß ich aber nicht wie sehr das Gerät funktioniert. Der Schmuck sieht etwas sauberer aus, aber wie viel sauberer der im Vergleich zu Desinfektionsmittel z.B. ist... keine Ahnung.
Hinzu kommt, dass die Fläche leider nicht soo groß ist. Wie gesagt passt da gerade mal eine Brille, Schmuck oder vielleicht ein Armband rein. Das gesamte Produkt und die Verpackung wirken nicht sonderlich hochwertig und machen keinen wirklich guten Eindruck.
Ich hänge gerade zwischen 3-4 Sterne, werde mich aber für 4 entscheiden, da das Produkt ja an sich - vermutlich - funktioniert und seinen Zweck erfüllt. Nur der Rest ist ausbaufähig.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: The Large Version Fit a 71" Long Bike
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
We wanted a cover that would last in the weather to protect a bike stored outside year-round.
We installed the Team Obsidian: Bike Covers size large onto a bike that measured 71" from the end of each tire.
The cover fits over everything easily but was a little baggy. See the attached picture.
There are buckled straps on either end to secure the cover, and even when tightened all the way, the bag was still baggy. The end straps, along with the center strap, should keep the cover from ballooning off the bike and stay in place in high winds.
The cover reached all the way to the ground.
As the cover is not symmetrical to all wider handlebars in the front, the pattern on the cover, along with a small label, identifies the front of the cover.
The material appears to be a heavier weight that we hope will hold up well to constant exposure to sun and rain. We will update this review after a winter of exposure.

I was actually referred to this item from a helpful comment on a Reddit thread I found online (thank you, internet stranger!). It arrived today and I thought it deserved a review so others can make an informed decision.

I didn't purchase this for its intended use as a phone pouch but rather for my standard-sized Nintendo New 3DS (pictured). I needed something low-profile, flexible and pocketable which still retained some decent protection. Neoprene isn't really waterproof or resistant, so don't try to test that, but the inside is really soft and doesn't seem to have any bits that could catch on the device or scratch it. I've attached photos so you can see that whilst the device doesn't fill the pouch and leaves a little room, it fits in great without effort and slides only a little bit while inside. It seems fairly well-protected in there, although remember this is best when used as something to throw in the pocket when getting about quickly on public transport or whatever. I would still feel confident putting this in my backpack too but nothing will beat an actual hard case, rather than a pouch, for protection. But the aim for me was portability as I have a hard case for if it needs to go in luggage. I'm also careful with my stuff.

For anyone else who is interested, I also managed to fit an Anbernic RG353P inside and it fit pretty decently, although it needs a slight pull to stretch it. But as it's neoprene and stretchy anyway, it didn't seem to be an issue. I also tried to fit a PS Vita 2000 model but this was just a little too small for that. It would fit pretty much any normal phone fine.

There's a mesh pocket inside but for my particular use case as a 3DS holder, I don't have room to fit a charging cable in there, neither would I want to, for risk of scratching the device with something hard. So it could maybe take a 3DS game cartridge or two, some papers or something flatter/not too thick, perhaps a screen wiper or whatever you want.

The other thing I'll be doing is swapping the zips for fabric ones as they're too jangly/noisy. Lastly, a nice little surprise was a small lanyard/cord which was tucked inside. Not sure how strong it'd be but nice to see nonetheless. The pouch came packaged in a plastic zip lock bag you can reuse.

Overall, very happy with this for what I needed it for.

Je suis pleinement satisfait de l'étui compatible avec Kobo Libra 2 que j'ai récemment acheté. Cet étui s'avère être d'une qualité remarquable, répondant à toutes mes attentes.

Tout d'abord, la qualité de fabrication est indéniablement élevée. Le matériau utilisé est robuste et offre une protection fiable à ma liseuse Kobo Libra 2. La sensation en main est agréable, et l'étui donne une impression de durabilité qui inspire confiance.

Le mode veille fonctionne parfaitement, ce qui est un atout majeur. La liseuse se met en veille automatiquement lorsque l'étui est fermé, préservant ainsi la batterie et assurant une expérience utilisateur pratique. C'est un détail que j'apprécie particulièrement pour prolonger l'autonomie de ma liseuse.

En ce qui concerne le design, j'apprécie la sobriété et l'élégance de l'étui. Il est discret, mais son allure sobre ajoute une touche de sophistication à la liseuse. De plus, il s'adapte parfaitement à la forme de la Kobo Libra 2, offrant un ajustement sécurisé.

Enfin, le rapport qualité-prix est tout à fait correct. Pour la qualité de fabrication et les fonctionnalités offertes, le prix est justifié.

En résumé, si vous cherchez un étui de qualité pour votre Kobo Libra 2, celui-ci est certainement une option à considérer. La combinaison de sa durabilité, du mode veille efficace et de son design sobre en fait un accessoire essentiel pour tout utilisateur de liseuse.

Avevo provato un modello analogo di altra marca, con presa di corrente passante, che non mi aveva soddisfatto a causa della scarsa sensibilità alla luce: in un corridoio con tre faretti LED accesi - quindi con ottima illuminazione - non si spegnevano mai, se non a mattino inoltrato.

Questo modello, posizionato nello stesso punto, si comporta invece benissimo: l'intensità della luce è progressiva (più tenue in penombra; più forte al buio) e le tre tonalità selezionabili - bianca, verde o blu, con comando touch - aiutano a identificare al volo, di notte, zone che si desideri eventualmente distinguere (esempio: camera, bagno, cucina), cosa molto utile per le persone anziane.
Personalmente, nel citato corridoio, ho impostato bianca la luce che indica la via per il bagno e blu quella che conduce alla cucina e ho riscontrato che ciò è stato molto utile.
L'intensità in generale può sembrare bassa, ma di notte è più che sufficiente per segnare il passo e non disturbare.

La presa di corrente passante ha la sicurezza bambini e risulta "tenace", nel senso che per estrarre una spina inserita è meglio tenere in posizione la luce di cortesia, altrimenti viene via dalla presa a muro (e poi, reinserita, tocca selezionare nuovamente la tonalità desiderata - l'impostazione precedente non viene memorizzata). Questo a mio parere non è un difetto e non deve inficiare la valutazione del prodotto, in quanto il comportamento richiesto all'utilizzatore è da considerarsi nient'altro che una buona prassi.

Sulla durata non posso esprimermi, dato che le ho posizionate da un paio di settimane, ma costruzione e materiali sembrano fatti per durare.

In conclusione: è un prodotto che consiglio, anche in virtù di un prezzo più che onesto.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Non temo più il freddo dentro casa!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Allora, questa coperta (che mi è stata regalata dal mio ragazzo per Natale) è davvero uno spettacolo. La cosa migliore è che puoi metterla addosso infilando le braccia nelle maniche, o semplicemente usarla come una coperta normale. Personalmente, la uso più come coperta standard perché mi piace avvolgermi e sentirne la morbidezza mentre leggo sul divano o studio.

Una delle cose che mi ha stupito è la sua capacità di erogare e mantenere il calore. È come se creasse una piccola barriera contro il freddo, e questo è un vero salvavita nei giorni gelidi.
Anche se non ti metti le maniche, la sua consistenza morbida e avvolgente fa comunque il suo lavoro nel tenerti caldo e accogliente e ho apprezzato tantissimo il suo senso di comfort. Comodissino anche il telecomando per impostare temperatura e tempo residuo di riscaldamento.
Inoltre le maniche sono quel tocco in più per poter fare attività anche "manuali" (come usare il PC) senza sacrificare il calore alle mani.

Detto questo, penso che alcune persone possano avere aspettative diverse su questo tipo di prodotto. Ho sentito alcuni amici che si aspettavano una coperta più pesante o con caratteristiche specifiche che questa coperta non offre, addirittura qualcosa di totalmente indossabile anche da dietro.
Se si prende questo prodotto per ciò che è, cioè una comodissima coperta termica (come il nome stesso del prodotto suggerisce), allora fa il suo lavoro ottimamente. Calore, comodità e morbidezza: che si può chiedere di più? Poi è talmente grande che ce la si può benissimo avvolgere attorno a tutto il corpo!
Io ve la consiglio candidamente.

If you have a single pet I'd recommend, but for more than one I'd think twice. This is because the timers, which are easy but a bit annoying to set up, do not stay in sync. So you can't have more than one releasing food at the exact same time. At least, not for long - they go out of sync in a few days.

The portion control isn't precise, with biscuits sometimes not being released. One of my cats learned if she jumped on it and it shook, some biscuits will come out.

Finally, the usb power adapters on mine don't work. I've always used the batteries, but I came across the cables in a draw and thought I'd just try them to see if that helps keep them synchronised, but they're all plugged in and no power.

I've just looked in the manual - while the description here says batteries OR usb, the manual says batteries AND usb. Not sure what the point of that would be.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: No pen loop, some odd design choices, but overall nice
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
It's a nice cover. It's thin. It's only slightly textured, and does feel like leather. No leather smell, which is good. The strap that holds it closed is tight, but does not go full around the back. You can see the dents in the back where it is glued in and it is about a half inch by my measurements. I worry it will pop out.

The hand strap is tight enough I don't worry about it falling, but it's too centered for me to hold my hand in it well and hit the buttons, which is a bit of a pain. Reading while strap hanging is ideally reading one handed. It's harder to measure how far in that goes, but I beleive it is up to the stitching.

It's hard to take off once you put it on, which means it's not going to fall off. I like that.

It has a crease on the back, which makes sense as you need to fold it to make the book stand work. It also has a crease in the front that I've yet to make sense of. It runs perpendicular to the strap. It doesn't help with reaching the buttoms; I tried that. It doesn't let you orient the book stand in landscape. I tried that was well. It lays over the page turn buttons, so you could turn the pages while the cover is closed? It's not really in the way of the USB port. It's just weird.

The hole in the back makes it easy to hit the oddly-placed power button. It is large and well-placed.

My biggest complaint is that it has no pen holder. I am adding one seperately. The Kobo Sage can use the stylus for notetaking, and while I grant the Elipsa is more commonly used for that, the addition of a small loop of elastic to act as a pen loop to support that feature should not have been cost-prohibitive.

Overall, nice case.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Very hard to open door but works and is quiet
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Followed the instructions. Didn't realize the arm coming from the hydraulic door mounted part should not be 90 degrees as it shows in all its diagrams. The arm mounted above the door should be 90 degrees.

Getting the arm from above the door to slide down over the arm from the hydraulic portion was a bit hard. I did bang on it a few times with my heavy duty side cutters. This did leave some minor chips in the paint which will probably rust at some point. However, a snug fit is probably better then a loose fit.

When you take the parts out of the package you will immediately be impressed with this ultra heavy duty feeling door closer. All the parts feel like heavy duty steel. I doubt they are truly heavy duty steel at this price, but whatever they are, everything is very heavy!

After adjustment, the door closes and latches perfectly. The one downside is the door is VERY HARD to open. I even moved the part above the door over about 4 inches to see if it made it easier. It seemed to make it a little easier but the door is still very hard to open.

Overall if you want to stop people leaving doors open or slamming doors, this is a great solution. I ordered four. Just finished the first one. Three more to go. Will I get them installed before you order yours, receive it, and install it?

Choosing between kiddo constantly slamming all the doors in the house inducing fight or flight all day long or having doors that are hard to open but never slam, I am going no slam every time. Which do you prefer?

Schöne Magnettafel, die optisch top aussieht und ihren Zweck erfüllt. Die Magnettafel wurde schnell und gut verpackt geliefert. Die Montage war kein Problem, auch die beiligende Bohrschablone war von den Maßen her korrekt. Einziger Nachteil, wenn man es so nennen kann, ist die Tatsache, dass man schon starke Neodymmagnete verwenden muss, um Dinge zu befestigen. Dies war mir jedoch im Vorfeld bekannt, da ich bereits eine baugleiche Magnettafel besitze. Da die sich die Metallfläche an der die Magnete haften hinter der Glasplatte befindet, werden entsprechend starke Magnete benötigt. So haften leider keine einfachen Magnete, wie z.B. die beliebten Kühlschrankmagnete oder auch solche die man oft als Sovenir auf Reisen kaufen kann. Mit den beliegenden Magneten und hier auf Amazon bestellten 8x8mm Neodymmagneten ist eine Befestigen aber kein Problem. Will man unbedingt seine Sovenirmagnete an der Wand befestigen muss man sich ggf. entsprechende flache Neodymmagnete bestellt und diese an die schwachen Magnete ankleben, um die Magnetkraft zu verstärken.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Buone paste lucidanti, efficaci ma totalmente prive di istruzioni.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Il set è costituito da 5 barrette di pasta affilante / lucidante di diversa granatura.
Purtroppo la dimensione della grana stessa non è indicata né sulle barrette, né altrove sulla confezione, posto che questa è un anonimo sacchetto di plastica e che manca totalmente qualunque tipo di istruzioni.

Alcune indicazioni operative e soprattutto la corrispondenza tra i colori e le granature si ricavano dalla pagina di vendita e dalle relative illustrazioni.
Ad ogni modo, le paste si prestano sia all'utilizzo manuale, per affilare e lucidare coltelli ma anche oggetti diversi in metalli vari, sia all'impiego insieme a dischi lucidanti con trapani, smerigliatrici e lucidatrici, principlamente per superfici più ampie.
Svolgono un ottimo lavoro, sia nella sgrossatura (relativamente, dato che la grana più grossa è da 500), sia soprattutto nella lucidatura con le grane più fine, inclusa quella da 2500.

Il prezzo di 11,99 Euro non è elevato, sia considerando la buona qualità del prodotto, sia la quantità (68 g per ogni barretta) dello stesso.

Ich habe die TCA Damen Excel Runner Leichte Laufweste mit Reißverschlusstaschen kostenfrei zum Test erhalten und möchte gerne meine Erfahrungen teilen.

Die Laufweste von TCA hat sich als äußerst praktisch erwiesen. Die Reißverschlusstaschen sind ein großer Pluspunkt, da sie genug Platz bieten, um meine Schlüssel, mein Handy und andere kleine Gegenstände sicher zu verstauen, während ich unterwegs bin. Das gibt mir die Freiheit, meine Hände frei zu haben, ohne mir Sorgen machen zu müssen, dass ich etwas verliere.

Die Weste selbst ist leicht und atmungsaktiv, was sie ideal für meine Laufeinheiten, besonders an warmen Tagen, macht. Ich schwitze weniger und fühle mich insgesamt wohler. Die Passform ist bequem und ermöglicht eine gute Bewegungsfreiheit, ohne zu eng oder zu locker zu sein.

Ein weiterer Vorteil ist die reflektierende Paspelierung, die die Sichtbarkeit während meiner nächtlichen Läufe erhöht. Sicherheit ist mir wichtig, und diese Weste trägt definitiv dazu bei.

Es gibt jedoch auch einige kleine Nachteile. Zum Beispiel könnte die Weste etwas mehr Polsterung am Kragenbereich vertragen, um Scheuerstellen zu verhindern. Außerdem wäre es schön gewesen, wenn die Reißverschlüsse der Taschen etwas robuster wären. Manchmal habe ich das Gefühl, dass sie leichter brechen könnten, wenn man nicht vorsichtig ist.

Insgesamt bin ich jedoch zufrieden mit der TCA Damen Excel Runner Leichte Laufweste. Sie erfüllt ihren Zweck gut und bietet einige nützliche Features. Die Kombination aus Leichtigkeit, Atmungsaktivität und praktischen Taschen macht sie zu einer guten Wahl für Läuferinnen. Wenn die kleinen Verbesserungen vorgenommen würden, wäre sie nahezu perfekt.

👍🏃‍♀️ Die Reißverschlusstaschen sind super praktisch.
👍 Die Leichtigkeit und Atmungsaktivität der Weste.
👍 Die reflektierende Paspelierung für mehr Sicherheit.
👎 Der Kragen könnte besser gepolstert sein.
👎 Die Robustheit der Reißverschlüsse könnte verbessert werden.

Insgesamt empfehle ich die TCA Damen Excel Runner Leichte Laufweste für Läuferinnen, die eine bequeme und praktische Weste suchen, um ihre Laufeinheiten zu unterstützen.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Disappointing Quality - Kurtzy Rubber Printmaking Roller
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
My experience with the Kurtzy Rubber Printmaking Roller has unfortunately left much to be desired, resulting in a two-star rating due to several notable issues.

**Dented Rubber and Weight Issues: 🛢️🤦‍♂️**
Upon receiving the product, I noticed a few dents in the rubber surface of the roller. These imperfections directly impacted its functionality, causing uneven pressure during printmaking. Additionally, the roller proved to be surprisingly heavy, making it less ergonomic and causing fatigue during extended use.

**Excessive Squeaking: 🐭🔊**
The most significant drawback was the excessive squeaking noise produced by the roller during operation. This not only created a disruptive and unpleasant working environment but also raised concerns about the overall durability and smooth functionality of the product.

**Wooden Handle Quality: 🪵👎**
While the wooden handle seemed promising at first, its quality did not match expectations. It felt somewhat fragile, and given the weight of the roller, there were concerns about its long-term durability, especially during frequent use.

**Limited Satisfaction: 😕🔄**
In summary, the Kurtzy Rubber Printmaking Roller fell short of expectations due to the dented rubber surface, excessive weight, and the disruptive squeaking noise during use. While the wooden handle adds a touch of aesthetics, its overall quality, combined with the other issues, limits the overall satisfaction with the product.

If you're considering this printmaking roller, I would advise caution and thorough inspection upon receipt. It might be worthwhile to explore alternative options that offer better build quality and functionality for a smoother and more enjoyable printmaking experience. A two-star rating reflects my disappointment with the product's performance and overall quality.

I have been getting Bright Day Rescue Cats calendar for the past few years. Ive never been into animal calendars because they seem so staged and I didnt like that. But my friend bought me a cat calendar where the cats were not staged, they look so natural. So it got me hooked on cat calendars. Finding Bright Day calendars with the rescue stories is a highlight of my year and month seeing how a cat was rescued from a situation and giving a second chance. I did notice the stories seem shorter than previous years calendars. I end up tearing off the pictures with the accompanied month and posting them on my office bulletin board above my computer. I write the name of the cat on each month so I know their name. My husband decided he wanted one too at work. He also writes the name of the cat on the cats picture so its easy to see. He has co workers who will come to his office to see what cat is being showcased for that month. It's a nice little breather if youre dealing with a stressful day to look up at the Susie the cat for December 2023, and feel comforted knowing she got a home. It just takes the focus off your stress or anxiety for a few minutes allows you to breathe and go back to what you were doing with a clearer head. Ich war neugierig aufgrund des Designs und wollte mal eine Álternative zu meiner normalen Bürste (Produkt einer bekannten Marke zum entwirren von Haaren) testen, die ich seit vielen Jahren nutze.
Der erste Eindruck war sehr gut. Liegt schön in der Hand und fühlt sich sehr gut an der Kopfhaut an. die langen Borsten dringen gut durch und dieses spiralförmige Design passt sich ergonomisch mit nur ganz wenig Druck der Kopfform an, so das man ein sehr angenehmes, gleichmäßiges Bürstgefühl hat. Das entwirren ging wirklich leicht trotz der Länge und ich hab den leichten Massageeffekt genossen.

Eigentlich also eine gute Bürste, aber ... nach nur einmaliger kurzer Nutzung bei unkomplizierten Haaren und mit wenig Druck waren bereits mehrere Borsten verbogen und geknickt und die Bürste sieht aus wie nach wochenlanger, intensiver Nutzung. Bei Konkurrenzprodukten hatte ich so eine Erscheinung erst nach Monaten. Ich mag mir garnicht vorsellen, wie lang es wohl dauern würde, bis die ersten Borsten brechen oder ausfallen. Das Design ist also toll, die Qualität des Materials leider minderwertig. Die Bürste geht nach nur ein mal nutzen zurück, die ist ihr Geld nicht wert. Für das gleiche Geld bekomme ich Bürsten der Marke, die ich seit vielen Jahren zufrieden nutze und werde wohl dabei bleiben.

Ich habe mir den Kapselhalter für die großen Vertuo-Kapseln bestellt und möchte hier meine positiven ✅ und negativen ❌ Erfahrungen teilen:

Was mir gefallen hat:

✅ Der Kapselhalter ist aus Acryl und sieht schick aus, besonders mit dem schwarzen Acryl.
✅ Das Anbringen an der Wand war einfach, nachdem ich die falsch bemessenen Aufkleber passend zugeschnitten hatte.
✅ Die Kapseln lassen sich leicht einfügen und gleiten problemlos in den Halter.
✅ Die Idee, Kapseln an der Wand aufzubewahren, ist praktisch und spart Platz.
✅ Der Kapselhalter erfüllt seinen Zweck und hält die Kapseln gut an ihrem Platz.
✅ Das Set enthält genug Aufkleber für die Montage.

Was mir nicht gefallen hat:

❌ Die Aufkleber sind viel zu groß und müssen mühsam zugeschnitten werden, um zu passen.
❌ Es gibt keine mitgelieferten Anweisungen, was die Montage etwas knifflig macht.
❌ Der Preis erscheint mir hoch, besonders wenn man bedenkt, dass Anpassungen nötig sind.
❌ Es wäre praktisch, wenn mehr Kapseln pro Reihe aufbewahrt werden könnten.

Meine Meinung:
Der Kapselhalter erfüllt seinen Zweck, aber die nicht passenden Aufkleber und der etwas hohe Preis trüben den Gesamteindruck. Mit einigen Verbesserungen, wie maßgeschneiderten Aufklebern und klareren Anweisungen, könnte das Produkt besser sein. 👍

The JLab Go Air Pop aren't your audiophile's dream buds, but for the price, they're a pocket-pleasing punch of sound. While they lack fancy noise cancellation and audiophile-grade clarity, they deliver crisp, dynamic tunes that won't break the bank.

The compact, pop-it-open case is a clever touch, with a built-in USB cable tucked away for easy on-the-go charging. No more scrambling for cords! The earbuds themselves fit snugly and comfortably, standing up to workouts and everyday use without fuss.

Sure, the sound might not be the absolute pinnacle of audio perfection, but it's clear, balanced, and surprisingly punchy. Bass lovers might crave a touch more rumble, but for most listeners, these buds offer a satisfying sonic experience.

The touch controls are responsive and intuitive, letting you adjust volume, skip tracks, and even take calls with ease. Plus, the battery life is impressive, lasting through hours of playlists and podcasts.

Bottom line? The JLab Go Air Pop are budget-friendly superstars. They're not the ultimate noise-cancelling, audiophile nirvana, but for crystal-clear tunes, a convenient case, and a price tag that won't make you wince, they're a winner.

Ich brauchte eine Abdeckung um unseren Tisch mit den Bänken (die man drunter schieben kann) auf dem Balkon abzudecken. Die letzte Abdeckung war etwas zu groß und leider auch viel zu dünn und war bei Wind relativ laut - es hat eben geknistert.

Gute Verarbeitung mit schöner neutraler Farbe. Das Material knistert leider auch hörbar, gerade im Wind, passt aber gut drauf, dadurch weniger zu hören als bei der anderen, die wir hatten. Aber ansonsten ist hier alles sauber verarbeitet und wirkt sehr hochwertig.

Die Plane ist mit 180x120x70cm eigentlich auch etwas zu lang und zu breit für den Tisch, aber durch das Klettband an den Kurzen Seiten lässt es sich trotzdem sehr gut straff anlegen. Was mir jetzt nicht gefällt, und worauf ich leider nicht geachtet habe, ist, dass die Plane an den Ecken, unten, keine Schlaufen oder so für die Tischbeine hat. Das vermisse ich jetzt tatsächlich, wenn Wind unter die Plane kommt, kann sie hochrutschen, auch wenn man das Band und das Klett richtig fest anlegt und so bei richtig starkem Wind im schlimmsten Fall wegfliegen.

Positiv:
+ gute Verarbeitung
+ hochwertiges Material
+ schöne neutrale Farbe
+ effektive Befestigung

Neutral:
= leider keine Schlaufe für die Beine an den Ecken

Negativ:
- hörbares Knistern des Materials, besonders bei Wind

Alles in allem erfüllt die Abdeckung gut und bietet einen effektiven Schutz für Gartenmöbel oder auf dem Balkon. Die fehlenden Schlaufen für Tischbeine hatte ich nicht drauf geachtet, da werden wir wohl noch was dran nähen, um das ganze noch besser zu sichern.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Totally love this Rhino USA pop-up tent!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I am 5' tall and I can collapse my Rhino USA pop-up privacy tent in about 15 seconds. I watched Rhino's instructional video and can now collapse my tent each and every time, very easily. I even taught my husband how to collapse it.
We love, love, love this tent and have used it at the running events we attend. We are so smug about the fact that we have our very own private port-a-potty and are thrilled that it has drawn no attention and no one has asked us what we use it for. So far, everyone has ignored it, which is good.
We, also, store items in the tent that we do not want anyone messing with while we stroll around the venue.
This Rhino USA pop-up privacy tent was the perfect item that we did not realize how much we would love until we started using it.
Also, the lifetime warranty cannot be beat!
Thank you for making this excellent product, Rhino USA! Please make this tent available in different colors so there can be separate tents for boys and girls (PINK CAMO!!!). I would rather not share my collapsible port-a-potty with any males... his & her pop-up tents!
FYI, my husband has a history of kidney stones. One day he complained to me about how desperately dehydrated he gets at races because he does not drink because he has nowhere to urinate. That very night, after much searching, I found this Rhino USA pop-up tent. I do not want my husband to become dehydrated just because he has nowhere to urinate; that is both ridiculous and unhealthy. He could develop those awful kidney stones again and I am not going to let that happen. This tent is practically a medical device for people trying to avoid developing kidney stones... PeeFree Tent!
Great for breastfeeding, too!
Thank you, Rhino USA!!!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: klappe lässt sich leider nicht mit einer Hand öffnen : schade.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
ich habe mir das Produkt in dieses Herstellers in der Vergangenheit eigentlich recht gute Erfahrung gemacht und wollte nun dieses Flip Case auch für ein neues iPhone 15 haben.

leider aber ist die obere Verriegelung des Klappmechanismus nicht sauber ausgeführt d.h. ich bin nicht in der Lage mit einer Hand die Klappe zu öffnen sondern benötige dafür noch einen zweite Hand. ich hatte versucht, Diesen Verriegelungsmechanismus mechanisch nach zu biegen aber dadurch ist er eher lose geworden also hat sich gelockert und hat nicht zu einem einfacheren öffnen beigetragen.

Deshalb kann ich diesen Produkt leider nicht die volle Punktzahl geben was eigentlich der Marke nicht angemessen ist da ich wie gesagt mit anderen Flip cases für frühere Handys deutlich bessere Erfahrungen gemacht habe.

Übrigens – der Hauptgrund sich für dieses Flip Case zu entscheiden waren diese:

zum einen kann ich das Handy bzw Case in aufgeklappten Zustand auch in eine Halterung in meinem Auto einsetzen, die seitlich das Gerät greift, und daher ist dieses vertikaler Flip Case deutlich besser einsetzbar als ein horizontal wie ein Buch zu öffnendes Flip Case.

Zum zweiten hat es im Gegensatz zu Produkten der Konkurrenz am unteren Ende auch Aussparungen für Stromanschluss/Ladestecker vorgesehen, die die meisten anderen vertikalen Flip Cases nicht haben, sprich wenn man das Handy laden möchte, muss bei denen die Klappe offen sein, was nicht immer in jedem Fall erwünscht ist...!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Looks good. Deeper fit than I was expecting. Label comes off as easily as I had hoped.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Label removal:
I liked the look of the hat, but didn't like the dumb-looking "Tough" label. After studying the photos, I figured it would be trivial to remove the label, and luckily it was simple. It's very easy to pop every 2nd or 3rd stitch of the about 50 label stitches with a hobby knife (I recommend doing it from the back, so in case you slip, it won't snag the front fabric). And, it comes right off (in less than 30 seconds if you're quick). The small holes left over from the sewing needle are easily steamed out with an iron, and you have a brand-new, brand-less hat. Highly recommended!

Fit:
This hat sits lower on my head than I was expecting. Since there is no real structure like a regular baseball cap has, you really want to pull it down tight to get the dome to look right, but the band bottoms-out on my ears, pushing them out slightly in a not-quite-comfortable way. So, for me, it's either a wrinkled top, or stick-out ears. I think I have a fairly average ear height (is that a thing?), but I don't have a lot of hair up top. So, your results may differ if you have lower ears, a tall forehead, or more voluminous hair on top.

Size:
I have a large-to-very-large head (7 1/2 hat size, 23 3/4", 603mm) and this adjusts to my size easily with plenty of room to spare on the strap.

My partner has a quite small head (6 5/8 hat size, 21", 534mm), and they were also able to adjust it down to fit easily (though they also agreed that it was too deep, and pushed their ears out uncomfortably).

Esattamente come in foto e come descritto!
Vedo molte recensioni che si lamentano del peso (non abbastanza leggero) e dello scarso grip per la superficie "morbida" dalla sensazione scamosciata e non in gomma, e vorrei dare il mio parere dopo quasi 2 mesi di utilizzo, avendolo portato anche in viaggio zaino in spalla con me in giro per la Thailandia.

- peso/leggerezza: se fate una breve ricerca vedrete che non esistono tappetini pieghevoli più compatti o meno pesanti, anzi! La maggior parte, anche quelli più costosi e di brand rinomati pesano da 1,3 kg a 2kg. Un peso attorno a 1 kg è anzi più leggero della norma. Avrei preferito pesasse ancora meno? Certamente! Ma bisogna mettere in conto che non si può aver tutto, e ho trovato questo tappetino essere un "compromesso" più che ottimo.

- grip: ho usato questo tappetino in posti e temperature più diversi e mi sono sempre trovata benissimo, stabile e non sono mai scivolata, oltre a non aver mai incontrato resistenza nei passaggi più fluidi tra le asana nelle sequenza vinyasa. Anche in ambienti caldi e umidi, tipo sotto il sole in spiaggia, è rimasto saldo dando sicurezza, mai scivoloso nemmeno se veniva a contatto con acqua o sudore (e facilissimo da pulire anche dai granelli di sabbia più fini).
Quindi no, non sono d'accordo con chi afferma che il grip non è buono. Lo trovo eccellente.

Vorrei anche far notare che, a differenza di tappetini più "gommosi" non diventa mai appiccicoso e non risente del calore (ovvero non rischia di deformarsi, sciogliersi, creare irregolarità di consistenza e colore. Se siete viaggiatori sono sicura capirete l'importanza di non doversi preoccupare di queste variabili, avendo la necessità di portarlo con voi ovunque e comunque.
I materiali sono davvero buoni e resistenti, nel poco tempo che è stato con me ha già resistito a tanto rimanendo come nuovo.

E' molto sottile, questo si, ma di nuovo un veloce confronto con qualsiasi altro prodotto di questo genere vi dimostrerà che 1,5 mm è lo standard.
Il fatto che sia così sottile in realtà ha il grande vantaggio di aiutare tantissimo nelle asana di equilibrio, sia in piedi che in inversione.
Ammetto che avendo per conformazione le ossa un po' sporgenti, certe asana non risultano agevolate, ma lo stesso valeva quando usavo tappetini in foam, dandomi però uno svantaggio in termini di equilibrio. Un asciugamanino piegato (o un pezzo di vecchio tappetino in foam che ho tagliato) messo sotto le "parti dolenti" all’occorrenza ha risolto tutto per me.

Unica piccola pecca? Le pieghe restano visibili... certo l'ho sempre tenuto piegato e potrebbe essere anche solo il fatto che le ha mantenute dalla piega in fase di produzione, voglio provare a bagnarlo e farlo asciugare disteso per vedere se vanno via. In ogni caso sarebbe un contro solo estetico, non hanno mai compromesso nessuna mia pratica. Parlando di estetica, è davvero un bellissimo oggetto!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: I have NEVER got this to work, despite every effort over months.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
EXTREMELY disappointing.

I've had this for far too long to return, so I now have to accept that it is little more than a very expensive paperweight.

I have tried using this display with the Arduino UNO, an Arduino Nano, an ESP8266, a D1Mini (also8266), an ESP32, and a Rapberry Pi Pico. I have never EVER been able to get even a flicker from the display. I have to conclude that this display, the one I have if not the actual model, is something to avoid.

It has left me feeling extremely frustrated, and I confess, just a little wary of AZ. I may have just been unlucky, but I seem to have difficulties with displays from this supplier that I don't have with others. Is it the information they are providing being inaccurate? Possibly.

Because I've struggled to get this working over months of trying and having to abandon it again, I've ended up using OLED displays instead.

Should it work? Yes. Does it work? No. It's dead. Trust me that I've tried everything, and drawn on a lifetime of programming and electronics knowledge. Nothing should be that difficult.

Will I get another e-paper display? Yes, probably, because I need one for a major project, but I will not be spending that much money on this type of e-paper display again, not without actually seeing proof that it works from the supplier.

All I can say is: Grrrrrrr

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Not Buying Due to Locking Ring Disappointment
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: A respectful review after looking over the product. As a Vet I can say from my experience you are either 100% reliable or not at all. I will not buy, especially at this price with a plastic locking ring. It appears from detailed analysis of the reviews that in the last few years the locking ring has gone from metal to plastic. The reason I would pay the expensive price of this shovel is I need 100% reliability out in the wilds in my 4x4 with my family. Sacrificing reliability by putting plastic threads on metal threads where mst the stress on the shovel will be transferred to, to save a few cents is a very poor choice and what pushed me to keep on looking for a bullet proof product. To be fair, there may be reasons like rust that drove Rhino to make this change but I can handle and or prevent rust. Put some oil or anti seize on it and you good forever. Very, Very bad choice Rhino to make this change, No Rhino has Plastic. Change back to a metal locking ring and I'll be a buyer. For now Im moving on and I'll have to question everything Rhino makes from now on.

Die bis jetzt beste Folie, die ich genutzt habe. Mit zwei anderen Folien hatte ich bisher Pech.
Diese Folie lässt sich ohne Probleme komplett blasenfrei aufsetzten, was nicht selbstverständlich ist.

Im Pack sind drei Folien, aber nur ein Reinigungsset (kleines Microfasertuch, Einweg-Alkoholpad, irgendein blaues Reinigungszettelchen). Tatsächlich benötigt man aber nur das Microfasertuch, das man ja immer wieder verwenden kann.

Display nur eben mit dem Microfasertuch wirklich sauber reinigen, geht schnell und problemlos.
Dann kann man schon die Schutzfolie aufbringen, ohne die anderen Reinigungsutensilien zu benutzen. Ich selbst habe die Folie von oben nach unten langsam(!) appliziert, Bezugspunkt war dabei die Linse der Selfie-Kamera. Dabei mit einer Plastikkarte leicht von oben nach unten angestrichen. Folie saugt sich gut an, da schon annähernd blasenfrei. Eine Miniblase hatte ich nach Aufbringen der Folie leicht ausstreichen können.

Die Folie ist etwas kleiner als des Display, lässt sich daher in meinen Augen erheblich besser stressfrei ausrichten als Folien, die millimeter genau die Größe des Displays besitzen. Das habe ich leidvoll bei einer anderen Folie erleben müssen.

Die Folie selbst ist nicht zu dünn, sondern hat eine vernünftige Steifigkeit und Dicke. Sie ist einwandfrei transparent, hat eine ganz leicht stumpfe Haptik zu Anfang, was aber die Bedienung nicht behindert und ein paar Stunden später auch vetschwunden ist. Sensorik funktioniert einwandfrei, Wischen etc. Funktioniert einwandfrei.

Für mich die bisher beste Folie, würde ich jederzeit wieder kaufen. Volle Kaufempfehlung.

The only reason I did not give a 5 star rating, and frankly, it is a 5 star product, is the misleading "Made in America" impression you are given when looking at this product. Kinda like Iphones, they are "engineered in America" but built in China. Whilst this makes them no less good quality wise, and they really are a generational improvement by a father & sons company in the US, I actually live in Thailand. So, to support a US company, I bought American, paid extra to ship them, paid import duty into Thailand etc, only to see made in China on the box, which is pretty much right next door to where I'm living.

Fool me once, but I have since found the same product with a different name on it, likely made in the same factory, and shall save myself over 50% next time I buy them. And I will buy again, they're great!

If the father & sons happen to see this review, may I please suggest you actually manufacture in the US. You've designed a fantastic product which people will pay a premium for, tool up and produce it locally. Nice bag for a day trip. The main compartment has a roll-down & buckle seal, and is spacious enough to stash a change of clothes, towel, camera, etc. It's not really big enough for a weekend away; but would be perfect for a day on the water. While the main compartment will keep your stuff dry (as long as you close it properly), I wouldn't trust the outer pockets to do the same. If you can get the zippers closed tightly, the small pockets should be beyond splash-proof and rain proof, but would probably not hold up if the bag was submerged. The outer pockets are also very small. The front one is probably the most useful of them, and has enough room to keep a few items like sunscreen and/or insect repellant, that you want to keep readily available -- but don't need to be 100% protected from the water. The side pockets are tiny, and have their zippers in the middle. I can't imagine using them for anything bigger than some lip balm, a small cloth for cleaning your sunglasses, some loose change, and maybe a compass.

The padding on the back and adjustable shoulder straps makes it comfortable to wear around. The nature of the roll & buckle closure creates a useful top handle. The yellow color stands out nicely, and would be helpful if you're looking for the bag -- or if somebody is looking for you. If necessary, any heavy contents could be dumped out, and the bag could be used as a PFD (just don't wear on your back in the water).

I wish the bag had a water bottle pocket and a few attachment rings, clips, and/or straps; but at this price-point, can't really complain about their absence.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Now I Know Why I Glow in the Dark
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Like: Easy instructions. Reasonable results return time. Relatively usable on-line data entry (they understand that not all the data are available at once and seamlessly supported follow-up entries). Results and risks clearly presented. Further resources referenced.

Dislike: Nothing

Could be Better: Packaging for shipping.
1) The self-seal (zip seal... whatever) bag supplied for analysis return does not seem robust. I added tape
2) The return package has a prohibition against machine handling in the mail. The Post Office (USPS) explicitly could not offer that (I learned that when I purchased priority mail service). Instead, they put their shipping label over the printed restriction. If machine handling is really a problem (and it apparently was not in my use case) then a more robust package is required. This seems to be a case of the supplier trying to push their problems off to another entity rather than addressing it head-on.

Caution: Write down everything (hard copy) and save it until you have reviewed the final results. You will need to reference the "My Test Kit Serial" multiple times. Dates, times (yes, times), and tracking information are all relevant.
Good

My cat likes cat grass but she tends to tug on the grass rather than chewing bits off. I tried this company's other product with the plastic container to see if she would actually like it. She did, but like I said, she tends to tug on the grass and knock the container over etc. These stay put.

After some experience, I stopped using all of the seeds in the packets each time as she doesn't really need all of that. Also, you can get the wheat berries/seeds at any bulk foods store. I might try some other types of seeds to see if she likes them better.

I also plan to reuse the "soil" by just breaking it up and taking the plant matter out. I haven't tried this yet but if it fails, I will post an update. I don't expect it to fail as they are really just made of coconut husks. I don't think they provide a lot of nutrients.

The best part about having two is that as the one starts to die off, I can get the second one started so she always has grass to nibble on.

Overall, very satisfied.

Ho utilizzato questo telo copribiciclette per ormai due anni, e ne sono estremamente soddisfatto. È un prodotto pratico ed essenziale, che svolge egregiamente la sua funzione. L'installazione è abbastanza semplice e riesco a effettuarla autonomamente senza difficoltà.

Utilizzo il telo per coprire le biciclette montate su un portabici da ganciotraino, e devo dire che si adatta perfettamente, offrendo una protezione efficace anche durante il viaggio. Il telo è dotato di varie fibbie di compressione, che permettono di fissarlo saldamente, prevenendo qualsiasi spostamento causato dal vento o dalla velocità. Inoltre, il sacchetto di trasporto e compressione incluso è davvero comodo, soprattutto per riporre il telo all'interno del camper che utilizzo.

Dopo due anni di utilizzo, il materiale ha dimostrato una buona resistenza all’usura e alle condizioni climatiche avverse. Consiglio questo telo a chiunque cerchi una soluzione affidabile e facile da usare per proteggere le proprie biciclette, sia in viaggio che durante il rimessaggio.

Bike came on time and had exceptional packaging. Strangely enough the seat clamp was missing. I Contacted Bixe asking for a Seat Clamp, their reply was "We do not have spare parts, return it to Amazon", I did not. I asked why they could not send me the clamp, and they replied again "Return it to Amazon". I copy pasted their "Industry leading" warranty as a reply, asking for a seat clamp and the best they could do was refund me $22, so that I could go out an buy my own seat clamp.

That said, the bike itself with a properly installed seat clamp is great. It is a beautiful product, rides well, is sturdy/strong, but their warranty is nonsense, and they do "as little as possible" to correct an issue.

I am still happy, I know this review will have little to no impact as I suspect most of their bikes ship with all the parts, but the support system is set up to exhaust you, or otherwise try to pass the problem to someone else. Yay?
