CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Schöne und vielseitige Lampe – Aufbau braucht Geduld
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Titel: Schöne und vielseitige Lampe – Aufbau braucht Geduld

Lieferung: Die Lampe wurde schnell und sicher geliefert.

Qualität und Komfort: Die Lampe ist optisch sehr ansprechend und bietet viele Möglichkeiten, sie nach eigenen Vorstellungen zusammenzusetzen. Sie passt sich durch ihr Puzzle-Design gut in verschiedene Räume ein.

Verarbeitung: Die Qualität der einzelnen Teile ist gut, aber der Aufbau erfordert viel Geduld. Ich habe etwa 1,5 Stunden gebraucht, bis die Lampe vollständig zusammengebaut und aufgehängt war.

Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis: Der Preis ist angemessen für die Vielseitigkeit und das Design der Lampe. Der zeitaufwendige Aufbau könnte jedoch für manche ein Nachteil sein.

Fazit: Eine sehr schöne Lampe mit vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten, aber man sollte sich bewusst sein, dass der Aufbau viel Zeit in Anspruch nimmt. Wenn man die Geduld aufbringt, wird man mit einem tollen Ergebnis belohnt.

This lock looks like it will do a great job keeping an honest man honest.

When I first opened the box, I was impressed with how heavy the tongue lock was. It felt like it was made of something.
It was a bit snug on my trailer's ball coupler. But that is not a fault of it, just a limitation of "universal fit". A couple taps here and there and it is on or off. The small top lock was less impressive, but I didn't need it anyways.

Then I picked up the included key. Instantly I recognized the key. CH751.
The key provided was not labelled as a 751, but I pulled one of the dozens I have and yep, it works perfectly.

Yes, I did just tell you all what key opens this lock. ( or at least the one I received )

I was a locksmith for several years and then did telecom for a couple decades.
The 751 key is the number one key I have ever come across.
85% of all telecom cabinets and truck toppers use this key.
It is so simple; it can be picked with either a bent or broken paperclip.
I believe a one-armed paperclip could pick this lock.

Throw back: for those that remember the last millennium, there was a high profile hom!c!de case that revolved around the fact that the suspect had one of those keys on his keychain.

The material feels nice and heavy duty and although the rolling top feels a bit weird if that's not something your used to doing, it's easy enough to figure out. So, we decided to try it out with some real weight. I stuffed it with a 20 lb bag of rice (pictured), and although the rice bag fit nice and snug, my husband (average sized and height) said it felt uncomfortable on his back with the weight distribution. He felt all the weight was on his lower back and didn't think the back padding on the bag was wide enough. I (small female, 5"2 @ 120 pounds) tried it on and didn't feel the same pressure as he did and also felt the weight was better distributed on my smaller build.
All that being said ... Im not planning on going anywhere carrying a 20 pound bag of rice around And feel this bag is still perfect for your average hike through wet things carrying your average weight items you don't want to get wet like your phone, clothes, snacks, etc. no matter the your size. But it's especially good for us shorties.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Was Supposed to be a Gift- I Ended Up Claiming it for Myself!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I was going to give this hat as a gift. But first, I wanted to try it on in order to give a detailed review about it. After wearing it for a moment, I decided that I’m keeping it for myself.

The hat has a slightly different cut than a baseball cap. With its 5 panel design, the hat looks like a cross between a bicyclist hat and a Kangol hat, like Samuel L. Jackson is known for wearing.

I have skin sensitivity issues. The reasons I decided to keep this hat were 1) how cool and light the 100% cotton fabric felt, 2) how soft the sweatband and inside liner felt and 3) the seamless quality of the closure which is unlike anything I’ve ever encountered. Instead of a plastic strip with pegs that you fit by placing through holes on a second strip, the adjustable part on this hat is a single piece of smooth fabric with an unobtrusive clip to loosen and tighten as needed. Plus, with the moisture wicking technology of the headband, I expect to feel cooler on hot days outside or in my kitchen lab at work. Above all, this hat has got me interested in trying out other products from Tough Outfitters. If I find similar success with those products, they might just have a new loyal fan for life!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Cumple su función, sí, ¡pero no a la primera!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Soy Ingeniero Metalúrgico y hago el oficio eléctrico por hobby.
Los he usado exclusivamente para crimpar ferrules 8 AWG, hace falta hacer pruebas con Ferrules 10 y 6 AWG.
He realizado trabajos donde he requerido crimpar estas terminales, uso la crimpadora Wirefy de 22 cm (hay otra versión de alta palanca de 23 cm, supongo, como su nombre lo dice, requiere menos esfuerzo), al crimpar la terminal una vez hago la prueba de engarze y noto que el cable se sale del conector, así que hago un segundo crimpado pero del lado contrario al de la primera vez, hago las misma prueba (jalo el conector del cable con unas pinzas) y esta vez el crimpado es fijo, el cable no se sale nunca.
Sí, ya sé que el título puede contradecir lo que lees, pero no es culpa del troquel de crimpado, sino tal vez de la pinza crimpadora (necesita un ajuste de engarce mayor).

Buen acabado del troquel, tiene detalles del maquinado espléndidos, no se han oxidado, y eso que los he usado casi a diario por 5 meses, aún así las lubrico con WD-40 Specialist Corrosion Inhibitor. Cuida tu inversión. (WD-40, patrocínenme xd).

Podrás notar que el video lo grabé con el celular en la mano izquierda y el crimpado con la mano derecha, la facilidad para crimpar es mejor que una pinza de engarce BGS o incluso una Klein Tools.
En fin, recomiendo sin pensar este producto.

We got this on a whim last minute as we were heading for a weekend of camping at an exposed and windy campsite. Unless it’s secured properly, it’s a bit useless as the wind just blows it over, and we couldn’t figure out a way to secure it to our particular stove. (Others might be different depending on size and shape). We did however end up using our stove in the porch of our tent, as it was just too windy to be outside, in which instance it came in useful to stop any fat spitting out of the pan, and acted as an extra safety barrier between the stove and the tent.
Overall I would recommend, it’s an inexpensive piece of kit which takes up zero space, it’s easy to clean and it will come in handy one way or another!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Large was almost perfect for 2 people, maybe not 4
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
We purchased the 4 person tent for a beach vacation. We've gone through so many umbrellas over the years and they never stand up, so we thought we'd give this one a try. We appreciated that it was lightweight and compact, as it traveled with us in our checked luggage. The first use did take a bit of practice to get it up and going. It was highly annoying that all the poles were wrapped in lightweight plastic and we had a tough time safely removing it in a steady 20mph wind without it flying away. I definitely recommend removing all packaging before taking it into the wild.

Secondly, the compact shovel was a bit too compact, and we assume that it will be the least durable component of the system. I plan to invest in a high quality stainless steel scoop for future use. Also, the filling of the bags with sand is by far the most time consuming portion of setting up the tent. This isn't so bad, but it leaves you stuck in the hot sun until all the bags are filled with sand. I suggest investing in a second more durable scoop or shovel so that two people can fill bags at one time. Also the plastic shovel was fine on loose sand, but when we encountered harder more compact sand I would have appreciated a stronger shovel.

It's very important to follow the relatively simple and straight forward instructions: fill the bags and stretch it out. On our 5th and final day at the beach we watched a crew of 6 people struggle to get a similar tent set up. We told them to stretch it out and fill the bags, but they didn't want to listen to us experienced oldsters, so their struggle continued much longer than necessary.

As for the shade, the fast moving late summer sun presented challenges with the smaller tent, every hour we had to adjust our seating positions to stay in the shade. At times during the high sun the shade was plenty, but quite often as the sun was sinking lower we'd find that we just didn't have enough. A great feature however was being able to use 2 or 3 poles as necessary to angle the shade some, however we may yet consider purchasing a larger tent just to maximize our shade and minimize our movements. Another thing we appreciated about the tent was that given the 4 fixed points it was very sturdy, even in high winds. Many people we saw had a different new shade canopy that consisted of one large pole arched into the sand with 1 anchor point up wind. While this system created a good area of shade, we imagine the constant flapping of the canopy was louder than we desired. The Sun Ninja provided quiet shade instead.

We have a holiday home in Greece and are plagued every year by wasps and, to a lesser extent, hornets. The wasps are everywhere, around the seating areas, the pool, indoors, outdoors, in the lawn. There are a couple of stings every year and many disrupted bbqs.

Several years ago I bought quite a few of these to give them a try. The first time I tried them it was already well into the summer so a little late to be trying them out. Nonetheless we noticed a small but observable drop off in the wasps after they went up and were pleasantly pleased. For a variety reason, over the next few years I didn’t put any more of these up and our wasp problem has been getting worse each summer.

This year we were at the house earlier than normal, in May, and I thought I’d give them another go, especially as it was before prime wasp season, although we had a few buzzing around already. I hung four, well spread out, in four olive trees around the garden and pool. It’s now late August and the results have been astonishing. I’ve seen the odd hornet, maybe 4 or 5 over the summer, and, remarkably, no wasps at all. I’m normally scooping half a dozen drowned wasps out of my pool everyday and this summer not a single one. It is possible that other environmental reasons that I am unaware of may have played a part. Maybe the weather hasn’t been right (seemed normal to me), maybe someone in the area sprayed insecticide and I didn’t know about it, there maybe several other reasons for the massive drop off in wasp activity. All this notwithstanding it seems an incredible coincidence to me that the year I use these at the right time and in decent numbers it is the year we have no wasp problem. (This year we have a trickier badger issue instead).

On my experience and results alone, I highly recommend them.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Good for some, not for others
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: If you are a prismacolor pencil user, these pencils probably aren’t for you. Yes, the lead is soft and waxy, not hard, the colors rich and vibrant, but the pigment is inconsistent, requiring multiple passes to completely color the page. This creates blooming or too much wax build up to highlight as much as you might want. Having said that, if you don’t want to spend $75 -$200 , these pencils are a pretty good quality and color selection for the price for those that enjoy just coloring. I also liked the case they came in for travel or just keeping them neat. Lastly, they sharpened quite easily with a cheap, battery-operated sharpener.

I know 3 stars seems harsh. This is a great ratchet strap set. I love being able to retract the strap back in at the push of a button.

Is this UHaul's fault? Probably. But who's more likely to change from complaints? A ratchet strap company or a moving truck rental company that keeps its stock of rental trucks for a lot longer than a ratchet strap company would keep its current stock of products.

This backpack was listed for $50 and I feel it is a good value at that price. It has some features that feel a little bit generic, but the key parts of the construction are upper-middle quality and it seems like it will retain waterproofness for a long time.

The realistic useful interior size of this pack is about 15" tall, 9" wide and 4-5" deep. You could fit a cylinder that is about 8 or 9" down into it, but it would be very barrel shaped on your back and not wear normally at all.

It has three exterior pockets, the two side ones are almost uselessly small and would only hold a set of keys or a small wallet at most. The center one is a more useful size and would hold a phone or tablet up to about 7" tall by 5" wide. All of these pockets intrude on the interior space available if filled.

The main area I worry about with the pack is the shoulder straps and their connection to the top back of the pack. This does not appear to be reinforced and the shoulder straps feel a bit flimsy, I am sure that if the pack eventually fails, it will be in this area.

Because of the above points, I think this would make a great light-duty daypack sort of waterproof pack, but that it would not be a good pack to attempt to load with heavy items and carry long distances. If it is mostly a pack you wear on your back to get to your boat and then it sits strapped there the whole trip I'll bet it lasts a very long time.

I bought these kits to test the levels in my home. The process is very straightforward. When you receive the kit, read the instructions to find a suitable location where the kit can be undisturbed for a minimum of 48 hours. Then you use their website to register the kit.

NOTE: If you want to use the free shipping label, complete the registration without purchasing any optional shipping. I think that part is confusing some people because there’s no option for “free / included shipping”. Simply don’t choose any of the shipping options and complete the registration. These are for expedited or for non-USPS options. The label will be emailed to you.

Then place the kit for two days. The registration system can even send you a text reminder when it’s time to remove the kit. Pack it up in the included envelope with the shipping label. I received my results within a day of the kit being delivered to the lab. They also provided quality mitigation suggestions because my levels were very high.

It’s also worth noting that some states will send you this kit for free. Do it online search for “AE labs state radon kit” program.

Der DS18B20 Temperatursensor mit 3 Meter Kabel und Edelstahlgehäuse ist ein echtes Highlight für jeden, der eine zuverlässige und präzise Temperaturmessung in seine Projekte integrieren möchte. Ich nutze diesen Sensor in Verbindung mit einem Raspberry Pi, und die Installation sowie die Inbetriebnahme verliefen absolut reibungslos.

Einfacher Anschluss und zuverlässige Funktion

Der Sensor ist speziell für die einfache Integration mit dem Raspberry Pi ausgelegt. Dank des digitalen Ausgangs und der One-Wire-Schnittstelle war der Anschluss eine schnelle und unkomplizierte Angelegenheit. Mit der passenden Software (wie der gängigen DS18B20-Bibliothek für den Raspberry Pi) konnte ich sofort präzise Temperaturmessungen durchführen. Die Messwerte sind stabil und genau, was den DS18B20 zu einer hervorragenden Wahl für alle macht, die exakte Daten benötigen.

Robust und vielseitig

Das Edelstahlgehäuse des Sensors ist nicht nur robust, sondern auch ideal für den Einsatz in verschiedensten Umgebungen. Ich verwende ihn sowohl in Innenräumen als auch in etwas anspruchsvolleren Außenanwendungen, und bisher hat er allen Bedingungen problemlos standgehalten. Das 3 Meter lange Kabel bietet zudem ausreichend Flexibilität, um den Sensor auch weiter entfernt von der Hauptplatine zu positionieren.

Fazit

Der DS18B20 Temperatursensor mit Edelstahlgehäuse und 3 Meter Kabel ist technisch auf höchstem Niveau und funktioniert perfekt mit dem Raspberry Pi. Die einfache Installation, die zuverlässige Messgenauigkeit und die robuste Verarbeitung machen dieses Produkt zur idealen Wahl für alle, die einen langlebigen und präzisen Temperatursensor suchen. Klare Kaufempfehlung und verdiente 5 Sterne!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Very cute, not too customizable, cord is annoying
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
So idk what people mean when they say this things feel fragile. Once everything is popped into place, you could probably toss it around a little and it would fine. All it's doing is hanging, and none of the pieces feel particularly fragile.

Didn't take long at all to put together, all pieces have numbers on them, and as long as you are mindful of what part is the top, you're good to go. I did find the clear skeleton of the lamp to be the hardest part, since the plastic doesn't have much give, but the petals were easy enough.

The petals are far enough away from the light bulb that I don't think an LED light is a total necessity, but it looks fine regardless. I found 800 lumens to be a little too dim, but this could be adjusted with a better bulb.

I bought this hoping I would dye or color the petals pink, since I didn't want to use a pink bulb, but wanted it to look cuter when not on. Couldn't really get anything to work that wouldn't compromise the opacity of the petals, so I just wish they had more colorway options!

But the cord. While I do like a braided cord, why on earth is the on/off switch like 4 inches away from the outlet? Utter nonsense. I bought one of those remote light switches here on Amazon for about $10, which is worth it imo, but kind of annoying that it's necessary. Also, the clip too coil the cord around doesn't seem to work very well with the thick braided cord, but it doesn't seem to have any issues with sliding down anyway.

All in all, a cute lamp with a fun DIY aspect that I wish was a little more customizable re: the color, but works fine enough!

Die Shirts wurden in einem Zip Lock Beutel geliefert, nach dem Auspacken war für mich kein unangenehmer Geruch nach synthetischen Fasern oder Chemie wahrzunehmen. Trotzdem sind sie natürlich erst mal in der Waschmaschine gelandet.

Das Meterial ist wirklich federleicht und auf der Haut kaum zu spüren. Der Schnitt ist weder zu weit, noch zu eng, das Tragefegühl kann einfach nur als angenehm unauffällig bezeichnet werden.

Die Verwendung von 100% Polyester bei der Materialwahl verspricht eine Formstabilität über einen längeren Zeitraum hinweg. Wäscht man die Shirts nicht bei mehr als maximal 30 Grad und vermeidet eine Fahrt im Trockner, sollten sie weder Einlaufen noch anderweitig ihre Form verändern. Da die Shirts eine schnelltrocknende Eigenschaft haben, muss man sie ohnehin nicht in den Trockner geben.

Auch Schweiß trocknet in und auf diesen Shirts zwar schnell, da der dünne und synthetische Stoff jedoch keinerlei absolrbierende Eigenschaften hat, verströmt das Material schon nach einer intensiven Trainingseinheit oder nach einem Tag tragen mit entsprechender Schweißentwicklung einen entsprechenden Geruch, die Shirts werden also möglicherweise häufiger gewaschen werden müssen, als andere Kleidungsstücke, um unangenehme Gerüche zu vermeiden.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Poor Quality 10-Gauge Wire – Exposes Copper When Split
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I purchased this 10-gauge low voltage wire expecting the same quality as the 12-gauge wire from the same brand, but I was sorely disappointed. The biggest issue is the poor insulation. When trying to split the wire down the middle to access the individual strands, the insulation tears too easily, exposing the copper inside. This isn’t just inconvenient; it’s a serious safety concern.

I’ve used the 12-gauge wire before without any problems, so I assumed this would perform similarly. Unfortunately, it didn’t. I had already run this wire through my yard before installing artificial turf, thinking it was up to the task. Now, I’m faced with the frustrating and costly task of tearing up the newly installed turf just to replace this faulty wire.

This product has caused me a lot of extra work and expense, and I’m really disappointed with the lack of quality control. If you’re looking for reliable low voltage wire, I would suggest avoiding this one. Save yourself the hassle and go for something with better insulation that won’t leave you regretting your purchase.

Der Kofferorganizer hat mein Packen auf Reisen revolutioniert und ist mittlerweile ein unverzichtbares Accessoire in meinem Gepäck.

Effizientes Packen & Platzersparnis:
Dank des Organizers kann ich meine Kleidung perfekt sortiert packen, was nicht nur den Überblick erleichtert, sondern auch enorm viel Platz im Koffer spart. Durch das feste Zuzurren des Organizers wird die Kleidung kompakt zusammengehalten, was bei mir tatsächlich etwa einen halben Koffer an zusätzlichem Platz freimacht. Das bedeutet mehr Raum für Souvenirs oder andere wichtige Dinge.

Praktisch & Zeitsparend:
Ein weiterer großer Vorteil ist, dass ich den Kofferorganizer einfach aus dem Koffer nehmen und direkt im Hotel aufhängen kann. Alles bleibt an seinem Platz, und ich muss nichts zusätzlich aus- oder einräumen. Das spart mir jede Menge Zeit und sorgt dafür, dass meine Kleidung ordentlich und knitterfrei bleibt.

Fazit:
Der Kofferorganizer ist ein Muss für jeden, der regelmäßig reist und Wert auf Ordnung, Platzersparnis und Effizienz legt. Mit seiner praktischen Handhabung und der Möglichkeit, deutlich mehr in den Koffer zu packen, ist er die perfekte Lösung für stressfreies Reisen. Klare Kaufempfehlung!

Pro
Die Box ist aus stabilem Holz mit hübscher Maserung. Wahlweise können beide oder ein Innenfach entfernt werden. Das Anbringen und Entfernen der hierfür notwenigen und mitgelieferten Holzteile gestaltet sich mühelos. Ebenso wie die Schachtel sind die Trennwände robust und schön.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: BELLE VOUS Set von 2 Spielzeugkisten – Praktisch, aber mit Einschränkungen: 4 Sterne
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Die BELLE VOUS Spielzeugkisten bieten eine kostengünstige und praktische Lösung für die Aufbewahrung von Spielzeug und Kinderkleidung. Dennoch gibt es einige Aspekte, die bei der Nutzung berücksichtigt werden sollten.

**Design und Aufbau: ⭐⭐⭐**
Die Kisten kommen zu einem guten Preis und sind schnell aufgebaut, auch wenn leider keine Anleitung beiliegt – diese findet man nur auf der Webseite, was etwas umständlich ist. Der Aufbau ist jedoch intuitiv und problemlos zu bewältigen. Die Kisten sind groß genug, um eine Menge Spielzeug oder Kleidung zu verstauen, was sie sehr praktisch für den täglichen Gebrauch macht.

**Stabilität und Nutzung: ⭐⭐⭐**
Die Stabilität der Kisten ist etwas eingeschränkt. Nur der Boden und die Mittelwand sind starr, weshalb man darauf achten sollte, die Kisten nicht zu überfüllen. Bei Überlastung verziehen sie sich und lassen sich schlecht schließen. Zudem halten sie wenig Gewicht aus, weshalb man sie nicht stapeln sollte. Besonders bei Kindern sollte man vorsichtig sein, da die Kisten bei Belastung – beispielsweise durch darauf Hüpfen – leicht in sich zusammenbrechen. Es ist daher ratsam, sie sicher zu platzieren, zum Beispiel unter einer Bank, um Unfälle zu vermeiden.

**Funktionalität und Handhabung: ⭐⭐⭐⭐**
Trotz ihrer Einschränkungen sind die Kisten sehr praktisch für die Aufbewahrung. Sie bieten viel Stauraum und lassen sich dank der Henkel leicht tragen. Die Idee ist super, und für den Preis bieten sie eine gute Möglichkeit, Ordnung ins Kinderzimmer zu bringen.

**Fazit: ⭐⭐⭐⭐**
Die BELLE VOUS Spielzeugkisten sind eine nützliche und preiswerte Option zur Aufbewahrung von Spielzeug und Kleidung. Sie sind leicht aufzubauen und bieten viel Stauraum, aber die Stabilität lässt bei Überlastung zu wünschen übrig. Sie eignen sich gut, solange sie nicht überfüllt oder stark belastet werden. Insgesamt eine empfehlenswerte Lösung, solange man die genannten Einschränkungen im Blick behält.

Die kwmobile Necklace Case für das Samsung Galaxy S10 Plus / S10+ bietet eine Kombination aus Schutz und Komfort, indem sie als Silikon Cover mit einer praktischen Handykette ausgestattet ist. Dieses Design ermöglicht es, das Handy bequem um den Hals zu tragen, was besonders nützlich für unterwegs oder für diejenigen ist, die immer schnellen Zugriff auf ihr Gerät benötigen.

Das Silikonmaterial des Covers bietet eine angenehme Haptik und einen soliden Schutz gegen Stöße und Kratzer. Die Handykette ist ein praktisches Feature, das den Zugriff auf das Handy erleichtert und es sicher am Körper hält. Die Integration der Kette in das Cover ist gut durchdacht und bietet eine zusätzliche Schicht an Bequemlichkeit.

Leider gibt es einen bedeutenden Nachteil: Das Produkt hat sich als nicht sehr langlebig erwiesen. Die Hülle und/oder die Kette sind nach relativ kurzer Zeit kaputtgegangen. Dies kann frustrierend sein, insbesondere wenn man den Komfort und die Funktionalität der Handykette zu schätzen weiß. Die Probleme mit der Haltbarkeit könnten durch Materialmängel oder Konstruktionsfehler verursacht worden sein, was die Lebensdauer des Produkts erheblich beeinträchtigt.

Insgesamt bietet die kwmobile Necklace Case eine interessante und nützliche Funktionalität, jedoch könnte die Qualität und Haltbarkeit verbessert werden. Wenn die Handykette und das Cover länger halten würden, wäre das Produkt eine ausgezeichnete Wahl für diejenigen, die eine stilvolle und funktionale Schutzhülle suchen. Derzeit sollten Käufer jedoch die möglichen Haltbarkeitsprobleme berücksichtigen und möglicherweise nach Alternativen suchen oder sich auf die Garantie- und Rückgabemöglichkeiten des Herstellers verlassen.

Writing this a long-time collector who frequently likes to rebag his comics. I'll start by saying I purchased 100 ct of the bags and boards on a prime day sale for $25. I think that's a reasonable price for these. But normal asking price is $32 for the combo pack and despite everyone saying that this costs less than other bags and boards, I would disagree. If you shop around, you can easily find other companies selling 100 bags and boards for less. I'm also struggling with the fact that I can't seem to purchase just the bags which is odd. I tend to reuse backboards but bags I swap out frequently and it seems like buying bags alone is not an option right now. Also want to mention that a 50-count bag and board combo is only 1 dollar less than a 100-count which makes no sense. All in all, the company needs to do a better job with the pricing. THAT BEING SAID...I do love the bags which is why I still give it 5 stars. At first, I didn't know if I liked them as they are totally different from what I'm used to. They're thicker and a bit wider than typical current/modern bags it seems. But after bagging a few comics I felt like these are nice because I may never need to replace them. Most bags get all wrinkly over time but I don't see that happening with these. The boards I felt were just okay. They feel thinner and flimsier ironically than other boards I've purchased. All in all, these are my current favorite bags. I just wish I could buy them on their own (without the boards) and hoping the pricing gets straightened out on Amazon.

We are always looking for ways to be better organised. Being strongly magnetic these just need to have some metal surface to attach them to. Two easy to wipe pockets which fit A4 sized paper or booklets. We have used one in the home office attached to the filing cabinet. It is quick to put any letters in and it has helped because these don’t get lost in a pile on the desk top. We have still to decide where the most useful place is for the second.

There is the choice to hang these organisers, with a hole for a nail or hook, if you want them placed more permanently somewhere that is not magnetic.

These would be useful in any place such as waiting rooms and lobbies which have documents / booklets you want noticed, picked up and read. Maybe useful in classrooms / offices for recording books used by more than one person - helps avoiding them getting ‘lost’ as they have a ‘home’ where they are expected to be found when not being used. These may even prove useful in kitchens or garages as they can be wiped clean.

These provide a neat solution across a range of situations and if they are the kind of thing that would be helpful to you they are worth considering.

The mug keeps coffee hot a lot longer than it looks like it should. The thickness of the walls doesn't look like there would be enough of an air-gap to insulate the liquid compared to other dual-wall insulated containers I have. I do preheat the mug with hot water (like I do with other mugs) and the mug keeps the coffee nice and hot for over an hour. The outside of the mug only gets warm near the top where the lid transfers the heat to the outer layer of the mug. The lower portion of the mug doesn't really get warm on the outside.
The lid fits quite snugly (make sure to open the slide slightly when putting the lid on so the air has a way to escape and doesn't push the lid back up).
There are only two minor issues that I have:
1. The seal on the slide to cover the drinking hole doesn't seal completely. Makes it spill resistant, but not spill proof (i.e. some liquid will come out around the drinking hole silicone seal).
2. The gasket around the lid can roll or twist when putting the lid on, so have to watch. If either of these happen, the liquid can leak out around the outside of the lid when even taking a drink.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Mit Tricks auch für Espresso geeignet
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Eine Kaffeemühle für unter 50 Euro wird niemals erstklassige Ergebnisse liefern. Das war mir klar.
Nachdem aber andere Mühlen für fast 100 Euro mehr ähnlich vernichtende Kritiken bekamen, war ich nicht mehr bereit, diesen Aufpreis zu zahlen, sondern habe dieses Modell bestellt.
Auch hier ist das Problem, dass die minimal einstellbare Korngrösse für Espressomaschinen ganz klar zu gross ist, und dass zudem jedes Körnchen auch noch einen anderen Durchmesser hat.
Somit kommt es zur Unterextraktion und damit zur Verschwendung von Nahrungsmitteln.

Man kann sich aber dieses Tricks bedienen:

Bohnen oben einfüllen, mahlen lassen, und das Mahlgut gleich wieder oben reinschütten.
Wird der Mahlvorgang 3-4 mal durchgeführt, ist die Korngrösse hinreichend gleich, und die Espressomaschine, auch Siebträgermaschine, liefert akzeptable Ergenisse.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Perfect Lunch Solution: Stylish, Practical, Convenient. Cute, and Versatile
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I recently got the BELLE VOUS Pink Bento Lunch Box, and it has completely transformed my lunch routine! This lunchbox is not only incredibly stylish but also highly functional, making it the perfect choice for anyone looking to take their meals on the go.

The design of this bento box is fantastic. With six compartments, it offers plenty of space to pack a variety of foods without them mixing together. Whether I’m packing a salad, snacks, fruits, or a main dish, everything stays neatly organized and fresh. The 1330ml/45oz capacity is just right for a satisfying meal without being too bulky to carry around.

One of the best features is its leakproof design. I’ve had no issues with spills or leaks, even with dressings or sauces, which gives me peace of mind when packing liquid-based foods. The lid fits securely, and the clasps are easy to use yet sturdy enough to keep everything sealed tight.

The fact that this bento box is microwave and dishwasher safe makes it incredibly convenient. I can heat up my meals at work without worrying about transferring them to another container, and cleaning up is a breeze since I can just pop it in the dishwasher at the end of the day.

I also appreciate that it’s made from BPA-free materials. It’s reassuring to know that I’m using a safe and healthy product for my food. The included cutlery is a great bonus, neatly fitting into the box and ensuring I always have utensils on hand.

The pink color adds a fun, cheerful touch, and I’ve received several compliments on how cute it looks. It’s perfect for both school and office use, adding a bit of personality to my lunchtime.

Overall, the BELLE VOUS Pink Bento Lunch Box is an excellent choice for anyone in need of a reliable, well-designed food container. It’s practical, easy to clean, and looks great too. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a versatile and stylish lunch solution!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Well made toy box - your dog will be delighted !
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
🔹INTRO & DESCRIPTION🔹

The Belle Vous dog toy organiser box arrives flat packed, and wrapped in plastic. Assembly simply involves taking the separate stiffened base and sliding into the bottom of the box. The base has a handy “tab” making it easy to remove if you wish to fold and store the box. It works on the same principle as the “cube” storage boxes which are very popular.

Once assembled the box has a front which is lower than the back and sides. It also has two carrying handles with shiny silver metal handles. It measures 38 cms x 34 cms and is finished in a neutral grey marl fabric.

🔹OPINION🔹&🔹CONCLUSION🔹

Prior to getting this organiser, my dogs toys were all stored in a cardboard box – an old Amazon box to be precise ! No offence to Amazon, but this is a much better solution ! Not only does it hold lots of toys, but it is also easy for my dog to access all his treasured toys, and choose the one which is “flavour of the day”! He is delighted with it, probably because he can see plenty of room for even more toys!

The fact it has handles is good for me, as we do take regular trips to our caravan, so I can easily just pick up the box and pop it into the car.

I think the current price of £12.99 is very reasonable for the size and quality of this box. All I need now is someone to train my dog on how to put the toys back once he’s got them all out !

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: A Moderately Useful Addition to my Restraint Devices
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I was attracted to ordering these ‘Belle Vous Rubber Bungee Cord with Metal Hooks (2 Pack) – Adjustable’ principally because of the larger, more robust-looking & better coated in plastic hooks (to better protect the items to which they are hooked) than on normal bungee twisted-wire hooks, & both by the relatively-flat 4-core (side by side) bungee strap with facility to shorten the length by adjusting it in one of the hooks. However, when I received the adjustable bungee straps, I was disappointed that the pull-up free end of the straps, with which to adjust the length, was on the inside of the hook, not the outside, making it potentially difficult to reach to adjust. No problem, I thought, I will just take the bungee strap out of the hook buckle & swap it around to face the other way. That proved to be difficult because it was difficult to get the canvas-covered ends of the bungee strap through the buckle – see photos. For the moment, I have changed only one, because of the time it took. The phot showing my finger is to show how thin the individual bungees in the straps are; of the other 3 photos, only the one showing elastic bands round both folded straps has the orientation reversed by me to put the free end of the straps, to pull for adjustment, on the outside face of the hook.

I used these Belle Vous Rubber Bungee Cords with Metal Hooks today for the 1st time (both of them), to secure the frame of my 13-yr-old Cervélo R3 Team bike onto a boot luggage rack, secured onto the lid of the rear luggage compartment of my 14-yr-old Boxster car, the rear end of which is an unsuitable shape on which to mount a proper bike rack. The detatched pedals & rear wheel went in the front luggage compartment, & the front wheel on the passenger seat, secured by the seat belt. I used 3 conventional 2 bungee straps as well to secure the bike frame firmly onto the rack.

As it happened, I could readily get access to the underside of the luggage rack, just as easily as I could the top, so the orientation of the adjustable hook on the Belle Vous Bungee Cords didn’t matter in this instance. However, it would be different when I could only place the nose of the hook into the far side of a load.

Unfortunately, I found that the flat group of 4 (thinner than normal) bungee cords did not have as much stretch or tension as my conventional single bungee cords. However, I expected to be readily able to increase the tension by pulling the free ends of the 2 Belle Vous Bungee Cords; unfortunately, it was not easy to pull the free ends through the buckles … the resistance to sliding was roughly similar to the stretchiness of the free end, & when it had stretched to its limit, I daren't pull harder, for fear of damaging the strap.

I was in a hurry, so I gave up trying to make the adjustment & simply unclipped the hook & rerouted the Belle Vous Bungee Cords over a longer route to achieve the correct tension, then put the hook over the rail of the rack at a suitable location. Unfortunately I had run out of time to take a photo of the straps in use, for this review, as I was now running late to get my car to a garage, for some work to be done on it. The bike was being taken there, so that I could cycle the 7 miles back home.

This set of ‘Belle Vous Rubber Bungee Cord with Metal Hooks (2 Pack) – Adjustable’ was useful, but it did not function as well as I had hoped. The best part about it was the large, strong hooks, fully coated in plastic. The £10.49 price was, in my opinion, reasonable for the functionality achieved, so I have allocated a star score of 3.

I have quite a few bamboo shelves and such for storage inside cupboards and wardrobes — all have been well measured and cut and the screw holes scored well enough to allow for easy assembly.

This nearly broke me, the slots for the pieces to fit together weren’t measured accurately with one side very noticeably smaller than it should have been. I tried the pieces in every possible configuration but it made no difference.

Then assembly - first it didn’t arrive with a screw driver or Allen key so have one ready - then I found several of the places screws were needed wouldn’t allow the screw to fully get flush with the wood. Likely because of the wonky measurements.

Every screw was tightened until my screwdriver literally scratched a mark in the head of the screw THAT’S how much force was needed… and I even then the stand is shaky. It moves from side to side which is frankly the last thing you want from a crockery stand.

A total waste of time and expensive compared with other bamboo options to boot. I went for this cause it looked like decent quality — don’t be fooled.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Great camping mug if you have an extra wide cupholder on your vehicle.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: The sassy thermal travel mug has good thermal design to keep your coffee hot and prevent the contents from spilling out. The graphics are attractive with an appropriate message for travelers and explorers, and the cup is easy to hold and to clean. I had bought one of these earlier for my wife who wanted one after she saw the one I ordered for myself. So I ordered a different color for her. We can easily tell our cups apart from each other as she has a white one while I had bought the one with the black design. I can't use this cup in our RV's microwave (too bad but understandable) since its base is metal. The cups also need to be handwashed which is OK since our RV lacks a dishwasher appliance. The only thing we could wish for as an improvement for this cup to have is a tapered bottom so that it fits securely in one of the Mercedes-Benz Sprinters three cup holders.. You can see in one of my photos that the cup does not securely fit in any of the three different size cup holders in our RV. Yes, both the driver and passenger have three cup holders apiece. That the extra wide cup holder won't securely hold the Sassycup. The base of the SassyCup is too wide to fit securely at the bottom so it tips slightly. I might be OK but if we hit a bump I suspect the cup may pop out the extra wide cup holder in the RV. The solution here if you do run into the same problem is to buy a "cup holder expander" which you can find several of on Amazon. That should then accommodate your SassyCup. Until I get one, I'll simply use the cup at the campsite and won't use it while driving.

These hooks are ideal for hanging a variety of garden tools on. They can of course be used for other things too although I think they would look a bit too utilitarian in a kitchen.

There are 12 double hooks and 6 single hooks in the pack together with self-tapping screws and a small screwdriver. Note that the screwdriver is double-ended, flat on one end and cross-head on the other, and you have to remove the shaft from the yellow handle and re-insert it to use the cross-head end.

The hooks and screws appear to be zinc plated to resist rust. Although the metal is quite thin it is perfectly adequate to hold a heavy spade for example. The screws are 12mm long that should not protrude through tongue and groove shed cladding but would be better if screwed onto the framing or a batten. I was able to screw them into timber without the need for a pilot drill.

I'm quite pleased with these hooks, they enable many of my garden tools to be hung up and more accessible, as well as neater than being propped up on the floor. They are competitively priced and recommended.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Comprehensive kit for hanging heavier frames
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
The set arrived in a clear plastic box that holds all the items securely. This is a good comprehensive set that includes all the parts needed for hanging heavier frames. The wall hooks are large and the fixing nails long which should provide solid anchoring, depending on the wall type. The D rings are also large and have three screw holes for fixing to the frames. The set also includes 6 pieces of picture hanging wire which top off all the items needed to carry out the task for heavy to very heavy frames.

Will be good for large paintings and will easily cope with hanging most mirrors. I particularly like the inclusion of 6 self adhesive silicon bumpers, which are great for placing on the bottom of the frame to hold it away from the wall surface and provide protection. I also like the inclusion of a small spirit level which it's always useful to have when hanging frames.

Pricewise it's £9.49 for the set which I think represents good value, given that these are for larger items, and as there are enough supplies to hang three frames works out at around £3.16 per frame.

Recommended.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Vielseitiges und leistungsstarkes Entwicklungsboard-Set – Ideal für IoT-Projekte und Bastler!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Das AZDelivery 5 x ESP32 Board Dev Kit C V4 NodeMCU ist eine fantastische Wahl für alle, die mit dem ESP32 arbeiten möchten, sei es für IoT-Projekte, Automatisierungslösungen oder einfach zum Experimentieren. Dieses Set bietet nicht nur eine beeindruckende Leistung, sondern auch ein hervorragendes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis.

Der ESP32 ist bekannt für seine Vielseitigkeit und Leistungsfähigkeit. Jedes Board in diesem Set bietet Dual-Core-Prozessoren, WLAN, Bluetooth und zahlreiche GPIOs, was es zu einer idealen Lösung für eine breite Palette von Projekten macht. Ich habe die Boards für verschiedene Projekte genutzt, von der Heimautomatisierung bis hin zu drahtlosen Sensoren, und sie haben sich in jedem Szenario bewährt.

Die Installation und Programmierung der Boards ist unkompliziert. Sie sind vollständig kompatibel mit der Arduino-IDE sowie anderen Entwicklungsumgebungen wie PlatformIO, was den Einstieg für Anfänger und Fortgeschrittene gleichermaßen einfach macht. Dank der umfassenden Dokumentation und der großen Community gibt es zahlreiche Ressourcen, die bei der Entwicklung unterstützen.

Die Boards sind gut verarbeitet und stabil, was besonders wichtig ist, wenn sie in dauerhaften Installationen eingesetzt werden. Die GPIO-Pins sind klar beschriftet, was die Verkabelung und das Prototyping erleichtert. Außerdem funktionieren die Boards zuverlässig und zeigen auch bei längeren Betriebszeiten keine Überhitzungsprobleme oder andere Ausfälle.

Ein weiterer Vorteil ist die Tatsache, dass das Set fünf Boards enthält. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn man mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig laufen hat oder wenn man einfach ein paar Ersatzboards zur Hand haben möchte. Es ist auch ideal für Bildungseinrichtungen oder Workshops, wo mehrere Teilnehmer gleichzeitig arbeiten.

Insgesamt bin ich mit dem AZDelivery 5 x ESP32 Board Dev Kit C V4 NodeMCU Set äußerst zufrieden. Es bietet alles, was man für erfolgreiche IoT- und Elektronikprojekte benötigt, und das zu einem sehr fairen Preis. Für alle, die mit dem ESP32 arbeiten oder in die Welt der Mikrocontroller eintauchen möchten, ist dieses Set eine klare Empfehlung. Klare 5 Sterne!

Der Wasserbehälter ist super. Der Hahn schließt gut und ist zum Glück tatsächlich aus Metall, ich hoffe Edelstahl. Hatte vorher bereits Hähne aus Kunststoff, aber da Wasser eine hohe Lösungskraft hat und ich kein Plastik mittrinken möchte, war mir der Metallhahn wichtig. Man muss lediglich darauf achten, dass der Hahn sehr fest verschraubt wird. Bei einer Wassermenge von 8 l, ist der Druck ziemlich hoch. Wir mussten einmal nachbessern und fester verschrauben, dann war alles gut. Der Hahn tropft nicht und das Ding sieht super aus .
Wir hatten den Behälterdeckel geschlossen und uns gewundert, dass unten nur ein Rinnsal herauskam. Der Trick ist natürlich, entweder den Deckel leicht geöffnet zu lassen, oder das Gummi zu entfernen und den Deckel zuschließen, dann läuft es super.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Vorsicht bei diesem Display Typ (Parallel oder SPI)!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Eine wichtige Info ist, dass dieses Breakout-Borad PARALLEL-Anschlüsse für die Kommunikation hat. Es ist also KEIN SPI Board!
Der Touchscreen (hier ein XPT2046) und das Display (ILI9341) haben unterschiedliche PIN's, schnell kommt man bei den Tutorials oder Libraries durcheinander, da viele Lib's entsprechen verändert, bzw. angepasst wurden (z.B. ILI9341_t3.h oder ILI9341_t3n.h) was dann dazu führen kann, dass man sich nicht einfach auf die Pinvergabe verlassen kann, je nach dem welches Board man benutzt. Ein Arduino UNO ist für dieses TFT daher NICHT zu empfehlen, da die Pins nicht ausreichen - dann eher einen Teensy (4.0 oder 4.1) oder ein Arduino MEGA. Auch mit ESP32 solltet ihr vorsichtig sein, oft wird hier der VROOM32 als funktional angegeben. Wegen mangelnder Beschreibung ein Stern Minus. Und ein Stern Minus wegen mäßiger Verarbeitung des Shield/Touch zerkratzt schnell und die Touch-Sensorik ist wegen fehlendem internen De-Bounce auch nur mittelmäßig, was man später im Programm mit vielen zusätzlichen Zeilen leider ausbessern darf.

Los TCA Tech Shorts de fútbol para niños son una opción excelente para los pequeños deportistas que buscan comodidad y funcionalidad en su ropa deportiva. Estos shorts destacan por ser ligeros, lo que es ideal para mantener la frescura durante entrenamientos o partidos intensos. Un punto fuerte es la inclusión de bolsillos con cremallera, algo que no siempre se encuentra en la ropa deportiva para niños. Esto permite llevar pequeños objetos personales de manera segura, sin preocuparse por perderlos mientras se corre o juega.

En cuanto al diseño, los shorts son prácticos y están hechos con un material que facilita la transpiración, ayudando a mantener la piel seca. Esta característica es esencial para evitar incomodidades durante el ejercicio. Además, la calidad de los materiales parece ser bastante duradera, lo que es un plus considerando el desgaste que suele tener la ropa infantil.

Por último, aunque son altamente funcionales, el diseño es sencillo, lo que podría no atraer a aquellos que buscan algo más llamativo. Sin embargo, si se priorizan la comodidad y la practicidad, los TCA Tech Shorts son una opción muy recomendable para cualquier niño que practique fútbol u otros deportes.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Ajusta perfecto, identico al que traia la aspiradora

El filtro que sustituí era el original, que venía de fábrica, y después de casi cinco años de uso, ya estaba bastante deteriorado, con algunas zonas casi al borde de romperse. Era definitivamente el momento de cambiarlo, y este nuevo filtro parece ser una réplica perfecta del anterior, de hecho yo no he encontrado diferencia alguna.

El ajuste es perfecto, para quitarlo tengo que hacer movimientos como de desenroscado, tal como hacia con el viejo al principio, pero ya ultimamente con tirar de el sin mucha fuerza ya salia. Ahora solo toca esperar a ver cuanto dura.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Lovely to look at but unable to clean.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
This is a really cute, mostly well made birdhouse but as there isn't any way to get into the nesting box side of it to clean it then it's pretty much useless as a nesting box because of the risk of disease spreading through the local bird population. Nesting boxes should be cleaned out every year once the parents and their young have left it. It also didn't make a lot of sense for it to be freestanding as you would need something fairly tall to stand it on so that the birds felt safe nesting in it. Although that could be changed by attaching a hanger on the back of it so it can be attached to the side of the house or a tree.

It is such a shame that I feel it is unusable as a nesting box because it really is well made and looks adorable, but the lack of any access to clean it out means I can only give it three stars.

This bookstand does indeed work - I have tried it with several hardback books and it does hold them open - but it is flimsy.

As it is essentially two plastic planks that you slot together (to me, very expensive for the money you are paying), one slight knock while moving around the kitchen is all it takes for the stand to come apart and drop your book. I feel that this product would fare much better with a hinge as opposed to a slotting mechanism. A hinge would also allow for varying angles of opening for books of different sizes and would help the stand to hold softcover books much better.

Aesthetically it looks nice but the areas that slot together seem rough and unfinished compared to the rest of the stand.

In short, it is OK. But there is room for improvement, so do shop around.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Funktioniert grundsätzlich gut, könnte aber etwas höher und (damit auch) schwerer sein
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Die Magnete des Messerhalters sind ausreichend stark um die Messer sicher zu halten. Da der Messerblock aber auch nicht besonders schwer ist, sollten mehrere Messer am Block hängen, damit man den Block nicht mehr festhalten muss, um ein Messer abzuziehen. Es können nur 2 große Kochmesser angebracht werden, da durch die Schräge sonst das Messer noch mit der Schneide über den Rand raus gucken. Kleinere Messer passen ünerall.

Pro:
-sauber verarbeitet und optisch ansprechend
-starke Magnete halten die Messer sicher
-Preis

Contra:
-könnte etwas höher sein, dann würden längere Messer, oder mehr lange Messer dran passen
-könnte schwerer sein. Ein großes Messer hebt den Block bei hochziehen mit an. Wenn mehrere Messer anheften, stimmt das Gewicht, und der Block bleibt stehen.

- ha una doppia chiusura con coulisse che protegge bene dall'ingresso di polvere e consente di inserire obiettivi di dimensioni diverse.
- all'interno troviamo un'impermeabilizzazione in neoprene di tutta la fascia grigia con texture a spina di pesce
Veniamo ora agli aspetti che non mi hanno convinta:
il tessuto grigio è sottilissimo e non offre alcuna protezione dagli urti, quindi non è assolutamente adatto al trasporto, ad esempio in uno zainetto o una valigia. Manca totalmente di imbottitura. L'unica soluzione è inserire un'imbottitura in modo artigianale o avvolgere l'obiettivo nel millebolle prima di inserirlo in questo sacchetto, che da solo non assolve alla funzione di protezione.
Questo copri obiettivo è adatto solo per tenerlo in casa.
A fronte di tutto quanto sopra il prezzo di 16 euro al momento di questa recensione non è adeguato: con pochi euro in più si acquista un intero set di proteggi obiettivi belli spessi e anti urto.

Der Belle Vous Hellgrauer Pfeifkessel ist ein ansprechender und funktionaler Wasserkessel, der sowohl für Gas- als auch für Induktionsherde geeignet ist. Mit einem Fassungsvermögen von 3 Litern ist er ideal für das Zubereiten von Tee oder Kaffee für mehrere Personen. Hier meine ausführliche Rezension:

### Design und Verarbeitung
Der Kessel besticht durch seine elegante Edelstahl-Emaille-Oberfläche, die nicht nur modern aussieht, sondern auch beständig gegen Flecken ist. Der helle Grauton verleiht ihm eine besondere Note und ermöglicht eine einfache Integration in verschiedene Küchenstile. Die Verarbeitung ist robust, und die Nähte scheinen solide verklebt zu sein, was einen langlebigen Gebrauch verspricht.

### Benutzerfreundlichkeit
Der Belle Vous Pfeifkessel ist mit einem ergonomischen, wärmeisolierten Griff ausgestattet, der eine komfortable Handhabung ermöglicht, selbst wenn der Kessel heiß ist. Der Deckel lässt sich leicht öffnen, was das Befüllen und Reinigen erleichtert. Zudem sorgt das integrierte Pfeifgeräusch dafür, dass der Benutzer informiert wird, wenn das Wasser den Siedepunkt erreicht hat. Dies ist besonders praktisch, um den Kessel rechtzeitig vom Herd zu nehmen.

### Funktionalität
Dieser Teekessel funktioniert sowohl auf Induktionsherden als auch auf traditionellen Kochplatten, was ihn vielseitig einsetzbar macht. Er erhitzt Wasser schnell, dank der effizienten Wärmeleitung des Edelstahlmaterials. Die 3-Liter-Kapazität ist ideal für größere Gruppen, und man kann problemlos genug Wasser für mehrere Tassen Tee oder Kaffee auf einmal zubereiten.

### Reinigung und Pflege
Die Reinigung des Kessels gestaltet sich unkompliziert. Edelstahl ist leicht abzuwaschen und es gibt keine schwer zugänglichen Ecken. Es wird empfohlen, den Kessel regelmäßig zu entkalken, besonders wenn man häufig hartes Wasser verwendet, um die Lebensdauer und Effizienz des Kessels zu sichern.

### Fazit
Insgesamt bietet der Belle Vous Hellgrauer Pfeifkessel ein gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis. Er überzeugt durch sein elegantes Design, die Benutzerfreundlichkeit und die Vielseitigkeit auf unterschiedlichen Herden. Die sanfte Pfeif-Funktion und die einfache Handhabung machen ihn zu einer ausgezeichneten Wahl für Teeliebhaber und Kaffeetrinker. Wer einen zuverlässigen und stilvollen Wasserkessel sucht, ist mit diesem Modell gut beraten.
P.S. Ich besitze bereits seit längerer Zeit einen ähnlichen Kessel, bei dem sich leider nach kurzer Zeit der Deckel aufgelöst hat, da das Innenteil verklebt war. Ich habe daraufhin den Deckel samt Innenteil durchbohrt und mittels zweier Schrauben befestigt. Leider haben diese Schrauben zu rosten begonnen (angeblich Edelstahl). Der Deckel des vorliegenden Kessels ist ebenfalls verschraubt. Es bleibt zu hoffen, dass die Schrauben nicht auch zu rosten beginnen. Ich empfehle übrigens, den Kessel an Benutzung vollständig zu entleeren und ohne Deckel wegzustellen, da mit aufgesetztem Deckel im Bereich des Kesselrandes Flugrost zu befürchten ist.

This rather useful picture hanging kit arrives in it's own plastic storage box. Inside the box is a complete set of bits to hang at least 3 picture frames. Or more precisely 3 heavy pictures on solid walls or 3 very light pictures on plasterboard.

The seller has also included some very short screws. Useful for mounting the parts directly onto the picture's backboard, rather many kits which only mount from the frames. Though the wire lengths are a little short, especially if hanging long pictures.

Overall ? At around £3.40 (at time of order) per frame, this is a decent affordable option for hanging framed heavy pictures on solid walls. But if you are only hanging lightweight frames it's a little overpriced.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Several things make this cup stand apart from others that are similar. The graphics are high end and it is like a traditional camp cup in design and look but with modern features like having a thermal boundary between the outer skin and metal cup to help keep the coffee warm. ⚙️ I recently received a pack of two ratchet straps with S hooks, each measuring 6 m in length and 25 mm in width. These straps are intended for securing various items, such as motorcycles, kayaks, and furniture, and have a working load limit of 450 kg (more on this later). They are constructed from weather-resistant polyester fibre, which is durable enough to withstand wet conditions without breaking or tearing. However, I did notice that some of the stitching is uneven in places and not of the best quality I have encountered.

🚗 The non-slip S hooks are coated in rubber to prevent scratches on my vehicle, and the rubber handles with a release lever make them relatively easy to use. That said, if you are not familiar with this type of strap, it can inadvertently pinch your fingers. While the straps may not be suitable for heavy daily use, they are adequate for occasional applications. I don’t consider them heavy-duty, as the frames are lightweight and have a bit of rattling, with the paint applied rather thinly.

💼 At £14.49, the price seems a bit steep considering their lightweight construction, and I have doubts about their ability to securely hold heavy loads. Overall, I consider them to be average value for the money for the quality, and I think that 3 stars is fair. Don’t mistake me; they do work, but I think people might automatically buy them with 4 stars, and they need some thought as the quality just isn’t there. ⚖️

I was looking for a really good plunger and I checked the reviews on Amazon. As usual I checked the 1 star reviews first to see if they had any major revelations! Some people were pretty unimpressed but the majority seemed to give positive reviews.

The plunger itself comes in 2 pieces which screw easily together. It looks and feels like fairly flimsy cheap plastic and so I had some trepidation. You can buy ones which seem more substantial and have a rubber suction cap much more cheaply.

The advantage of this however is that the "coiled" body of it acts like a compressor and builds up suction very simply and very quickly. I plunged sinks with it which I thought were already pretty clear and it still brought up gunge. So full marks for that. I used it on a shower and a kitchen sink and a wash-hand basin.

You do of course have to block any other air holes in the sink before you plunge but I'm sure everybody knows that already!

All in all a pretty effective plunger and probably the best I have ever used and so justifies the higher price. This review is for the larger model with a green handle and blue body. I would recommend it, and I didn't get it free!!!!

Then a few days later I used the ladder for screwing a lamp on the sealing. Suddenly I was in free fall and the pieces of the chair broke my foot. In summary: do not use it as a ladder: it is death dangerous.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: La calidad del acabado podría mejorarse un poco, pero en general, ¡una caja de servicio maravillosa!
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
El artículo llegó bien embalado, en una caja de cartón genérica y sellada, con el asa dorada envuelta individualmente y la tapa de acrílico protegida con plástico en ambos lados. El montaje es muy fácil e intuitivo.

El cuerpo de la caja está hecho de bambú y tiene 4 divisores interiores que son removibles. Desafortunadamente, hay algunas áreas que están "reparadas" y mal acabadas, como puedes ver en las últimas fotos.

El tamaño es bastante generoso, casi 30 cm de largo, y me encanta la calidez del bambú, así como la forma ovalada, lo que la hace muy elegante.

La tapa tiene un ciervo dorado como asa, lo cual es muy lindo y encantador.

Creo que esta caja puede usarse para muchos artículos pequeños, pero estoy segura de que la usaré para servir nueces y semillas, aunque la tapa no cierra herméticamente y la humedad podría estropear la comida dentro si se deja por mucho tiempo.

*A pesar de haber recibido este artículo para propósitos de prueba, mi reseña es completamente imparcial y genuina, basada en mi propia experiencia y expectativas. No estoy influenciada por factores externos, y mi reseña refleja mis pensamientos y sentimientos honestos sobre el producto. Comparto mi reseña para ayudar a otros a tomar decisiones informadas, y espero que les sea útil en su propio proceso de compra.

And so this aluminium based bookstand seemed an excellent idea; Light in weight but with a reassuringly sturdy feel about it, and easy to set up and fold away. But in use, holding any sort of book open with the fitted page clips is totally impossible, thereby, sadly, making the device 'unfit for purpose'. The only workable option seemed to be to use separate 'Bulldog' type spring clips, but unless the size of the book is approximately the same size of the back plate of the support and not too thick, that won't work either. Or at least, I didn't for me. So the practical option is to look for a similar product but with clips powerful enough to overcome contemporary books with so called 'ideal binding'

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Kit completo per appendere quadri (ma occhio alle necessità specifiche)
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Kit che contiene tutto il necessario per poter appendere quadri, fotografie, specchi e cornici in genere. Il sistema, piuttosto classico, consiste nell'applicare due staffe con occhiello sul retro del quadro, legare il cavetto d'acciaio tra uno e l'altro e poi appendere il quadro al gancio ottonato da fissare con i chiodi alla parete. Il materiale presente, seguendo il metodo descritto, consente di appendere tre quadri, per un peso massimo di 5 kg ognuno. Bisogna però considerare che non tutte le cornici sono adatte a questo tipo di attaccaglie. Le viti per fissare le staffe occhiellate sono molto piccole e corte mentre i chiodi da piantare nella parete per i ganci ottonati sono lunghi ben 5 cm. In base al tipo di cornice o di muro è quindi bene sapere che la minuteria fornita potrebbe non essere adatta (chiaramente è possibile utilizzare dei tasselli da 5 invece dei chiodi (ma questi non sono forniti). Sono presenti anche i gommini adesivi da posizionare sul retro della cornice, nella parte inferiore, per livellare la cornice rendendola complanare alla parete. Un metodo efficace e "vecchia scuola", ottimo in alcuni casi, un po' meno in altri.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Useful bits, but unsure about the quality
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
My husband has recently started trying his hand at golf so I thought he might find this accessory set useful. There's a dual-headed brush with a handle for cleaning your golf clubs. One side is a wire brush for cleaning the metal of your irons and the other side is nylon for wood and there's also a pointed bit on the end, (sharp with a removal protective cover), which is to poke out sand, stones and small bits from the club. A plastic clip cover fits over the whole head of this brush for when not in use. I like how this brush is attached to an extendable cord that can be pulled out about 60 cm with a carabiner clip on the end, so you can attach it to your golf bag and always have it to hand without fear of losing it full.

There's a microfibre cloth - again with a carabiner clip for attaching to your bag - useful for wiping down and this absorbs well. Measuring 60 cm x 40, it's of a decent size but folds up small.
I also really liked the look of the tool with many parts which resembles a Swiss army knife. It's on a chain with akey ring and includes a little brush, a ball marker, a small metal pen to write on the ball, (this slots in the top), a wrench, a divot tool and a groove cleaner. I thought this looked really good but as I took it out of the box the back and part of the inside fell apart. Not knowing much about golf personally, I wasn't sure whether that was how it was supposed to be, but I don't think so because it took me ages to put the metal back part back into place and looking at it, part of the metal casing is bent, so I think it's damaged, which is a shame. I also imagine that the magnetic ball marker disc will get lost quickly as it takes little effort to dislodge it from the front of the tool. I can only assume this tool is damaged or faulty as I doubt whether it should be buckled (see photo), and immediately fall apart, but I may be wrong.
Aside from this, it would be a great set for a golfing fan, although bear in mind that as it comes in a plastic packet, the presentation is not giftable, therefore you would need to buy something to put it in to make it look decent.

I have looked for a suitable brush for my tightly coiled 4c hair for decades.
This gets through my insanely kinky DNA configured curls easier than any other brush or comb I have ever used, and all without tearing the hairs out like an epilator! It removes the dead hair effectively without causing breakage. No mean feat on hair like mine! Difficult to do because of the texture, but absolutely necessary as my hair will locks without any provocation.
For hair that is similar in texture to mine, a word to the wise, DO NOT MANIPULATE YOUR HAIR WITHOUT WATER OR OIL (PREFERABLY BOTH), no matter how gentle you are, you will cause breakage! Our hair is inherently dry and ALWAYS needs to be moisturised to be detangled, combed or styled. And go through your hair with your fingers before ANY kind of mechanical manipulation (that means before combing or brushing) to get rid of the most extreme tangles first. This will ensure that you retain far more hair, rather than ripping it out whilst you comb and brush through it. AND ALWAYS START AT THE ENDS OF YOUR HAIR! THAT GOES FOR EVERYONE! I can honestly say my hair is longer since I have been using this because it doesn’t damage my hair the way other brushes have.
That being said, this is the least painful de tangling experience you will ever have if you heed my prior warning. Even a little leave in conditioner will do the trick, but you MUST use something to give you some ’slip’ as it goes through your hair, and be gentle!
Now, for every other type of curly, you don’t need to be so fastidious with the moisture, you won’t have the crazy zigzag configuration that leaves your hair as desperate for hydration as ours is.
That means that wet or dry, this will glide through your hair with the minimum of effort. And, if it catches a knot, the bristles are flexible enough to bend rather than break the hair off. Really great for the health of your hair and less traumatic if your using it on your little one!
For those of you with crazy curls but in a looser pattern, damp hair is still probably going to make the process easier for you, but even with dry hair, this will annihilate the most stubborn tangles in no time flat!
I recommend investing in some Camellia Tea oil for anyone with dry hair or frizzy ends.
It’s light enough for even the finest hair, and even manages to tame my insane bird’s nest.
Some of that with this brush and tangles will never be a problem again! I’m going to order 2 more! I really love this brush! I’ve paid a lot more money for less effective items.
Hope that helps!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Lots of storage, good containers but the lids are lower quality
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
On the face of it, there is a lot for your money here. 15 x 600ml containers, they stack for storage which is essential and the containers themselves are dishwasher, freezer and microwave safe.

The size and volume is very useful - we took a load away camping and it was great to always have a useful-sized container for snacks and leftovers.

The containers themselves are good quality and slightly thicker plastic than my much more expensive Sistema ones. However, the lids are a bit of a let-down. They are much thinner and the hinged locking flaps feel like a weak point destined for failure. However, they do close securely and have a silicone seal included.

The other major drawback, though, is that the lids are marked as not dishwasher or microwave safe which is a big red flag for me. Let's face it, if they can't go through the dishwasher they will end up in the bin and if they do, they will probably fail sooner. It's Hobson's choice.

So this is a 'not quite, what might have been' for me...

Ich habe die Griffe an meinem Kraft-Turm im Heim-Gym angebracht und nun für diverse Übungen eingesetzt. Insgesamt bin ich sehr zufrieden, da sie für mich einfach perfekt in der Hand liegen. Bei Rotationen des Griffes sind sie noch recht leichtgängig, wobei ich versuche sie nicht zu sehr zu Drehen (je nach Übung nicht ganz so einfach).

Eine Zugbelastung von jeweils ca. 30kg macht den Beiden bisher nicht im Geringsten etwas was. Für mich war die Anschaffung eine sehr gute Entscheidung und eine gute Ergänzung für weitere Trainingsmöglichkeiten. Sowohl für Zugbewegungen am Kabelturm als auch für Druckbewegungen (Trizeps) ist der Griff sehr gut geeignet und fühlte sich von der ersten Sekunde optimal für meine Hand an.

Bei kleineren Händen vermute ich, dass die Breite unangenehm werden könnte - meine Frau bevorzugt hier runde Griffe.

Hinweis: Ich habe dieses Produkt kostenlos im Rahmen des Amazon Vine Programms zur Verfügung gestellt bekommen. Meine Rezension in diesem Beitrag ist davon unbeeinflusst und erfolgt freiwillig.

The Good:

* The small compartments and the drawer are handy for things like paper clips, mini post it notes, staple remover tools etc.
* You can fit loads of paperwork into this organiser as it’s so big.

The Bad:
* It looks cheaply made. It’s very light so it feels like it’s made from balsa wood.
* Whilst the rear compartment is suitable for holding long scissors, rulers or a few envelopes, the main compartment is too deep for pens! And even if you had extra long pens, you’d need loads of them to fill the space so that they stand up as it’s all one big compartment. You’ll notice from the sellers photos, they don’t show any regular pens being stored.

I also don’t understand why they didn’t design this with two drawers rather than just one. The space under the two small compartments on the left is simply wasted.

The fact that this cant hold pens means I can’t recommend it.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: A Large Capacity Cup With Good Features
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: The SassyCups Travel Tumbler with Handle - 40 oz Insulated Stainless Steel Mug with Straw and Slide Closure Lid - Fits Car Cup Holder - Helps Keep Drinks Hot or Cold is a useful mug for short or long trips. The mug comes with a long straw with a flexible silicone tip. The straw appears to be made of stainless steel. The bottom of the straw is cut flat instead of at an angle which allows it to sit flat on the bottom of the mug cutting off or reducing flow. I knocked off 1/2 star for this. The exterior of the mug is finished in powder coat and mine had a chip in it. This probably came from careless handling at the factory and I knocked off another 1/2 star for this. The handle on the mug is large enough for large hands which is not always a given. Also, it was comfortable to hold. As with any mug, the capacity is measured to the brim without the top on which, of course, is not the way anyone uses it. While the stated capacity is 40 ounces, the actual capacity is 32 - 34 ounces and this is typical of any mug, not just this one. For example, I have another mug that is rated at 32 ounces but the actual usable capacity is about 24 ounces. The thermal usefulness of the mug is on par for any stainless thermal mug and the manufacturers' rating is accurate. Stainless steel is an excellent material for travel mugs as it is exceptionally strong and wear resistant. I doubt you could wear out a stainless mug in a life time. This is a strong, large capacity mug that will serve you well to keep your cold drinks cold and your hot drinks hot for as long as you own it.

Die Shorts bestehen aus atmungsaktivem und feuchtigkeitsableitendem Material, das dafür sorgt, dass die Haut trocken bleibt und Überhitzung vermieden wird. Dies ist besonders wichtig während intensiver körperlicher Aktivitäten, da es den Tragekomfort erhöht und die Leistungsfähigkeit unterstützt.

Ein besonders praktisches Feature sind die Reißverschlusstaschen, die sicheren Platz für kleine Gegenstände wie Schlüssel oder Münzen bieten, während die Kinder sich bewegen. Die Reißverschlüsse verhindern das Herausfallen der Sachen und ermöglichen eine sichere Aufbewahrung.

Die Shorts sind zudem in einem modernen, sportlichen Design gehalten und lassen sich leicht mit anderen Sportbekleidungsstücken kombinieren. Sie sind in verschiedenen Größen erhältlich, um unterschiedlichen Altersgruppen und Körpergrößen gerecht zu werden.

Die TCA Tech Jungen Fußballshorts bieten nicht nur eine ausgezeichnete Leistung auf dem Spielfeld, sondern auch praktische Details, die den Alltag sportbegeisterter Jungen erleichtern.

Assembling this was one heck of a challenge. Apart from getting a fine cut from one sharp edge where a piece of splinter was still protruding on the side, you get a number of plastic clips that being the 4 sides and the bottom base together.

Each clip has 2 grooves from a single slot in a round-shaped clip. You have to somehow insert the clip into one of the sides and then balance the other and then push the other side into the clip. Once it's in, it simply rocks. This rocking makes it difficult to then assemble the alternate sides and corners.

Around 20 mins later, I managed to assemble this and after all this, although it's quite stable, each side rocks back and forth. It doesn't convey a professional build at all, and at the current price of £26.99, It's way overpriced.

It also states it can hold 80 files, but you have to note that these files would be empty, so if you had average-sized files, max you could fit is around 30 before it would start getting tight.

The only pro on this is that it's mobile, so in a small office where you would want the convenience of being able to slide a stack of files from one desk to another, this would do exactly that without it falling apart, but with the flexible clips, I can't guarantee that over time, it won't wear out and you'll end up using standard ziplock straps.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Broad spectrum detector, not specific but not all-inclusive
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
It’s a bit vague what this actually detects (although the datasheet lists all the different gasses/vapours), it’s not just organic molecules, it’s not just acidic gases or alkaline gasses, it’s just kind of a weird mix of unrelated things.

I would say this is a great cheap sensor for VOCs (e.g. in a workshop) but the fact it picks up atmospheric CO2 and NOx too makes it kind of pointless. It just tells you there’s some amount of atmosphere around.

If you used this in only a controlled environment where no more than one detectable gas could be present, then it’s great…but no one buying a cheap sensor has that use-case.

So, it’s fun to play with and see that numbers go up when you use alcohol/paint/ammonia/breathe nearby, but for the home-gamer that’s about it.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Ein wenig kurz geraten, sonst top fürs Laufen
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Nachdem ich zuletzt 2 Laufshirts von TCA aus der Männerserie in Größe S bestellt hatte und feststellen musste, dass diese viel zu groß ausfallen, habe ich auf gut Glück dieses QuickDry Jungen T-Shirt von TCA bestellt. Gemäß Größentabelle sollte es ideal passen, da es in etwa den Angaben zu der Größe XS entspricht, welche es aber so beim Herrenartikel gar nicht gibt. Lediglich in Sachen Körpergröße, bin ich ein paar cm größer als es die Angabe zu den Maßen für 12-14 jährigen Jungen entspricht.
Und tatsächlich würden mir genau diese 4cm fehlen, damit das Shirt ideal passt!
Darüber hinaus ist in einigen anderen Rezensionen zu lesen, dass das Shirt eher klein ausfällt, was ich jetzt so nicht in Summe bestätigen würde, wenn man seine Sportkleidung lieber eng-anliegend statt schlackernd hat.

Die Verarbeitung aller Nähte ist hervorragend. Die in grau gehaltenen Mesh-Einsätze sind super sinnvoll und sorgen für angenehme Kühlung, gerade bei wärmeren Außentemperaturen und schweißtreibenden Aktivitäten. Sonst ist der Stoff in einem cleenen Weiß gehalten und kann gut in der Maschine mit anderer Sportkleidung gewaschen werden. Auch den (Wärmepumpen-)Trockner übersteht das Shirt ohne einzulaufen oder sich zu verziehen.

In Summe ist das Teil durchaus empfehlenswert. Nur mit der Preisgestaltung habe ich so meine Probleme und kann nicht ganz nachvollziehen, warum der Doppelpack eines ähnlichen Produktes von TCA für Männer bis zur Größe L, also unter Einsatz von viel mehr Stoff, nur wenige Euro mehr kostet, als das eine Shirt für Jungen?

I can't wait to try this out in Puerto Vallarta on the boat, the jet ski, the paddle board, the water taxi etc.,
You really have to see this, and try it on, to fully understand what I'm trying to describe. I sincerely believe this should be part of anyone's repertoire when traveling to tropical climates and engaging in water sports, hiking, biking etc.
Jolie coque, pareil que sur la photo

The Sun Ninja Dry Sack Pack is a good bit of kit for your water adventures. I'd put it in the 25L range for capacity. One main compartment, two side pockets, one front pocket. The pockets are very tight and aren't going to hold a lot. Also, as other reviews have noted, you'd better be dang sure you get the zippers all the way closed on them or whatever is inside will get some wetness.

The main compartment seems pretty solid, though. It's a roll top and buckle closre, so again, make sure you do it right and you should be okay. Material is 500D synthetic and seems pretty strong. Shoulder straps have nice padding for a pack at this price point and are fairly comfortable. All-in-all, this seems to be a pretty good deal for your weekend kayak/boat/canoe trips. If you're doing a SEAL Team 6 water operation, maybe look elsewhere. But to guard against accidental dunkings, definite buy.

As with any water gear, don't forget to test it before you use it!

Versatile Fit: The design is flexible and fits comfortably under my helmet, making it ideal for motorcycle riding as well. It stretches to accommodate different head sizes, so both men and women can wear it without any issues.

Durable and High-Quality: The stitching is strong and well-finished, ensuring this mask will last through many winters. It’s been through multiple washes and still looks and feels brand new.

Multi-Purpose Use: I love how versatile this mask is. Whether I’m skiing, snowboarding, biking, or just taking a walk on a cold day, this balaclava provides the protection and warmth I need. It’s also great for layering under other gear.

If you’re looking for a reliable and comfortable winter face mask, this balaclava is a fantastic choice. It’s become an essential part of my cold-weather wardrobe, and I highly recommend it for anyone who spends time outdoors in the winter.
