I recently purchased the Sun Ninja Beach Tent, and it has truly exceeded all my expectations. Setting it up was a breeze—within minutes, I had the tent securely anchored, thanks to the simple instructions and easy-to-use components. Even with the wind picking up slightly, the Sun Ninja stayed perfectly in place, proving its sturdiness.

Portability is another highlight. The tent is incredibly lightweight, making it effortless to carry from the car to the beach, and it packs down neatly into a compact bag that barely takes up any space.

Once up, the Sun Ninja provided excellent protection from the sun, allowing me and my family to relax comfortably under its shade. The best part? It became the talk of the beach! Everyone was curious about it, and I received numerous compliments on how sleek and functional it looked. If you're looking for a beach tent that's easy to set up, portable, and reliable in variably windy conditions, the Sun Ninja is the way to go. This summer, it was definitely the envy of the beach!

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Keeps cold drinks cold & hot drinks warm
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I really like this thermos with a handle. I love that this cup holds a large amounts of liquid so I can fill it once and save all throughout my day. I really like that is a very similar design to a popular cup out there right now, because all the accessories fit this cup, and so I could customize it the way that I wanted.
It also fits in every cupholder in my car and my mom’s car in my friends car, which has been really awesome to find in a thermos that holds so much liquid.
When I add ice to my cup, it keeps it cool all day long but if I add a coffee or a hot tea, it keeps it really nice and hot for several hours!
It’s nice to have the versatility to use it for both hot and cold.
I really like how sturdy the handle is. It makes it really nice and easy to pick up.
The two things that I didn’t like about this cup was the lid is mostly for shippers, not straw users. The opening exposes too much of a gap on both sides of where the straw goes into but it’s a perfect for those that just like to tilt and sip their liquids. I really didn’t like the metal straw that it came with, it had a rubber piece to it which just picked up everything so quickly; any lint, dust, cat hair, and I’m pretty sure that’s the part where you put your mouth. So overall two very minor things and I really appreciate and like this cup.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Nowhere near the quality of others I have.
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
I was offered these straps free of charge for an honest review under the 'Vine' Program.

On inspection I immediately found quality issues compared to one other similar ratchet straps I already own. The stitching and the thread used on these is nowhere near the robustness of my others and there are no labels to verify the break strength. The cut off at the open end of the long strap is also sloppy and one has already started to fray (the other brand I own seems to be heat sealed on the open end to prevent fraying) . In use however, the major difference I experienced was the ease (or otherwise) of releasing the strapping after use. On these, after fully opening the ratchet handle (to it's full horizontal position) I also found I had to pull back the spring release catch before I could pull the strapping out. This is very fiddly compared to my other strap which only requires full opening of the ratchet handle to pull out the strap. Some may say this is a safety feature but I think it is quite inconvenient and is of no benefit.

The hooks seem strong and there is plenty of length on the straps to cover a load on a trailer. Additionally, this is a 4 pack which could be helpful in some situations. The ratchet mechanism works fine for tightening the strapping. However, for me, there are just too many minor quality and usage issues to make this my 'go to' strap down solution and I will probably only use these for light loads when I will perhaps double up and use all 4 when I would normally only need 2 (even though then, I will have the added inconvenience of the struggling with the release mechanism).
Lösen sich beim Gebrauch im Freien auf und reißen dann.

These straps will definitely promote order and ease to the daily tie-down routine. The ratchet and straps are somewhat flimsy and the self retraction springs already began to fail after less than a month of daily use. I would recommend these for occasional lightweight use.

CUSTOMER_REVIEW_TITLE: Ignore the foolish reviews -- it's equivalent of 1000 mg
CUSTOMER_REVIEW_DESCRIPTION:
Took me a while to understand the complexities of different versions of ashwagandha. But this is a 30:1 extract. So when the back of the bottle says 33.34 mg, it's really 1000 mg equivalent of the root extract. Ignore all the uneducated complaining reviews.

(Note: I'm not saying I know this is super high quality or anything -- no idea, but seems fine to me. Just that the thing about false advertising is flat-out wrong. Other brands just put the equivalent number on the bottle so they don't get bad reviews.)

Also important to note that the 1000 mg equivalent is with 3% withanolides, like most products you'll find on Amazon. However, there are also extracts that have 5% (such as most KSM-66 if it's done right) or even higher. So if you find a product with a different kind of extract, you need to adjust for this too. Yes, this is complicated. Basically this is equivalent to 600 mg of most KSM-66 products (which tend to be around 5% withanolides). This is a dosage on par with most of the studies done. So you ARE getting the correct amount with these gummies.
You get what you pay for, but overall good quality. Slippery for hot yoga, but good for home workouts.
